song:
1. Thooya, Thooya, Thooya, Saththiyeka Thevaa!
  Umakke Ennaalum Sangeedham Erume;
  Thooya, Thooya, Thooya, Sarva Valla Naadhaa!
  Kaarunyare, Aanandhak Katale!

2. Thooya, Thooya, Thooya, Anpar Soozha Nindru
  Thevaasana Munnar Tham Kreetam Vaippaare;
  Keroopeem Seraapeem Thaazhndhu Potrap Petru,
  Indrendrum Veetraalveer, Anaadhiye!

3. Thooya, Thooya, Thooya, Jodhip Pirakaasaa!
  Paavakkannaal Um Maanpaik Kaana Yaar Vallor?
  Neere Parisuththar, Mano Vaakkuk Kettaa
  Maatchimai, Thooimai, Anpum Niraindhor!

4. Thooya, Thooya, Thooya, Saththiyeka Thevaa!
  Vaanam, Poomi, Aazhi Ummaith Thudhikkume;
  Thooya, Thooya, Thooya, Sarva Valla Naadhaa!
  Kaarunyare, Thooya Sadhyekare!
title: Thooya, thooya, thooya, saththiyeka
Poolokaththaare, yaavarum

song:
1.Anaadhiyaana Karththare,
  Theyveeka Aasanaththile
  Vaanangalukku Melaai Neer
  Makimaiyotirukkireer.

2.Pradhaana Thoodhar Um Munne
  Tham Mukam Paadham Mootiye
  Saashtaangamaakap Panivaar
  Neer Parisuththar Ennuvaar.

3.Appatiyaanaal Thoosiyum
  Saampalumaana Naangalum 
  Evvaaru Ummai Antuvom?
  Evvidhamaai Aaraadhippom?

4.Neero Uyarndha Vaanaththil,
  Naangalo Thaazhndha Poomiyil
  Iruppadhaal, Vananguvom,
  Maa Payaththotu Seruvom.
title: Anaadhiyaana karththare
Naam theva sannidhaanaththil

song:
1.Aa Karththaave! Thaazhmaiyaaka Thiruppaadhath Thantaiye.
  Thentanita Aavalaaka Vandhen, Nalla Yesuve;
  Ummai Naati, Tharisikkave Vandhen,
  Ummaith Theti, Tharisikkave Vandhen.

2.Paavam Theerkkum Paliyaana Suththa Aattuk Kuttiye,
  Neere Thiruch Chabaikkaana; Gnaana Manavaalane;
  Ummai Naati, Tharisikkave Vandhen,
  Ummaith Theti, Tharisikkave Vandhen.

3.En Piraaththanaiyaik Kelum, Aththiyandham Panindhe,
  Kenjum Ennai Etrukkollum
  Naan Um Sondham Aanene;
  Ummai Naati, Tharisikkave Vandhen,
  Ummaith Theti, Tharisikkave Vandhen.
title: Aa karththaave! Thaazhmaiyaaka

song:
1.Pukazhvom Karththaa, Nesa Sudhan Yesu
  Makkatkaai Maantu Vintalanj Chendranare.
            
  Allelooyaa! Kanam Pukazh, Allelooyaa! Umakke,
  Allelooyaa! Engalukkup Puththuyir Thaarume.

2.Pukazhvom Karththaa, Parisuththa Aavi
  Meetparaik Kaanpiththu, Irul Pokkinaare.
            
3.Sakala Kanam, Aattuk Kuttikkuththaan,
  Sarva Paavam Etru, Karai Neekkinaare.
           
4.Ellaa Menmaiyum, Karunai Karththarukku,
  Emai Vaangi, Theti Nataththukindraare.

5.Uyirppiyume Um Anpaal Nirappum
  Uyar Akniyaal Aaththumaa Joovaalikkattum.
title: Pukazhvom karththaa, nesa sudhan yesu

song:
1.Yesuvin Inpa Naamaththai
  Ellaarum Potrungal;
  Vinnorkal Pola Avarai, 
  Neer Vaazhka! (4) Ennungal.

2.Pisaasinindru Maandharai
  Meettoraip Potrungal;
  Oppatra Nesar Avare  
  Neer Vaazhka! (4) Ennungal.

3.Ellaarum Arul Naadharai
  Makizhndhu Potrungal;
  Jeevaadhipadhi Avarai, 
  Neer Vaazhka! (4) Ennungal.

4.Avaraip Paarkkum Pozhudhu
  Oyaamal Potruvom;
  Nam Meetpar Paadham Panindhu,
  Neer Vaazhka! (4) Ennungal.
title: Esuvin inpa naamaththai

song:
1.Potrum! Potrum!! Punniya Naadharaip Potrum!!!
  Vaanor Kootip Paatavum Inpamaai,
  Paarileyum Naama Sangeerththananj Cheyya,
  Maandhar Yaarum, Vaarum Aanandhamaai;
  Nesa Meyppan Karaththil Endhumaaru
  Yesu Naadhar Nammaiyum Thaanguvaar.
  Potrum! Potrum!! Theva Kumaaranaip Potrum!!!
  Paadhu Kaaththu Niththamum Poshippaar.

2.Potrum! Potrum!! Punniya Naadharaip Potrum!!!
  Paava Naasam Seyvikka Muyandraar;
  Paatu Pattup Piraanath Thiyaakamumaaki
  Vaana Raajya Vaasalaith Thirandhaar;
  Maa Karththaave! Sdhoththiram Indrum Endrum!
  Vaazhka! Vaazhka!! Jekaththu Ratchakaa!!!
  Arul Naadhaa! Maasanukaa Paragnjodhi!
  Valla Thevaa, Karunai Naayakaa!

3.Potrum! Potrum!! Punniya Naadharaip Potrum!!!
  Vinnum Mannum Isaindhu Paatavum,
  Potrum! Potrum!! Eka Makaththuvamaaka,
  Aatchi Seyvaar Niththiya Kaalamum;
  Yesu Raajaa, Maatchimaiyotu Vandhu,
  Yesu Svaami, Poomiyil Aalume;
  Lokam Engum, Needhiyin Kreetaththaich Chooti,
  Jodhiyaakap Paalanam Pannume.
title: Potrum! Potrum!

song:
1.Pakdhare! Annaandhu Paarum! Yesu Vetri Vendharaai
  Vaanil Thondra, Maandhar Yaarum Sevippaare Thaazhmaiyaai
  
  Vaazhka! Vaazhka!! Endrum Vaazhka!!! Vaazhka! Raaja Raajare!
  Vaazhka! Vaazhka!! Endrum Vaazhka!!! Vaazhka! Raaja Raajare!

2.Thevadhoodhar Muti Sootta Raajareekanj Cheykiraar.
  Yaavarum Jeya Keedham Paata Kreetadhaariyaakiraar.

3. Theeyarum Sakkandhamaaka Muti Sootti Vaazhththinaar
  Thooya Thoodhar Koottamaaka Sevith Thaara Vaarippaar.

4.Paarum Raaja Apishekam! Aaravaaram Kelume!
  Yesuvin Sarvaadhikaaram Poomi Engum Koorume.
title: Pakdhare! Annaandhu paarum!

song:
1.Potruven En Meetpar Anpai!
  Praanan Thandhu Ratchiththaar.
  Paatupattu Raththanj Chindhi,
  Paavam, Saapam Neekkanaar.
  
  Potrum! Potrum!! Allelooyaa!
  Poorna Meetpuntaakkinaar
  Thooya Valla Raththam Sindhi,
  Theeya Paavam Neekkinaar.

2.Neesap Paavi Endranperil
  Nesam Vaiththuk Kaattinaar.
  Meetkum Porulaakath Thammai
  Mutrum Thandheetetrinaar.
  
3.Potruven Sampoorna Meetpai!
  Nesa Naadhar Kaakkiraar,
  Vaazhnaal Ellaam Paavaththin Mel
  Vetri Kaanach Cheykiraar

4.Potruven Aanandhamaakap
  Paati Nandri Solluven!
  Ennai Meetta Yesuvote
  Endrum Thangi, Sevippen.
title: Potruven en meetpar anpai!

song:
1.Potruven Yesu Anpai! Ennai Mun Nesiththaare!
  Vinlokam Vittu Avar Kalvaariyil Mariththaar.
  
  Potruven! Yesu Anpai Endrume En Manadhil
  Enakkaai Avar Maanta
  Anpai Ennip Potruven.

2.Naan Kanneer Vitumunne Enakkaaik Kanneer Vittaar,
  Naan Jepanj Cheyyumunne Thuyaramaai Jepiththaar.
  
3.En Paavak Karai Pokkith Thooimai Yaakkineere, Um
  Theyveeka Anpin Aazham Yaar Alavitak Kootum?
  
4.Naan Theemai Seydhapodhu Neer Anpu Kaanpiththeere.
  En Ullam Umakkuth Thaan Anpai Uruvaakkume.
title: Potruven yesu anpai

song:
1.Meyth Thevanaith Thudhi Per Nanmai Seydhaar,
  Kumaaranaith Thandhunnaiye Nesiththaar,
  Un Paavaththukkaai Yesuve Mariththaar,
  Nee Jeevanaip Pera Aaruyir Thandhaar.

  Potruvom! Potruvom!! Jeeva Naayakarai, 
  Nampuvom! Nampuvom! Loka Ratchakarai!
  O! Yesuvin Moolam Narkadhi Untaam,
  Pidhaavin Samookam Kantataiyalaam.

2.Sampoorana Meetpaich Champaadhiththanar,
  Tham Vaakkai Anparuk Karulven Ena
  Eppaaviyaanaalum Visvaasam Vaiththaal,
  Annerame Mannippuntaam Yesuvaal.
  
3.Adhisayamaana Anpin Perukke!
  Yesuvinaale Varum Makizhchchiye!
  Annaalil Yesuvai Naan Paarkkum Podhu
  Untaakum Makizhchchikku Varampunto?
title: Meyththevanaith thudhi per nanmai seydhaar

song:
1.Ennerameyum Paatuven; Visaaram Neengitre.
  Immaanuvelaip Potruven; Sandhoshamaayitre.
  
  Sangeedham, Keedham, Keedham, Paatuven
  Keedham, Keedham, Sangeedham Paatuven.

2. En Yesuvaik Kalvaariyil Naan Kanten, Appodhu
  Ennaaluntaana Thunpaththaik Kantu Kanneer Vitten.
  
3.Pollaadha Sodhanai Vandhaal Yesuvaip Paatuven;
  Kanneer Soriyum Velaiyil Endrum Naan Paatuven.
  
4.Peranpin Suviseshaththai Ellaarkkum Therivi;
  Poomiyengum Pudhup Paattu Muzhanga Nee Paatu.
title: Ennerameyum paatuven

song:
1.Peranpar Yesu Nirkiraar, Naam Antik Kolluvome
  Kataatchamaakap Paarkkiraar, Nal Naamam Potruvome.
  
  Vinnil Menmai Petradhe; 
  Mannor Inpamaakave
  Paatip Potrum Naamame; 
  Yesu Ennum Naamam.

2.Un Paavam Yaavum Manniththen; Anjaadhe Enkiraare
  Sandhekang Kontu Sorvadhen? Meyp Paakyam Eekiraare.
  
3.Maa Menmai Yesu Svaamikke Nammaal Untaavadhaaka
  Ratchanya Kriyaikkaakave Naam Vaazhththal Seyvomaaka.
  
4.Ratchanya Valla Naamaththaal Visaaram Neengip Pokum;
  Avvinpa Naamam Ketpadhaal Sandhoshamum Untaakum.
  
5.Perinpa Motcha Lokaththil Maanpaakak Kootuvome,
  Ratchanyanaadhar Paadhaththil Saashtaangam Pannuvome.
title: Peranpar yesu nirkiraar
Ekopiththuch cherndhituvom

song:
1.Vaanin Keezh Vaazhum Maandhare! Karththaavin Pukazh Ongita,
  Sarva Vallavar Naamaththai Ellaarum Potrip Paatuvom.

2.Karththaa! Um Krupai Endrendrum Um Sadhya Vaarththaikal 
  Sadhaa Udhayamaana Um Keerththi Karai Mattilum Nilavum.

3.Nilaiyatra O Maandhare, Paadalkalinaal Potruvom.
  Avar Ratchippin Seydhiyai Uraiththituvom Saththamaai.

4.Thesamengum Naam Paatuvom. Valuvaai Thoniththituvom
  Kempeera Saththaththinaale. Lokil Avarai Vaazhththuvom.
title: Vaanin keezh vaazhum maandhare

song:
1.Neer Vaarum, Raajaave! Um Naamam Thudhikka
  Krupai Seyyum; Makimaiyutaiya
  Vetriyin Karththaave!
  Anaadhi Thevane! Aatchi Seyyum.

2.Thetrara Vaalane! Um Nal Saatchikalaidh
  Thaangukiren Vallavar Neer Thaame
  Vaasam Seydharulum
  Neengaamal Nilavum Vallavare.

3.Sarva Vallavare! Um Siththam Seydhitum
  Poolokinil Makadhvamutaiya
  Karththaave! Ummaiye
  Neetoozhi Naatkalaai Thudhi Seyvom.
title: Neer vaarum raajaave um

song:
1.Theva Krupai Engum Vazhindhotudhe
  Avar Koti Endrum Jodhi Veesudhe
  Melulakam Pola Maatchiyulladhu
  Avar Anpu Sadhaa Vin Jolikkudhe.

2.Kotai Soorya Oli Engum Veesudhe
  Makizhchchiyin Oli Nirain Thotudhe
  Poolokaththaar Kali Koorndhu Paatita
  Potrudhalin Thoni Muzhangitudhe.

3.Andhakaaram Neenga Oli Veesume
  Karththaa! Ummai Naangal Nesiththitave
  Vin Mantala Mekam Viraindhu Otum
  Thirai Uyarndhita, Pidhaa Thondruvaar.

4.Oru Podhum Naangal Sandhekiththitom
  Maranaththin Vaasal Ummil Nalladhu
  Neer Illaadha Vaazhvu Andhakaarame
  Nidhya Inpa Vaazhvin Vazhikaattitum.
title: Theva krupai engum vazhindhotudhe

song:
1.Thooimaiyile Naam Karththarai Aaraadhippom
  Panindhu Avaraip Pukazhvome
  Thaazhndhu Keezhpatindhu Avarin Naamaththai
  Vanangi Thudhiththu Thozhuvome

2.Paaraththinai Avar Paadhaththil Vaiththitu
  Unakkaai Adhanaith Thaangituvaar
  Un Jepam Kettuth Thetrituvaar Unnai
  Un Kaalatikalaik Kaaththituvaar.

3.Anjitaadhe Prakaaraththinul Sendrita
  Nee Petra Aasdhiyaik Kaanikkaiyaai
  Karudhi Vaanjaiyaaip Pataikkum Pozhudhu
  Anpin Sadhya Vaarththai Pulanaakum.

4.Pakdhiyote Nee Pataikkum Kaanikkaiyai
  Nichchayam Karththar Thaam Etruk Kolvaar.
  Avar Thaam Unnutaiya Kanneerai Neekkuvaar
  Makizhchchi Arulvaar Ena Nampu.
title: Thooimaiyile naam karththarai

song:
Osannaa Paalar Paatum Raajaavaam Meetparkke!
Makimai, Pukazh, Keerththi Ellaam Untaakave!

1.Karththaavin Naamaththaale Varungomaane, Neer
  Thaaveedhin Raajaa Maindhan, Thudhikkappatuveer.
  
2.Unnadha Thoodhar Senai Vinnil Pukazhuvaar;
  Maandhar, Pataippu Yaavum Isaindhu Potruvaar.

3.Um Munne Kuruththolai Kontekinaar Polum,
  Mandraattu Keedham Sdhoththiram Kontummaich Chevippom.

4.Neer Paatupatum Munne Paatinaar Yoodharum;
  Uyarththappatta Ummaith Thudhippom Naangalum.

5.Appaattaik Ketta Vannam Em Vental Kelume;
  Neer Nanmaiyaal Niraindha Kaarunya Vendhare.
title: Osannaa paalar paatum

song:
1.Makadhva Raayan, Potrath Thozhuvom.
  Arpudha Anpu, Nandri Paatungal.
  Anaadhi Thevan Sakaayar; Ketakam.
  Makimai Kanam Thudhiyum Avarkke.

2.Oli Ven Aatai; Pannoli Sutar.
  Puyazhum Settai; Irulum Vazhi.
  Akniradham Kaarmekam Minnal Soozhum.
  Peraatral Paatum; Maa Kirupai Potrum.

3.Palaveenar Yaam; Nilaiyatravar.
  Nampum Pakdharai Kaiviteer Endrum.
  Sakaayar, Nanpar; Pataiththeer Meetteere.
  Um Krupai Podhum Engal Aayul Mattum.
title: Makadhva raayan, potradh

song:
1.Seeyonil Karththar Aalvaar; Makizhvom Naamellaam.
  Servom Naam Kirupaasanam Makizhndhaarpparippom
  Seeyonil Karththar Aalvaar; Pukazh Thudhi Ketpom.
  Vendhar Muzhangaal Mutanga Raaja Menmaiyuntaam.

2.Seeyonil Karththar Aalvaar; Avar Pol Thevan Yaar?
  Aazhkatal Avar Kaiyinkeezh Peraazhiyum Aalvaar.
  Mutisootti, Naamam Potrum Avar Koti Ongum.
  Neer Soozh Maa Aazhaththil Theevum Meetpin Aatral Perum.

3.Seeyonil Karththar Aalvaar; Kaalam Nesar Sondham.
  Thevaalayap Prakaaraththil Inpa Keedha Vaazhththal
  Raayar Kotik Keezh Vanangum Uyirkal Ellaam
  Karththar Vinman Ellaam Raajaa Menmuti Soottuvom.
title: Seeyonil karththar aalvaar

song:
1. Thevap Peraatral, Vallamai Naan Paatuven Endrum
  Parvadhangal Aazhaazhikal Vaanamum Pataiththaar
  Pakalai Aalum Sooriyan, Vinmeen, Sutarnilaa
  Paniyum Theva Mey Gnaanam, Naan Potrip Paatuven.

2.Karththar Uyirkal Anaiththum Vaarththaiyaal Pataiththaar
  Nanmaiyaana Naleevukal Seer Unavum Thandhaar
  Naan Thangum Poomi Aakaayam Engum Avaiyellaam
  Pataippin Arpudhak Kaatchi; Naan Paatuven Endrum.

3.Pookkalum Poongotikalum Theva Makimaikke
  Kaarmekam Seerum Puyalkal Avar Kattalai Keezh
  Uyirkalin Urpaththiyum Ataikkalam Thanjam
  Um Samukam Allaal Veru Pukalitam Kaanom.
title: Thevap peraatral vallamai
Sarvaththaiyum anpaai

song:
1.Saruvalokaadhipaa, Namaskaaram!
  Saruva Sirushtikane, Namaskaaram!
  Tharai, Katal, Uyir Vaan Sakalamum Pataiththa
  Thayaapara Pidhaave, Namaskaaram!

2.Thiru Avadhaaraa, Namaskaaram!
  Jekath Thiratchakane Namaskaaram!
  Tharaniyil Manutar Uyir Ataindhonga
  Tharuvinil Maantoi, Namaskaaram!

3.Parisuththa Aavi, Namaskaaram!
  Parama Sarkuruve, Namaskaaram!
  Aroopiyaai Atiyaar Akaththinil Vasikkum
  Ariyasiththe, Sadhaa Namaskaaram!

4.Muththozhilone, Namaskaaram!
  Moondrilondrone, Namaskaaram!
  Karththaadhi Karththaa, Karunaasamuththiraa,
  Thuththiya Thiruththuvaa, Namaskaaram!
title: Saruva lokaadhipaa, namaskaaram!

song:
1.Saththaai Nishkalamaai Oru Saamiyamum Iladhaayach
  Siththaai Aanandhamaaith Thikazhkindra Thiruththuvame,
  Eththaale Yatiyen Kataith Theruvan En Paavan Theer
  Aththaa Unnai Yallaal Enakkaar Thunai? Yaarurave?

2.Emmaa Vikkuruki Uyireendhu Purandhadharkor
  Kaimmaa Runtukolo? Kataikaarum Kaiyataiyaaich
  Summaa Rakshnaisey, Sol Sudhandhiram Yaadhumilen
  Ammaan -  Unnaiyallaal Enakkaar Thunai? Yaarurave?

3.Thiraiser Vempavamaam Katal Moozhkiya Theeyaremaik
  Karaiserth Thuykkavendre Punaiyaayinai Kanniliyaan
  Parasen Patrukilen Ennaip Patriya Patruvitaai,
  Arase, Unnai - Yallaal Enakkaar Thunai? Yaarurave?

4.Thaaye, Thandhai Thamar, Kuru Sampaththu Natpevaiyum
  Neeye Emperumaan, Kadhi Verillai Ninnayang Kaan:
  Eye, Endrikazhum Ulakotenak Kennurimai?
  Aaye, Unnaiyallaal Enakkaar Thunai? Yaarurave?
title: Saththaai nishkalamaai

song:
1.Seermiku Vaanpuvi Thevaa, Thodhram!
  Sirushtippu Yaavaiyum Pataiththaai, Thodhram!
  Er Kunane, Thodhram! Atiyaark
  Kirangituvaai, Thodhram - Maa Nesaa

2.Ner Miku Arul Thiru Anpaa, Thodhram!
  Niththamum Umak Katiyaarkalin Thodhram!
  Aar Manane Thodhram! Unadhu
  Anpinukke Thodhram! - Maa Nesaa

3.Jeevan, Sukam, Palam Yaavukkum Thodhram!
  Thinam(2) Arul Nanmaikkaakavum Thodhram!
  Aavalutan Thodhram! Unadhu
  Anpinukke Thodhram! - Maa Nesaa

4.Aaththuma Nanmaikatkaakavum Thodhram!
  Adhisaya Nataththudharkaakavum Thodhram!
  Saatrukirom Thodhram Unadhu
  Thakumanpukke Thodhram - Maa Nesaa

5.Maaraap Poorana Nesaa, Thodhram!
  Makizhotu Jepa Mozhi Maalaiyin Thodhram!
  Tharuvaai Thunai Thodhram! Indhadh
  Tharuname Kotu Thodhram - Maa Nesaa
title: Seermiku vaanpuvi thevaa

song:
Yesuvaiye Thudhisey Nee Maname,
Yesuvaiye Thudhisey - Kirisdhesuvaiye

1.Maasanukaadha Paraapara Vasdhu
  Nesa Kumaaran Meyyaana Kirisdhu,	- Yesu

2.Andhara Vaan Tharaiyum Tharul Thandhan,
  Sundhara Mikundha Savundhara Nandhan,  - Yesu

3.Ennina Kaariyam Yaavum Mukikka,
  Mannilum Vinnilum Vaazhndhu Sukikka	 - Yesu
title: Esuvaiye thudhisey nee maname

song:
Sundharap Parama Theva Maindhan Yesuk Kirisdhuvukkudh 
Thoththiram, Pukazhchchi Nidhya Keerththanam Endrum

Andharam Puviyum Thandhu, Sondha Jeevanaiyum Eendhu
Aatrinaar; Nammai Ondraaik Koottinaar; Arul Muti 
Soottinaar; Kirupaiyaal Thetrinaar, Thetrinaar Endrum             - Sundharap

1.Paadhakap Pasaasaal Vandha Theedhenum Paavaththaal Nondha 
  Paavikalaana Namai Usaavi Meettaare;
  Vedha Pidhaavuk Kukandha Jaadhiyaakak Koottavandha 
  Mesiyaavaip Patrum Visuvaasa Veettaare, 
  Kodhanukaa Needhiparan Paadhamadhin Aadharavil 
  Kootungal; Paavaththuyar Potungal; 
  Jeyaththaik Kontaatungal; 
  Thudhi Sollip Paatungal, Paatungal Endrum     - Sundharap

2.Vinnilulla Jodhikalum, Ennatangaa Senaikalum
  Vindhaiyaaik Kirisdhuvaip Panindhu Potrave, 
  Mannilulla Jaadhikalum Nannum Pala Porulkalum
  Valla Paran Enath Thudhi Solli Eththave,
  Annalaam Pidhaavuk Kore Punniyak Kumaaranaik
  Kontaatita, -Avar Paadham Thetita, Veku Thiral Kootita 
  Thudhi Pukazh Paatitap Paatita, Endr           - Sundharap

3.Saththiyath Tharasarkalum Uththiyokath Thuraikalum
  Sangath Thozharkalung Kirupai Thangi Vaazhave, 
  Eththisai Manidharkalum Pakdhar Visuvaasikalum 
  Ekamikach Chamaadhaanamaaka Vaazhave, 
  Uththamap Podhakarkalum Saththiyath Thiruch Chapaikalum 
  Uyarndhu, Vaazha - Theeyon Payandhu Thaazha Mika Nayandhu 
  Kirisdhuvukku Jeyandhaan, Nayandhaan Endrum 	        - Sundharap
title: Sundharap parama theva maindhan

song:
Thoththiram Seyvene - Ratchakanaith
Thoththiram Seyvene

Paaththiramaakka Immaadhram Karunai Vaiththa
Paarththipanai, Yoodhakkoththiranai, Endrum 	- Thoththiram 

1.Annai Mari Sudhanai - Pulmeedhu
  Amizhdhuk Kazhudhavanai,
  Munnanai Meedhutra Sinnak Kumaaranai,
  Munnurai Noorpati, Innilath Thutronaidh
  
2.Kandhai Podhindhavanai -  Vaanorkalum
  Vandhati Panipavanai,
  Mandhaiyark Kaanandha Maatchi Yaliththonai,
  Vaana Paran Ennum Gnaana Kunavaanai
  
3.Sem Ponnuruvaanai - Thesikarkal
  Thetum Kuruvaanai,
  Ampara Meviya Umpar Kuzhaangalo
  Tanpu Pera Nindru, Paim Pon Malar Thoovi,
title: Thoththiram seyvene, ratchakanaidh

song:
Thandhaanaith Thudhippome - Thiruch
Chapaiyaare Kavip -  Paatippaati

Vindhaiyaai Namakkanandhanandhamaana,
Villarkariyadhor Nanmai Mika Mikadh		 - Thandhaanaidh

1.Oiyaaraththuch Cheeyone, - Neeyum
  Meyyaakak Kalikoorndhu Nerndhu
  Aiyanesukkunin Kaiyaik Kooppith Thudhi
  Seykuvaiye, Makizh Kolluvaiye, Naamum
  
2.Kannaarak Kaliththaaye, -  Nanmaik
  Kaatchiyaik Kantu Rusiththup Pusiththu;

title: Thoththira paaththirane

song:
1.Karththaave, Ennai Maa Anpaai Neer Indha Raavilum
  Pollaang Killaamal Sukamaai Tharkaaththuk Kontirum.

2.Iruttileyum Thevareer Velichchamaanavar;
  Mey Isravelaik Kaakkum Neer Urakka Matravar.

3.Ennaal Untaana Paavaththaal Manam Kalanginum 
  Kirisdhuvin Thooya Raththaththaal En Nenjaik Kazhuvum.

4.Irakkam Seydha Umakke Pukazhum Nandriyum 
  Seluththuven, En Karththare, Ennaith Thallaadhirum.
title: Karththaave ennai maa

song:
1.Mey Jodhiyaam En Nesare! Neer Thanginaal Raavillaiye;
  En Nenjuk Kummai Maraikkum Mekam Varaamal Kaaththitum.

2.Um Nesa Maarpil Endrume Naan Saaindhu Vaazhdhal Inpame,
  Endru Naan Patukkaiyilum Sindhikka Eviyarulum.

3.Ennotu Thangum Pakalil Sukiyen Neer Illaavitil;
  Ennotu Thangum Raavilum, Neer Thaangin Anjen Saavilum.

4.Indraikkuth Thivya Azhaippai Asattai Seydha Paaviyai
  Neer Kaivitaamal, Ippodhe Izhuththuk Kollum, Meetpare!

5.Noyutroraik Kannokkitum, Variyorai Visaariyum;
  Thukkippor Sisu Polave Amarndhu Thoongach Cheyyume.

6.Vizhikkum Podhennarukil, Neer Vandhu Endran Velaiyil
  Um Arul  Thandhu  Kaaththitum En Aayul Kaalam Muzhudhum.
title: Mey jodhiyaam en nesare
Ennotirum en nesa karththare

song:
1. Yesuvin Kaiye Kaaval, Yesu Nal Maarpile,
  En Aavi Avar Anpaal, Inpa Nidhrai Seyyum.
  Kel! Thoodhar Paatum Saththam, Jodhi Naattinindru,
  Muththuk Katal Vittoti En Keedham Konteki.
  
  Yesuvin Kaiye Kaaval,Yesu Nal Maarpile,
  En Aavi Avar Anpaal, Inpa Niththirai Seyyum.

2. Yesuvin Kaiye Kaaval, Kollum Kavalaiyum,
  Sodhanaikalum Neengum, Paavam Varaadhange.
  Maa Visaaram, Sandhekam, Payamo Angillai;
  Innum Konjam Ikkattu, Konjam Kanneer Inge.
  
3. Yesu En Aadhma Thanjam, Enakkaai Mariththaar;
  Pilavunta Malaimel, Endrum Naan Nampuven.
  Inge Porumaiyotu, Raavo Sendru Kaalai
  Pon Nakaril Udhikkum Mattum Kaaththiruppen.
title: Esuvin kaiye kaaval

song:
1. Pakalum Raavum Karththarutaiyadhu
  Irul Soozhkaiyil Nammotiruppaare
  Avar Nizhalin Keezh Ilaippaaruvom Naam
  Avar Kaappaatruvaar.

2. Payangal Yaavum Otip Pokum Munne
  Vitiyumattum Kaaththuk Kolluveere
  Aadhmaa Sareeraththai Theenginindru Kaakka
  Thoodharai Anuppum.

3. Poomiyil Endha Thanjamume Illai
  Pataiththa Thevane Emmai Ratchiyume
  Um Anpin Prasannam Vilakuvadhillaiye
  Thammaith Thetuvorkku.

4. Potrituvome Um Iniya Naamam
  Um Siththam Seyya Ventik Kolkirome
  Paavaththai Manniththu Jeevanaith Thandharuli
  Paadhukaarum Thevaa.
title: Pakalum raavum karththarutaiyadhu

song:
1. Innaal Varaikkum Thevane, Ennaith Tharkaaththu Vandheere;
  Umakkuth Thudhi Sdhoththiram Seykindradhe En Aaththumam.

2. Raajaakkalukku Raajane, Umadhu Settaikalile
   Unnai Anaiththuch Cherththitum; Irakkamaakak Kaaththitum.

3. Virodham Nenjil Penaadhu, Naan Thoonga Arul Purindhu,
  Krisdhu Nimiththam Irangum; En Kutram Yaavum Manniyum.

4. Pidhaave, Endrum Enadhu Ataikkalam Neer; Umadhu
  Mukaththaik Kaanum Kaatchiye Niththiyaanandha Muththiye.
title: Innaal varaikkum thevane
Soozhum irulil, arul jodhiye

song:
1. Ippo Pakal Sendru Iravaakitre;
  Ennotu Neer Thangil, Endrum Anjiten.

2. Inpa Niththiraiyai Ilaip Putrorkku
  Karunaiyaaith Thandhu, Kan Paarum Naadhaa.

3. Naangal Patukkaiyil Nandraaith Thoongaiyil,
  Nal Thoodharin Kaaval Natakkach Cheyyum.

4. Karththaavin Paarvaiyil, Suththanaaith Thondri,
  Vitiyar Kaalaiyil Vizhikkach Cheyyum.

5. Kanam Menmai Pukazh Pidhaa Kumaaran
  Aavikke Sadhaavum Untaavadhaaka. - Aamen.
title: Ippo pakal sendru iravaayitre

song:
1. Merke Maalai Maayudhu, Vaanam Vaiyam Thotudhu;
  Velli Ellaam Pookkudhu; Aakaayam Jolikkudhu; Ati Pani.
  Thooya, Thooya, Thooya, Senaik Karththaa!
  Vaanam Vaiyam, Ummaiye
  Potrith Thudhikkindradhe, O! Maa Karththaa!

2. Anta Mantalaththile, Aantavarin Veettile,
  Atiyaarkal Kootave, Aasir Seyya Varave, Nerungitum.
  Thooya, Thooya, Thooya, Senaik Karththaa!
  Vaanam Vaiyam Ummaiye
  Potrith Thudhikkindradhe, O! Maa Karththaa!

3. Irul Vandhu Mootave, Arul Emmaik Kaakkave,
  Vaanath Thirai Natuve Em Idhayam Ekave Vaarom Idho.
  Thooya, Thooya, Thooya, Senaik Karththaa!
  Vaanam Vaiyam Ummaiye
  Potrith Thudhikkindradhe, O! Maa Karththaa!

song:
1. Aiyare, Neer Thangum Ennutan!
  Aiyare, Neer Thangum - Ippo
  Andhi Neram Pozhu Thasdhamiththaachche,
  Aiyare, Neer Thangum.

2. Pakal Muzhudhum Kaaththeer, Sendra
  Pakal Muzhudhung Kaaththeer; - Thoththiram!
  Parane Indha Iravilum Kaarum!
  Paaviyai Neer Kaarum.

3. Neer Thangum Veettil, Yesuve,
  Neer Thangum Veettil Ellaam
  Niraive Andrik Kuraiyaamo Karththaa?
  Ninnai Vitamaatten.

4. Enakkum Neer Kaaval Yesuve!
  Enakkum Neer Kaaval; - Endran
  Inaththaar Janaththaar Eliyaar Valiyaar
  Ellaarukkum Kaaval.

5. Ummote Patuppen, Yesuve!
  Ummote Patuppen; - Iravil
  Ummo Tayarven, Sedhamillaamal
  Ummo Tezhundhiruppen.

6. Maranam Jeyiththor Neer, Meyyaai
  Maranam Jeyiththor Neer; - Ummaal
  Maraname Koorenge? Narake Ninvalu
  Jeya Menge Enpene.
title: Aiyare, neer thangum ennutan!

song:
1. Vaarumaiyaa Podhakare, Vandhemmitam Thangiyirum;
  Serumaiyaa Pandhiyinil, Siriyavaraam Engalitam.

2. Oli Mangi Irulaachche, Uththamane Vaarumaiyaa,
  Kaliththiravu Kaaththiruppom,Kaavalane Karunai Seyveer.

3. Aadharaiyilem Aarudhale, Anparukkuch Chadhaa Urave
  Pedhaiyarkkup Perarive, Paadhai Mey Jeeva Sarkuruve.

4. Naamiruppom Natuvilendreer, Naayanum Naamam Namaskarikka,
  Thaamadhamen Thayaipuriya, Tharparane, Nalam Tharuveer.

5. Undran Manai Thiruchchapaiyai Vaiyamengum Valarththituveer.
  Pandhamarap Parikariththe Paakkiyamalith Thaantarulveer.
title: Vaarumaiyaa podhakare

song:
1. Sooriyan Maraindhu Andhakaaram Vandhadhu.
  Sorndha En Thekam Ayarndhu Nal Ilaippaarap Pokudhu:
  Aiyaa, Neyaa, Ponnati Saranam.

2. Manadhu Vaakku Natakkaiyilum Umakkuth Thurokamaai
  Seydha En Paavam Yaavaiyum Um Thiru Udhiraththaal,
  Kazhuvi Suththikariyum Yesaiyaa.

3. Pakal Muzhudhum Patchamaakap Paadhukaaththeere.
  Sakala Theemaiyum Akala Vaiththarul Nalamum Eendhaaye,
  Aiyaa, Neyaa, Ponnati Saranam.

4. Aaththumam Sareeram Enakkaana Yaavaiyum,
  Appaa Um Kaiyil Oppuviththu, Naan Ayarndhu Thoonguven.
  Thevaa, Kirupai Koorndhu Kaarume.

5. Raavil Varum Mosam Ondrum Ennaich Cheraamal,
  Peyin Sarppanai Theeya Soppanam Manadhil Neraamal,
  Thevaa Um Nal Kaaval Thaarume.

  Kaaththu Vandhitum, Enadhu Karththaadhi Karththane!   	- Sdhoththiram

4. Podhane, Needhane, Punidha Sadhya Vedhane,
  Keedhane, Thaasar Thudhi Kelum, Yesu Naadhane! 	  	- Sdhoththiram

  Vedha Nool Thaarum, Thoodhu Mozhi Veesa,
  Vaakkuth Thaththangal Karpanai Anpum
  Iravu Sendru Vitindhitum Varai,
  Um Sutar Ennaich Cheeraai Nataththum.

  Vaakkuth Thaththangal Karpanai Anpum
  Iravu Sendru Vitindhitum Varai,

  Vaakkuth Thaththangal Karpanai Anpum
  Iravu Sendru Vitindhitum Varai,
  Um Sutar Ennaich Cheeraai Nataththum.

song:

  Arulappattadhe, Arulappattadhe.

  Parampa Arulum Sarkuruve.

song:
1. Kaadhu Kulirap Paatungal Kirupaa Saththiyam;
  Puththi Theliyak Kaattungal Thivviya Vasanam,
  Velka! Saththiya Vedham Vaazhka! Niththiya Vedham!
  Amirdhame! Arpudhame! Thivviya Saththiyam.
  Amirdhame! Arpudhame! Thivviya Saththiyam.

2. Nalla Seydhiyaik Koorume, Kirupaa Saththiyam.
  Paava Naasaththaik Kaattume, Thivviya Vasanam;
  Vaana Varusha Maari, Gnaana Pokkisha Vaari,
  Amirdhame! Arpudhame! Thivviya Saththiyam.
  Amirdhame! Arpudhame! Thivviya Saththiyam.

3. Vedhanaayakar Pozhiyum Kirupaa Saththiyam;

  Amirdhame! Arpudhame! Thivviya Saththiyam.
  Amirdhame! Arpudhame! Thivviya Saththiyam.

song:
1. Maa Menmai Petra Vedhame! Un Jodhi Veesudhe.
  Un Vaakkaik Ketpor Sindhippor Maa Inpangaanpaare.
  Or Etra Vaarththai Solvaaye, Eth Thanmai Yullorkkum,
  Aa! Ellai Yillaach Chelvamum Unnaale Kitaikkum.
  
  En Paadhai Kaattum Theepame, En Vazhik Koliye, 
  En Jeevakkaalam Ennutan Oliyaaich Chellave.

2. Maa Kopam Thappa Otita Nee Puththi Solkiraai.
  Krusetuththup Pin Selvorkkup Per Vaakkukkotuththaai
  Jeevaatril Paanam Pannalaam, Mey Vaanjai Yullore;
  Maa Suththar Paakyavaankalaam Endrarul Kindraaye.

3. Un Kantippum Echcharippum Maa Nanmaiyaanadhe;
  Mey Vaanjai Jepath Thotadhai Naan Etruk Kolvene,
  Aa! Menmai Petra Vedhame! Neerp Paakya Raavome,
  Un Aarudhal Sandhoshamum Mey Vaazhvum Indriye.

  Paalarkkiniya Paalum Adhaam;

  Tharunam Adhu Nal Aayudhamaam;

  Vakukkum Theva Vaarththai Adhu;

  Vidhiththa Piramaanamum Adhuve	 				- Saththiya

  Aavalaai Akkaatchi Kantaanandhippen;
  Meetkappatta Thaasar Ondrukooti Motcha Lokaththil,
  Nirkumpodhu Naanum Kootave Nirpen.

  Thaasar Vinnil Ondru Kooti(3)
  Nirkumpodhu Naanum Kootave Nirpen.

2. Niththirai Seydha Pakdhar Uyirththu Vaanameri Ekuvaar
  Meetpar Maanpaik Kantu Aaravaarippen.
  Visuvaasikal Ellaarum Vinnil Kooti Vaazhuvaar.
  Andha Naalil Naanum Koota Vaazhven.
  
3. Yesunaadharin Peranpai Engum Koorumpatikke
  Sorvillaamal Velai Seydhu Jeevippen. 
  Pinpu, Thaasar Ondru Kooti Theva Sannidhiyile,
  Nirkum Podhu Naanum Kootave Nirpen.
title: Thivyakkaalach chaththam ketka

song:
1. Aantavaa Ivvulaka Velli Pon Madhiyen,
  Mel Veetu Enakkuntu, Naan Um Mandhai Serndhen,
  Um Jeeva Puththakaththil En Meetpaa Sollume
  Meentor Naamak Kanakkil En Per Thaakkalaachcho?
  
  En Per Thaakkalaachcho? Yesin Raththam Konte!
  Jeeva Puththakaththile, En Per Thaakkalaachcho?

2. Aantavaa, En Paavamo, Mika Eraalame;
  Aanaal Meetpaa Um Raththam Ezhaikkup Podhume,
  Um Vaakku Enakkuntu; Maaraadha Unmaiye,
  Sivappaana En Paavam Pani Venmaiyaame.

3. O, Singaara Nakaram Vaasasdhalam Minnum
  Thanguvor Suththarkalaam Utai Thooya Venmaiye
  Ange Theemai Anuki Thooimaiye Ketaadhu.
  Vin Thoodharkalin Ettil En Per Thaakkalaachcho?
title: Aantavaa ivvulaka velli

song:
1. Aantavar Varum Neram Naalum Ariyom
  Kaalam Sameepam, Ataiyaalam Kaankirom
  Meentum Vaaraar Paar, Uraikkum Vaakkuththaththam
  Kaalam Naam Ariyom.

  Varuvaar .... Kaaththe Naam Thayaaraavom
  Varuvaar .... Allelooyaa! Allelooyaa!
  Mekaththil Varuvaar Pidhaa Makimaiyotu
  Neram Naam Ariyom.

2. Ratchippu Thetum, Gnaani Kaanum Oliyum
  Karththar Pesina Aakama Saththiyamum
  Theerkkaruraikal Ellaam Meentum Vaaraare
  Kaalam Naam Ariyom.
  
3. Theepangal Thoonti, Jepam Vizhiththe Seyvom
  Narpaniyaatri, Paati Akamakizhvom
  Aantavar Vaaraar Jeevamuththoodhu Solvom 
  Kaalam Naam Ariyom.
title: Aantavar varum neram naalum

song:
1. Janaththaarellaaritamum Sendru Parai Saatruvom
  Nam Yesu Raajan Varum Pozhudhu Pozhudhu Vitiyum.
  
  Aattukkuttiyaanavarai Naam Vaazhththituvome
  Yesuvin Varukaiyin Seydhi Kooruvom.

2. Raajyangalin Thaththalippin Seydhi Echcharikkudhe
  Vaanaththin Ataiyaalangal Yaavum Arivikkindradhe.

3. Thevanin Pillaikal Naamellorum Potrith Thudhippom
  Paakkiyavaankal Supavai Naalin Jodhiyai Nokkuvaar.
title: Janaththaarellaaritamum sendru

song:
1. Immaanuvele Vaarum, Vaarume.
  Mey Isravelaich Chirai Meelume;
  Maa Theyva Maindhan Thondrum Varaikkum
  Un Janam Paaril Engith Thavikkum.	
  
  Makizh! Makizh! Seeyonin Sapaiye,
  Immaanuvelin Naal Sameepame.

2. Eesaayin Verth Thulire Vaarume
  Pisaasin Valla Koshtam Neekkume
  Paadhaala Aazham Nin Iratchiyum
  Vem Saavin Mel Per Vetri Aliyum.
  
3. Arunodhayame, Aa, Vaarume.
  Vandhengal Nenjai Aatrith Thetrume
  Mandhaara Raavin Mekam Neekkitum,
  Irunta Saavin Nizhal Ottitum.
  
4. Thaaveedhin Thiravu Kole, Vaarume,
  Vin Vaasalaith Thirandhu Thaarume;
  Otukkamaam Nalvazhi Kaaththitum,
  Visaalamaam Thurppaadhai Thoorththitum.

5. Maa Valla Aantavaa, Vandharulum;
  Murkaalam Seenaai Malai Meedhilum
  Ekkaalam Minnalotu Thevareer
  Piramaanam Isravelukkaliththeer.
title: Immaanuvele vaarum, vaarume

song:
1. Um Raajyam Thevane, Varachcheydharulum,
  Vempaavam Neengave Sengolai Ochchitum.

2. Virodham Oyave, Vinnirpol Mannilum
  Thooimaiyum Anpume Eppodhu Sezhikkum?

3. Um Vaakkuk Ketradhaai Van Pasai Por Nindre
  Aneedhi Mutrumaai Ozhiyum Naal Endro:

4. Karththaave Ezhumpum, Vaarum Um Vanmaiyaal;
  Neer Varath Thaviththom; Thetrum Um Kaatchiyaal.

5. Um Thooya Naamaththai Theeyor Pazhikkindraar;
  Anpatru Theemaiyai Vetkaamal Seykindraar.

6. Aneka Thesaththai Agngnaanam Mootitre;
  Veesum Vin Jodhiyai Maa Vitivelliye!
title: Um raajyam thevane

song:
Meka Madheel Thoodharotidho, Idho!
Mesaiyaa Kiris Thesaiyaavenadhaasai Nesaiyaa
Vaaraar, Vaaraar, Makizh Kempeeramaai.

1. Thekaththotu Ponavar Ivar, Ivar
  Thirumpavum Padhinaayiram Parisuththar Soozhndhita
  Seekram, Seekram, Jekaththai Nokkiye 			- Meka

2. Oliva Malai Vittekinaar, Appo, Appo
  Uruvaththotavar Thirumpudhai Naam Utru Nokkuvom
  Kooti, Paati Vandhu Potruvom 			      	- Meka

3. Aaravaaram Ketkudhe, Adho, Adho!
  Aattuk Kuttiyin Paattaikketka Adhirndhu Nirkudhe,
  Allelooyaa! Arumai Ratchakaa	     		     	 - Meka

4. Manuvel Raajan Varukiraar, Idho, Idho!
  Malai Natungita, Puvi Adhirndhitak, Katal Kalangita
  Vaanor Poovor Vanangi Nirkave.                  			- Meka
title: Meka madheel thoodharotidho

song:
Meka Meedhil Iyesu Raajan, Vekam Vaaraare!

Aayaththam Mulloraip Paralokanj Cherkka
Avare Vaaraare   						- Meka

1. Aantavar Thaame Aarpparippote
  Avaniyil Vaaraare!
  Meentavaro, Melokame Sella
  Medhiniyai Vituvaar,					- Meka

2. Kirisdhuvukkulle Mariththo Rellaam,
  Kilampiye Ezhumpituvaar
  Marikkaadhirukkum Parisuththarellaam
  Maru Roopamaavaare. 								- Meka

3. Paatupattorkkup Palanalippaare;
  Paatupattavar Thaame,
  Kootum Namakko Kuraivillaap Palanaiye
  Kooviye Kotuththituvaar.					 - Meka

4. Avaruraiththa Ataiyaalanga Lellaam,
  Thavaraamal Natakkindradhe,
  Aayiramaayiram Avaradhu Vasanangal
  Adhai Arivikkindradhe.					- Meka

5. Aayira Varusha Aalukai Seyvaar
  Aantavar Iyesu Thaame!
  Needhi Samaadhaanam Niraindheyirukkum
  Jodhiyin Aalukaiyil.						- Meka

6. Allelooyaa Keedhame Paati, 					
  Aka Makizhndhaatituvom;
  Vallavar Varum Velaiyu Midho,
  Mellave Nerungitre. 						- Meka
title: Meka meedhil iyesu raajan
Enadhu karththarin raajareeka naal

song:
Vaiyakan Thannai Natuth Theerkka Iyesu
Vallavar Varukiraar Thiru Maraik Kerka.

Poi Yulakorkalin Kankalum Paarkkap
Por Padhi Thanir Paran Seyaraich Cherkka. 	 	- Vaiyaka

1. Vaanangal Matamatap Po Tozhindhitave,
  Makidhalam Adhirchchiyaaith Thaanatung Kitave,
  Paanuvum Madhiyutu Anaiththu Mangitave,
  Panja Poodhangalun Thaanazhindhitave. 			- Vaiyaka

2. Mukkiya Thoodhenak Kaalame Thonikka,
  Mun Mariththo Rellaan Thaa Mezhundhirukka,
  Akkana Muyirullor Maru Uruth Tharikka, 
  Aantavar Varukiraar, Pakdharkal Kalikka              		 - Vaiyaka

3. Yaavarin Sindhai Seykaiyum Velip Patarku,
  Irantu Puththakangalun Thirandhava Ravarkku,
  Poovula Kinilavar Natandhu Vandha Tharku,
  Punniya Nalavutan Palanalippadharku.              		- Vaiyaka

4. Ataikkalan Yesuvai Yarindhavar Naamam,
  Azhindhitaadhavarkalin Vaazhvadhu Seshamam,
  Pataiththitu Vaayindhak Kanamunai, Sashaamam 
  Patritak Kootume Thitukkenave; Nam                 		- Vaiyaka
title: Vaiyakan thannai natuth theerkka

song:
Mesiyaa Yesu Raajan Meka Meedhil Varuvaar;
Medhiniyaip Pataiththavar - Aa, Aa,

Andharath Thorkal Kooti - Aanandha Keedham Paati
Annal Yesu Varuvaar; 
Anandhang Kotith Thoodhar Soozha Varuvaar - Aa Aa		- Mesi

1. Antam Natungita - Immantalandhaan Kulunga
  Paavikal Thammaith Tholaikka 
  Parisuththavaan Seyaraith Thammitam Azhaikka - Aa, Aa	- Mesi

2. Aadhi Andhamillaadhon - Anpark Kirakkamullon
  Aadharai Meedhil Vandhavar
  Atiyaarukkaai Paatu Mika Ataindhavar - Aa, Aa,	          		- Mesi

3. Ekkaalath Thoniyutan, Eka Muzhakkaththutan
  Ennesu Naadhar Varuvaar;
  Avarin Makkalellorum Kalikooruvar. - Aa, Aa,         		- Mesi

4. Santaalaththai Vituththu - Sandhoshamaayirukka
  Saadhanai Seyyach Cholludhe;
  Thiru Vasananj Chanmaarkkam Sella Villudhe- Aa, Aa,    		- Mesi
title: Mesiyaa yesu raajan mekameedhil

song:
Kaalam Nerungi Vittadhe - Namadhu Yesu
Karththar Varach Chamayame: - Sakodharare,
Kaalam Nerungivittadhe.

 Thevaadhi Thevan Munne Seppiya Mozhippati
 Kallanaip Pol Varuvaar Karuththaai Iruppom Naamum.        	- Kaalam

1. Ataiyaalam Solli Vaiththaare,
  Adhile Ippo Anandham Mutivumaachchudhe,
  Avar Solpati Ataiyaalam Solli Vaiththaare,
  Mesiyaa Yesuraajan Mekameedhil Varuvaar;
  Thaavi Avaril Sellath Thayaaraai Irukkavenum.      		- Kaalam

2. Paavaththai Vittakaluvom; Namadhullaththil
  Parisuththam Thangach Cheyvom; Indre, Indre
  Paavaththai Vittakaluvom;
  Mevi Yesuvitaththil Thaavi Otiye Sendru 
  Suththan Kirisdhuvotu Sukamaa Yirukkalaame,            		- Kaalam

3. Kataisith Thoodhaai Varukudhe, Thiru Vasanadh
  Thuraiyai Vilakkich Cholludhe, Meendha Sapai
  Kataisith Thoodhaai Varukudhe,
  Saththiya Maarkka Midhil Saldhiyil Sendru Naamam
  Suththikarippataindhu Sukamaayirukka Vaarum.                	- Kaalam
title: Kaalam nerungi vittadhe

song:
1. Meloka Raajan Varung Kaala Maakudhu;
  Paraloka Makimai Peralaam Paavi Oti Vaa

2. Paavaththai Veru, Pasaasai Yottitu - Pari 
  Suththam Needhi, Anpu, Thaazhmai Angiyaaip Potu

3. Iravu Poyitru, Pakal Sameepamaayitru
  Irulin Seykai Thalli Oliyin Kavasam Tharippom

4. Kutiveri Ventaam, Kol Kuntuni Ventaam
  Pakalin Pillaikal Pol Seeraai Natakkak Katavom

5. Paarkkak Kootaadha Parisuththa Jodhiyaai,
  Paraloka Raajan Veetriruppaar Thoodhar Soozha

6. Parisuththaraik Kaana Veku Suththam Ventume.
  Yesuve Um Raththaththaale Suththamaakkuvom.
title: Meloka raajan varung kaalamaakudhu

song:
Aayaththamaa, Idho Aayaththamaa?
Karththar Varukiraar Aayaththamaa?

Naturaaththiriyin Saththam Nam Kaadhinil
Thonikkavillaiyo? Thaamadha Men Pinnum        	 -Aayadh

1. Kaala Midhu Kataik Kaala Midhu;
  Karththar Varukaikkuk Kaalamidhu;
  Ataiyaalam Idho, Anandham Kaanudhu,
  Kaalam Sameepiththa Thendrarindha Podhu.             - Aayadh

2. Kaalam Idhil Manavaalan Karththar
  Ninaiyaadha Neram Vandhituvaar.
  Mariththa Visuvaasikal Ezhumpuvaar;
  Jeevanullorum Maru Roopa Maakuvaar.                       - Aayadh

3. Mekangal Mel Sendru Aakaayaththil
  Sandhippom Karththarai Mukamukamaai;
  Palanalippaare Yesu Makaaraajaa
  Sareeraththil Seydha Seykaikkuth Thakkadhaai          - Aayadh

4. Raajareekam Petru Makimaiyaai
  Raajaa Ezhundharul Vaar Vaanaththil;
  Yesu Raajaavutan Singaasanaththil Naam
  Aaluvom Paraththil Aayiram Varusham.                	       - Aayadh

5. Niyaayath Theerppirukkum Mutivinil
  Vellai Singaasana Niyaayath Theerppu,
  Maarip Pokume, Ivvaanamum Poomiyum,
  Thondrume, Pudhiya Vaanamum Poomiyum.                 - Aayadh
title: Aayaththamaa, idho aayaththamaa?

song:
1. Iyesu Raajaa Varuvaar, Thoodharotum Varuvaar,
  Pakdharai Motchaththil Serththitave Naan
  Jodhiyaai Avar Mukam Kantituven - Pinnum
  Jeya Kampeerang Kontullam Pongitume             		- Iyesu

2. Manavaalanotu Manavaattiyaam Sapai,
  Mangalamaaik Kavi Saatritume - Appo
  Maatchimaiyotu Naam Paatituvom Avar
  Nesaththin Aazhaththai Rusiththituvom                       	- Iyesu

3. Muththiraiyitta Suththarkal Vellai Angi Thariththu
  Karththar Samookaththil Nindrituvaar - Adhil
  Serndhituven Naanum Paatituven - Andru
  Porkireetame Thariththaatituven                               		- Iyesu

4. Kaadhaliththen Naan, Kaasiniyil Inpam Vittu
  Karththa Rotendru Muravaative - Angu
  Kanaka Manavarai Joliththitume - Appo
  Karththaraam Iyesuvil Sukippome                            		- Iyesu

5. Vaanaththil Ekkaalam Thoniththitum Samayaththil
  Suththarkal Yaavarum Parandhituvaar - Appo
  Aththanin Kaliyaana Virundhadhile - Naamum
  Niththamum Avarotu Aarpparippom                      		- Iyesu
title: Iyesu raajaa varuvaar, thoodharotum varuvaar

song:
Un Thevanaich Chandhikka Nee Aayaththamaa?

1. Poomiyil Yesu Varumpodhu Pollaar Otituvaar;
  Indha Vidham Nee Irundhaal, Enna Seydhituvaai?         		- Un

2. Mekangalutan Varuve Nendru Sonnavar
  Ippo Mekan Thanil Varum Neram Kittich Cherudhe     		 - Un

3. Theva Thoodharotum, Perum Ekkaalaththotum 
  Tham Pakdharaich Chandhikkum Neram Kittichcherudhe            - Un

4. Ava Pakdhar Akkaalaththil Azhudhituvaar;
  Avar Varumpodhu Ratchippataiyamaattaar                    		- Un

5. Paavangalil Jeevippavar Padhungituvaar;
  Parisuththa Maakkappattor Parandhituvaar.                       		- Un

6. Irakkamulla Indha Naalil Manandhirumpu;
  Innimisham  Etruk Kontu Mannippu Peru            			- Un

7. Unakkaai Mariththa Yesu Kaaththu Nirkiraar;
  Yesu Unnaip Patchamaaka Etruk Kolluvaar           			- Un

8. Paranai Etruk Kollaadhor Andha Naalile
  Padhungi Nidhyamaakap Paridhapippaar.                                	 - Un
title: Un thevanai sandhikka nee

song:
Makimaiyulla Maa Yesu Raajan
Vaana Thoodha Senaikalotu
Seekkiram Vaaraar - Aanandhamaame,

1. Poomiyum Adhisayikka, Vaanorkal Aarpparikka,
  Thoodharoliyutan Mekamadhil Vaaraar,
  Ezhaikal Naam Yesuvaich Chandhippom
  Aa! Aa! Aa! Aa! Aanandhamaame 				 - Makimai

2. Ekkaalam Thaan Thonikka Vaanjaikal Yaavum Theera,
  Nanparin Pakkaththil Yaavarum Kootiye,
  Aanandham Paati Naam Yesuvaip Potrita,
  Aa! Aa! Aa! Aa! Aanandhamaame 				 - Makimai

3. Poomiyin Jaadhikalum, Thesaththin Iraajaakkalum
  Manuvel Raajanaal Niyaayath Theerppataiya
  Anpaarndha Naangal Yesuvutan Nirpom;
  Aa! Aa! Aa! Aa! Aanandhamaame 			       	- Makimai

4. Aayira Maantukalum Vaanaththin Aatchikalum,
  Mutrumaaith Theerndhapin Pudhupoomiyil Naangal
  Niththiyam Jeeviththu Endrum Sukiththita
  Aa! Aa! Aa! Aa! Aanandhamaame			      	- Makimai
title: Makimaiyulla maa yesu raajan

song:
Endran Poomaanaik Kaanach Chindhai Perukudhaiyo!
    Endraikkuk Kaanpeno? O! O!

1. Sundharaththil Mikundhu Andharangaththilirukkum
  Endran Poomaanaik Kaana - Azhakutaiya
  Anna Lesuvaik Kaana                                  		- Endran

2. Vinni Virundhavar, Mannil Mel Vandhavar,
  Kanniyitam Pirandhavar - Laasarukkaakak
  Kanneerai Vittazhudhavar                                    	- Endran

3. Innum Vara Enna Thaamadham Sellumo?
  Sonna Vaakkai Ninaiththu - Atiyen Undran
  Paadham Panindhu Vandhen.                                    	- Endran

4. Pollaadhorai Iratchikka Vallapa Raajan
  Enna Thuyarataindhaar? Adhai Ninaiththaal
  Solla Mutiyudhillai                                        		- Endran

5. Paadhakarin Ati Kannaththil Patum Velai,
  Ennai Ninaiththeere Neer, - Adhai Ninaiththaal
  Ummai Marappeno Naan?                                		- Endran
title: Endhan poomaanaik kaanach

song:
Seeyone! Nee Ezhumpip Pirakaasi
Saalem Raajan Idho Varukiraare.

Mekangalutane Kan Yaavum Kaana
Makimaikkul Unnai Avar Vandhu Serppaar 	  		- Seeyone

1. Pakar Kaalanga Lellaam Anain Thanaindhu Poi
  Iraak Kaalangal Thaan Atuth Thatuththe,
  Satu Thiyaai Poovinil Vandhu Kontirukka,
  Jaadhikal Yaavum Thaththalikkudhe				- Seeyone

2. Senaip Palaththaal Raajyangal Aayinum
  Thinan Thinamaakath Thakarndhitudhe 
  Senai Sakdhiyil Ondrume Illai,
  Aaviyin Palaththaal Jeyang Kollavenum 				- Seeyone

3. Mutivu Kaalaththin Mutivu Varumun
  Muththoodhu Engum Muzhanganume;
  Pinmaari Petru Pirayaasang Kontu,
  Pirapukkalaiyum Pitiththizhukkanum. 				- Seeyone

4. Thiruch Chapaiye! Un Theepangal Ellaam,
  Soorya Prakaasam Pol Ilangitattum;
  Makimaiyaai Vaanaththil Ezhumpi Varukaiyil,
  Manavaalanotu Naam Maruroopamaavom. 			- Seeyone
title: Seeyone! Nee ezhumpip pirakaasi

song:
Muththoodhu Ulakengum Muzhangitudhe
Muththirai Tharikkappata Aayaththamaa Nee

Ini Kaalanj Chellaadhe Iyesu Varuvaar
Inimelum Kaalaththai Nee Veenaakkitaadhe. 		- Muththoodhu

1. Niyaayaththeerppu Kotukkum Velai Vandhadhu
  Niyaayasangangal Anaiththum Utkaarndhadhu - Thevan
  Neenta Aayusullavar Singaasanaththil Utkaarndhaar,
  Needhi Paran Yesuvum Avarutan Vandhaar		- Muththoodhu

2. Pataiththavatrai Vananguvadhai Ozhiththu Vittu
  Pataiththavarai Vananguvadhai Indre Nee Sey - Thevan
  Thevanukkup Payandhu Makimaippatuththitu
  Theva Raajyam Sella Indre Aayaththamaaku, 		- Muththoodhu

3. Paapilon Makaanakaram Vizhundhu Vittadhu
  Paavaththin Uchcha Nilaiyai Ataindhu Vittadhu - Andha
  Maayaiyaana Podhakaththin Madhuvaik Kutikka Vaiththu
  Maandhar Anaivaraiyum Mayakki Vittaale. 		- Muththoodhu

4. Mirukaththin Soroopaththai Vanangupavarkkum
  Mirukaththin Muththiraiyaith Tharippavarkkum - Kalla
  Aattukkuttiyaanavar Mun Akkini Kandhakaththutan
  Avarutaiya Kopamadhu Kaaththirukkudhe		- Muththoodhu

5. Iyesuvin Visuvaasaththai Ataindhavarum
  Iyesuvaip Patrina Saatchi Utaiyavarum - Endran
  Paththu Karpanaikalukkuk Keezhpatindhu Natapporum
  Ilatchaththu Naarpaththu Naalaayiram Per.		- Muththoodhu
title: Muththoodhu ulakengum muzhangitudhe

song:
1. Melokaththai Naatukirom, Adhanjodhi Prakaasaththaiyum
  Perinpaththai Varnikkirom; Paarththaal Ennamaayirukkum!
  Pon Veedhiyin Maatchiyaiyum Adhan Vachrakkal Madhilaiyum
  Maa Menmaiyaai Varnikkirom; 
  Serndhaal Ennamaayirukkum!

2. Eppaavamum Illaamar Pom Kanneer Sanjalam Sodhanaiyum
  Vetri Sirandhu Oindhiruppom; Serndhaal Ennamaayirukkum!
  Ange Yesuvaiyech Chevippom.
  Ven Vasdhirandhaan Tharippom, Vaanor Sangam Serndhituvom,
  Serndhaal Ennamaa Yirukkum!

3. Azhiyaamaiyai Ataindhu Avar Saayalaiyum Anindhu
   Maa Seekkiram Poi Naangalum Serndhaal Ennamaa Yirukkum!
   Karththaave, Em Yaavaraiyum Motcha Paaththira Raakkitume;
   Em Anparum Emmutane
   Serndhaal Ennamaa Yirukkum!
title: Melokaththai naatukirom

song:
1. Jeeva Nadhiyantai Povom Singaasanath Thoorume;
  Theva Thoodhar Nirpar, Servom Thiru Nadhi Orame.

  Jeeva Nadhiyantai Servom
  Nerththiyaame Thivya Nerththiyaame,
  Paavamatra Thooyaraik Kaanpom, Theva Sannidhiyile.

2. Andha Nadhiyin Alaikal, Modhi Veesung Karaiyil;
  Ennaalum Ulaavi Naangal, Panivom Sandhoshaththil.
  
3. Kaandhiyaana Nadhi Pomun Paaram Yaavum Vittu Oivom
  Aantavar Kirupaiyaale Kreetam Vennangi Eevaar.

4. Ratchakarin Saayal Paarppom, Jeevanadhi Neerinil;
  Keedham Paatuvadhaik Ketpom, Kalippom Nam Ratchippil.
title: Jeeva nadhiyantai povom

song:
1. Meloka Inpa Naattil Nidhya Veetunte;
  Saavillaa Avveettil Oyaadha Vaazhvunte.
  Thooya Angi Thariththu, Thoodhar Saashtaangam Seyvaar.
  Jodhi Veesum Avveettai Endru Paarth Thaanandhippen?

  Aa! Aanandhamaam Perinpam Untaam,
  Nal Meetparin Veettil, Perinpam Untaam.

2. Ilangum Andha Veettil Paalar Paatuvaar;
  Theva Aasanaththil Meetpar Veetraaluvaar:
  Paalar Keedhangal Paati Oivindri Aarpparippaar;
  Jodhi Veesum Avveettai Endru Paarth Thaanandhippen?

3. Seekkiram Motcha Nakar Yaavarum Seruvaar.
  Yesu Endran Meetpar Saavil Naan Anjiten
  Thooya Nesaraik Kaanpen Thangach Chimmaasanaththil;
  Jodhi Veesum Avveettai Endrum Paarth Thaanandhippen.
title: Meloka inpa naattil nidhya

song:

  Idhe En Saatchi En Keedhame,
  Meetparaip Potral Ekkaalame.

2. Poorana Paakkiyam Thaazhmaiyum
  Enakkuntu, Uyar Kaatchiyum,
  Vin Thoodhar Vaanin Riranginaar;
  Anpin Edhiroli Thoniththaar.

3. Maa Thaazhmai Amaidhi Engume;
  Meetparil Aanandham Peruven
  Kaaththirukkiren, Mel Nokkiye
  Avar Anpu Thayai Niraindhe.
title: Nichchayam esu en sondhame

song:
1. Siraiyin Kashtam Kasappilum Nindru Vandhen! Neengi Vandhen!
  Muzhu Svaadheenam Ataiyavum Yesuve! Vandhanan!
  Piniyinindru Sukaththukkaai;
  Varumai Neengach Chelvaththukkaai,
  Paavaththai Vittu Aaththiramaai, Yesuve Vandhanan.

2. Izhivu Nashtam Thavarilum Nindru Vandhen! Neengi Vandhen!
  Ratchippin Laapam Ataiyavum Yesuve! Vandhanan,
  Thunpaththai Vittu Inpaththukkaai,
  Thollaiyai Vittuch Chaandhaththukkaai,
  Ikazhchchi Nindru Makizhchchikkaai, Yesuve Vandhanan!.

3. Marulukindra Sdhidhiyilum Nindru Vandhen! Neengi Vandhen!
  Thevanin Siththam Ariyavum Yesuve! Vandhanan.
  Aapaththinindru Sampaththaiyum,
  Thaazhvinai Vittu Vaazhvinaiyum,
  Kantataiven Inneraththilum, Yesuve! Vandhanan.

4. Maranak Keti Payaththilum Nindru Vandhen! Neengi Vandhen!
  Nesarin Veettil Makizhavum Yesuve! Vandhanan.
  Naasaththai Vittu Jeevanukkaai,
  Mosaththinindru Paakkiyaththukkaai
  Thiruch Chamookath Thinpaththukkaai Yesuve! Vandhanan.
title: Siraiyin kashtam kasappilum

song:
1. Thikkatra Paavi Naan, Seer Ketta Neesane,
  Sondha Kiriyai Kandhai Thaan, Endran Kadhi Yesuve.
  
  Katanillaiyaam Theerndhu Poyitre!
  Yesuvaal En Theedhellaam Nivirththiyaayitru.

2. En Nesa Ratchakaa! Um Thiru Raththame
  Theemai, Karai, Maasellaam Neengi Vitach Cheyyume.

3. En Kunam Theeyadhe; Endraalum Thevareer
  Maasillaadha Raththaththaal Suththa Supaavam Alippeer.
title: Thikkatra paavi naan
Theva thaasare ezhundhu potritungal

song:
1. O! Yesuve, En Meetpar , Inpa Keedham Neere;
  Thukkam Ennaich Choozhkaiyil, En Ratchakar Neere.
  
  O! Yesuve, En Meetpar, Ummaiye Potruven,
  Neere En Maaraa Nanpar, En Anpin Thozhar Neer.

2. Kashtamaana Kaalaththil Neere En Aarudhal;
  Kanneer Sindhi Nirkaiyil Neere En Nampikkai.

3. Ratchakarai Nampuven; En Nal Vazhikaatti,
  En Paasam Avaril Thaan Ulakam Yaavilum.

4. Ip Paava Ulakil En Aadhma Sandhosham Neer,
  Paraloka Veettilum En Makizhchchi Neere.
title: O! Yesuve, en meetpar
Ummaale andri ratchakaa
Meetpar mariththa kurusantai

song:
1. Undran Settai Nizhalil Ilaippaaralaam!
  Endhap Paatum, Thunpam, Theengum,
  Satrum Anukaamal Neengum,
  Undran Settai Nizhalil Ilaippaaralaam! (2)
  
  Thanguven, Thanguven, Thanguven.
  Undran Settai Nizhalil.
  Sukippen, Sukippen, Sukippen
  Undran Settai Nizhalil.

2. Undran Settai Nizhalil, Samaadhaanamaam!
  Nenjin Novu Mutrum Aarum;
  Thunpam Inpamaaka Maarum;
  Undran Settai Nizhalil, Samaadhaanamaam! (2)

3. Undran Settai Nizhalil, Peraanandhamaam!
  Potruven Sandhoshamaaka;
  Paatuven Kempeeramaaka;
  Undran Settai Nizhalil, Peraanandhamaam! (2)
title: Undhan settai nizhalil

song:
1. Naan Pramiththu Nindru Peranpin
  Praavaakaththai Nokkip Paarththen.
  En Ullaththil Meych Chamaadhaanam
  Sampooranamaai Ataindhen
 
  Maa Thooya Udhiraththaal En Paavam Neengak Kanten.
  Yesaiyarin Ratchippinaal Naan Aarudhal Kantataindhen.

2. Munnaalil Ivvaarudhal Kaana
  Oyaamal Prayaasappatten.
  Veenmuyarsi Neengina Podho,
  En Meetparaal Arul Petren.

3. Tham Karaththai En Meedhil Vaiththu
  Nee Sosdhamaavaai Endranar
  Naan Avar Tham Vasdhiram Thota
  Aarokkiyam Arulinaar

4. Enneramum Punniya Naadhar
  En Pakkaththil Vilanguvaar;
  Tham Mukaththil Arut Prakaasam
  En Perile Veesach Cheyvaar.
title: Naan pramiththu nindru peranpin
En paavan theerndha naalaiye

song:
1. En Aanmaavil Prakaasam Untu Mika Maatchiyotu
  Pooloka Maatchi Kaattilum Yesuve En Oli.

  Aasirvaadhamaana Oli Samaadhaanam Varum Pozhudhu
  Aanmaavil Olikkadhir Veesum Yesuvin Pun Nakaippil.

2. En Aanmaavil Paadalkal Untu En Raajaavukkaaka
  Paataadha Paadalkalellaam Ketka Vallalare.

3. En Aanmaavil Vasandham Untu Karththar Antum Podhu
  Avar Paadal En Idhayaththai Malarach Cheykudhe.

4. En Aanmaavil Makizhchchiyuntu Anpum Nampikkaiyum
  Aaseervaadham Avar Eekiraar Melulakin Paakyam.
title: En aanmaavil prakaasam

song:
1. Meych Chamaadhaanamaa Thur Ulakil?
  Aam, Iyesu Raththam Paayum Nenjinil

2. Meych Chamaadhaanamaa Pal Thollaiyil?
  Aam, Iyesu Siththaththai Naam Seykaiyil.

3. Meych Chamaadhaanamaa Soozh Thukkaththil?
  Aam, Iyesu Seer Amarndha Nenjaththil

4. Meych Chamaadhaanamaa Utraar Neengil?
  Aam, Iyesu Karam Nammaik Kaakkaiyil

5. Meych Chamaadhaanamaa Sitrarivil?
  Aam, Iyesu Raajan Arukil

6. Meych Chamaadhaanamaa Saa Nizhalil?
  Aam, Iyesu Saavai Vendrirukkaiyil

7. Poolokath Thunpam Ozhindha Pinnar,
  Iyesu Meych Chamaadhaanam Arulvaar.
title: Meych chamaadhaanamaa thur ulakil?
Visuvaasin kaadhil pata

song:
Enna En Aanandham Enna En Aanandham
   Sollak Kootaadhe
   Mannan Kirisdhu En Paavaththai Ellaam
   Manniththu Vittaare.

1. Kootuvom, Aatuvom, Paatuvom Nandraai
  Makizh Kontaatuvom. Naatiye Nammaith Thetiye Vandha
  Naadhanaip Potrituvom. 				- Enna

2. Paavangal, Saapangal, Kopangal Ellaam
  Parikariththaare; Thevaadhi Thevan En Ullaththil Vandhu
  Thetriye Vittaare. 					- Enna

3. Atchayan Patchamaai Iratchippai Engaluk
  Karulina Thaale; Nichchayam Suvaamiyaip Patriya Saatchi
  Pakara Ventiyadhe.					- Enna

4. Vennangi, Ponmuti, Vaaththiyam Mel Veettil
  Jeyak Kotiyutane; Mannulakil Vandhu Vinnulakir Sendra
  Mannanaith Thoththarippom. 			- Enna
title: Enna en aanandham! Enna

song:
Then Inimaiyilum Yesuvin Naamam
  Thivya Madhuramaame; Adhaidh
  Thetiye Naati Otiye Varuvaai; Thinamum Nee Maname.

1. Kaasinidhanile Nesamadhaakak Kashtaththai Uththariththe
  Paavak Kasatadhai Aruththuch Chaapaththaith Tholaiththaar;
  Kantunar Nee Maname 						- Then

2. Paaviyai Meetkath Thaaviye Uyiraith Thaame Eendhavaraam,
  Pinnum Nemiyaam Karunai Nilavaramuntu;
  Nidham Thudhi En Maname						- Then

3. Kaalaiyil Panippol Maayamaai Ulakam Upaayamaai Neengivitum
  Endrum Karththarin Paadham Nichchayam Nampu,
  Karuththaai Nee Maname 						- Then

4. Thunpaththil Inpam Thollaiyil Nalla Thunaivaraam Nesaritam
  Nee Anpadhaaich Cherndhaal Anaiththunnaik Kaappaar;
  Aasai Kol Nee Maname 						- Then

5. Poolokaththaarum Melokath Thaarum Pukazhndhu Potrum Naamam
  Adhaip Pitiththuk Kontaal Thaan 
  Perinpa Vaazhvaip Peruvaai Nee Maname 				- Then
title: Then inimaiyilum yesuvin

song:
Ellaam Yesuve, - Enak Kellaam Mesuve
 
 Thollai Miku Mivvulakil 						- Ellaa

1. Aayanum Sakaayanum Neyanum Mupaayanum
  Naayanu Menak Kanpaana Gnaana Manavaalanum,		- Ellaa

2. Thandhai Thaayinam Janam Pandhullor Sinekidhar,
  Sandhota Sakalayoka Sampoorana Paakyamum, 			- Ellaa

3. Kavalaiyi Laarudhalum Kangulilen Jodhiyum,
  Kashta Noip Patukkaiyile Kaikanta Olashadhamum, 		- Ellaa

4. Podhakap Pidhaavu Men Pokkinil Varaththinil
  Aadharavu Seydhitung Koottaaliyu Men Thozhanum, 		- Ellaa

5. Aniyu Maaparanamum Aasdhiyum Sampaadhyamum
  Pinaiyaaliyum Meetparu Men Piriyamaththiyasdhanum,		- Ellaa

6. Aana Jeevaappamum Aavalu Men Kaavalum
  Gnaana Keedhamum Sadhurum Naattamum Kontaattamum,	 - Ellaa
title: Ellaam yesuve enakkellaam

song:
Eppodhume Inpa Vaazhve!
Yesaiyar Ennotiruppadhaale,

1. Epporulum Kuppai Pondranave - Maandhar
  Evarum Or Naalil Thoosidhaane;
  Ennarumai Nesar Yesu Naadhar - Enak
  Kellaam Avar Pinne Edhu Kurai?

2. Maadhaa Pidhaa Utraar Maantittaalum Pinnum
  Matrulla Ishtar Maraindhittaalum,
  Mannan Kiris Thesu Mangaa Nesar - Enak
  Kenna Kurai Enak Kedhu Peetai?

3. Kaavarkaarar Yesu Kannurangaar - En Mel
  Aaval Mikundhor Anpu Mikundhor;
  Pattayaththaal Pakkaththaayiram Saayinum
  Payandhiten Satru Mayarndhiten.

4. Thangu Mitam Saththirame - Vinnin
  Thanga Veettin Vaazhvu Niththiyame
  Mangaa Vaazhvu Enak Kange Yuntu Pinne
  Inge Edhai Endran Pangennuven?

5. Eththanaiyaai Maandhar Thooshiththaalum - Pinnum
  Ikazhn Then Peraik Ketuththittaalum,
  Edhum Sollen Naavezhumpa Viten - Kiris
  Thesaiyar Polavark Kirangituven.

6. Enna Nashtam Thollai Thunpam Vandhum Saaththaan
  Eka Pataiyaai Enaich Choozhndhaalum,
  Enna Payam Adhaal Edhapaayam - Enak
  Kesu Thunai Senaa Veeraravar.

7. Nirpen En Nesar Karam Pitippen - Saaththaan
  Nirkaadhota Marai Vaal Pitippen;
  Virpitippen Jeya Vetri Kolven - Senaa
  Veerar Palaththaale Theeranaaven.
title: Eppodhume inpa vaazhve

song:
1. Thivya Anpin Saththaththai Ratchakaa!
  Kettu Ummai Antinen.
  Innum Kittich Chera, En Aantavaa!
  Aaval Kontidho Vandhen.

  Innum Kittach Cherththuk Kollume,
  Paatupatta Naayakaa!
  Innum Kittakittach Cherththuk Kollume,
  Jeevan Thandha Ratchakaa!

2. Ennai Mutrume Indha Neraththil
  Sondhamaakkik Kollume;
  Ummai Vaanjaiyo Tendhan Ullaththil
  Naatith Thetach Cheyyume.

3. Thiruppaadhaththil Thangum Podhellaam
  Peraanandham Kaankiren.
  Ummai Nokki Ventudhal Seykaiyil
  Meych Chandhoshamaakiren.

4. Innum Kantiraadha Perinpaththai
  Vinnil Petru Vaazhuven.
  Thivya Anpin Aazhazhum Neelamum
  Ange Kantaanandhippen.
title: Thivya anpin saththaththai

song:
1. En Nenjai, Svaami Umakke
  Eevaaip Pataikkiren:
  Neer Indhak Kaanikkaiyaiye
  Ketteerendrariven.

2. En Makane, Un Nenjaith Thaa,
  Nee Ikkatanaith Theer,
  Verengum Nee Sukappata
  Maattaaye Enkindreer.

3. Thevaa, Neer Adhaith Thayavaai
  Angeekarikkavum;
  Naan Adhai Ulla Vannamaai
  Thaaren Anpaayirum.

4. En Muzhu Nenjaiyum Anpaai,
  Svaami, Neer Endraikkum
  Akamum Aalayamumaai
  Pataiththuk Kontirum.

5. Neer Adhai Aalum Karththare,
  Aththaal Naan Paakkiyan,
  Naan Ulakaththaan Allave,
  Naan Ummutaiyavan.
title: En nenjai, svaami umakke

song:
1. Endran Jeevan Yesuve Sondhamaaka Aalume;
  Endran Kaalam Neramum Neer Kaiyaati Yarulum.

2. Endran Kai Peranpinaal Evappattu, Endran Kaal
  Pani Seyya Viraiyum; Azhakaaka Vilangum.

3. Endran Naavu Inpamaai Ummaippaata, Endran Vaai
  Ratchippai Prasdhaapikkum; Thoodhu Solla Nataththum.

4. Endran Aasdhi Thevareer Mutrum Angeekarippeer;
  Puththi, Kalvi Yaavaiyum Siththappati Seyyavum.

5. Endran Siththam Vituththen, Oppuviththuk Kotuththen;
  Endran Nenjai Aaluveer, Adhil Thondri Vasippeer.

6. Endran Nesam Paarumen; Thirukkaalil Ootrinen:
  Ennaiye Samoolamaai Thaththanj Cheydhen Endrumaai.
title: Endhan jeevan yesuve
Thevaa! Ennaip pataikkiren

song:
1. Or Nalla Nanparaik Kanten,
  Anaadhi Nesaraaka;
  Peranpinaale Izhuththaar.
  Thammantai Thayavaaka;
  Avvanpinaal En Ullaththaidh
  Tham Vasamaakkinaare.
  Naan Avar Sondham, Endranai
  Endrendrum Aatkontaare

2. Or Nalla Nanparaik Kanten,
  Mariththu Ennai Meettaar
  En Jeevan Kaakkath Thammaiye
  Pooraavaaith Thandhu Vittaar.
  En Sondhamalla Ondrume,
  Eendhorkke Sondhamaaka
  En Jeevan Sukam Yaavume
  Pataippen Endrumaaka.

3. Or Nalla Nanparaik Kanten,
  Maa Paasamulla Anpar;
  Palaththa Vazhith Thunaivar
  Meynj Gnaanamulla Nanpar.
  Innesar Anpai Vittidho!
  Neekkaadhu Ennai Ondrum;
  Saavo? Paato? Paadhaalamo
  Naan Avar Sondham Endrum.
title: Or nalla nanparaik kanten

song:
1. Nee Uyiraip Pera, Naan Iraththam Sindhinen
  Nee Meetpai Ataiya, Naan Vilaiyaakinen
  En Jeevan Naan Thandhen, Thandhen
  Nee Ennaththaith Thandhaai?

2. Sadhaakaala Inpam, Nee Petru Vaazhndhi;Ta
  Ivvulakin Thunpam Vandhen Sakiththita
  Anekaantaai Patten Patten
  Or Naal Nee Thandhaayaa?

3. Makadhva Nilaimai Unakkaai Naan Vitten
  Ulakin Vaadhaiyai Unakkaaich Chakiththen
  Thandhene Naan Ennai, Ennai
  Nee Ennaththaith Thandhaai?

4. Un Jeevan Thaththanjey, Un Nesa
  Meetparkkaai; Pooloka Vaazhvu Poi
  Jeevi Nidhyaththirkaai Kuppai Ulakellaam
  Avaraip Pin Sellu.
title: Nee uyiraip pera, naan
Nesamulla yesuve um paadham
Esuvukke oppuviththen

song:
1. Yesuvin Anpinaal Moozhkavum,
  Nesaththin Aazham Paarkkavum,
  Innamum Theeraa Vaanjaiye,
  Ennil Untaakukindradhe.
  
  Aatkontavar Nesam,
  Eetetrina Nesam,
  Innum Menmelum Vaanjippen;
  Unnadha Anpaip Potruven.

2. Yesuvin Sollum Siththamum,
  Aasaiyullonaaich Cheyyavum,
  Theva Oththaasai Nampuven,
  Aaviyin Peril Saaruven.

3. Naadharin Inpa Saththamum,
  Vedhaththil Kettu Niththamum,
  Aaththuma Nanmai Naatuven,
  Needhiyin Paadhai Selluven.
  
4. Yesuvin Raajareekamum,
  Aasiththa Maa Sengonmaiyum,
  Vinnile Thondrum Vannamaai,
  Manniluntaakum Menmaiyaai.
title: Esuvin anpinaal moozhkavum

song:
1. Nesa Yesuvukkaai Yaavunj Cheyven,
  Enna Nerittaalum Pin Vaanga Maatten;
  Narpor Veeranaippol Nilaiththu Nindru,
  Nesar Karpanaikal Seyven Naan Endrum.

2. Yaavaiyum Veruththen En Yesuvukkaai.
  Aavalaai Siluvai Engumavarkkaai
  Sumandhu Pin Sella, Endran Jeeva Naal
  Thandhen Idho Raajaa! Eppodhu Nee Aal.

3. Endhak Kaariyamum Unmaiyaaich Cheyven,
  Enna Nerittaalum Meyyaaich Chakippen;
  Paava Atimaikal Ratchippataiya,
  Thalaraa Vairaakkiyam Ennil Pataiyum.
title: Nesa yesuvukke yaavum

song:
1. Naan En Sondhamalla! Yesu
  Raththanj Chindhi Meettanar.
  Paatupattu Jeevan Thandhu,
  Ennai Aantukontanar.

  Sondhamalla! Yesuve!
  Mutrum Naan Un Atimai!
  Endran Jeevan Selvam Yaavum
  Niththam Umakkutamai.

2. Naan En Sondhamalla! Ennai
  Kirisdhuvin Aadheenamaai
  Oppuviththu, Avarkkendru
  Jeevippen Aanandhamaai.

3. Naan En Sondhamalla! Jeevan 
  Sukam Kaalam Pataippen.
  Ejamaanin Siththamaaka
  Upayokanj Cheyven Naan.

4. Naan En Sondhamalla! Ennai
  Etrukkontu Ratchiththaar
  Pinpu Motchaanandha Thandhu
  Oozhikaalam Vaazhvippaar.
title: Naan en sondhamalla!
Ratchakaa, ummutaiyonaakak

song:
1. En Jeevan, Sukam Selvam Piradhishtai Seykiren.
  Ursaakap Paliyaaka Naan Oppuvikkiren.

2. En Naadhaa! Aatiyenai Neer Etruk Kollumen.
  Naan Umdhan Sondhamaaka Ennaalum Jeevippen.

3. En Nenjil Neere Vandhu Pirasannamaakuveer,
  Ekaadhipadhiyaaka Angaatchi Seykuveer.

4. Neer Aalum! Yesu Naadhaa! En Raajaavaayirum.
  Ekkaalum Atiyenai Aatkontu Nataththum.
title: En jeevan, sukam selvam

song:
1. Siluvaiyin Paadhaththil, Visvaasiththu Nirpen,
  Alaindhu Sorum Poomiyil, Thangum Paarai Nizhal
  Paazhvanaandhara Vazhiyil, Thaaparikkum Veetu
  Kotum Sooryaveppam En Aarudhal, Kavalaikalin En Aarudhal.

2. Kora Van Siluvaiyil, Enakkaai Oruvar,
  Vedhanaiyaal Saakindradhai En Kankal Kaanudhe.
  Paadhikkappatta En Nenjil, Iru Adhisayam,
  Meetpin Anpum En Apaadhramum, Theva Rakasiyam.

3. Siluvai Nizhale Nee, En Pukalitame,
  Ummukam Sooryan Oli Pol, Vere Oli Kaanen,
  Ulaka Inpam Neekkinaai, Izhappe Ariyen,
  Siluvai Yandri Verondrilum, Menmai Naan Paaraatten.
title: Siluvaiyin paadhaththil, visvaasiththu

song:
Nee Yunakku Sondha Mallave, Meetkappatta Paavi
Nee Yunakku Sondha Mallave. 

Nee Yunakku Sondha Mallave
Nimalan Kirisdhu Naadharkke Sondham 				- Nee Yunakku

1. Siluvai Maraththil Thongi Mariththaare; Thiru Raththam, Raththam
  Thiru Vilaavil Vatiyudhu Paare;
  Mikundha Parisaththaal Kontaare;
  Motcha Makimai Yunakkeevaare. 					- Nee Yunakku

2. Indha Nandriyai Marandhu Ponaayo? Iyesuvai Vittu
  Enge Yaakilum Maraindhu Thirivaayo?
  Sandhadhamun Idhayangaayamum;
  Suvaami Kirisdhinutaiya Thallavo? 				- Nee Yunakku

3. Pazhaiya Paavaththaasai Varukudho? Pasaasin Mele
  Patchamunakkuth Thirumpa Varukudho?
  Arpa Nimishaththaasai Kaattiye,
  Akkinik Katal Thalluvaane? 						- Nee Yunakku

4. Pizhaikkinum Avarkke Pizhaippaaye; Ulakai Vittu
  Marikkinum Avarkke Marippaaye;
  Mariththu Uyirththa Yesu Naadharin;
  Malarati Ennaalum Ninaippaai. 					- Nee Yunakku
title: Nee yunakkuch chondha mallave

song:
Paadham Ondre Venum; Indhap
Paarinil Enakku Matredhum Ventaam - Un

1. Naadhane, Thungamey - Vedhane, Pongu Nal
  Aavalutan Thuyya - Thoodhardhozhunj Cheyya 			- Paadham
  
2. Seerum Puyalinaal - Vaaridhi Pongitap
  Paaril Natandhaar Pol - Neer Mel Natandha Un			- Paadham

3. Veesum Kamazh Konta - Vaasanaith Thailaththai
  Aasaiyutan - Mari - Poosip Panindha Por				- Paadham

4. Pokkitamatra Em Aakkinai Yaavaiyum,
  Neekkitave Maran - Thookki Natandha Nar			- Paadham

5. Naanilaththor Uyar - Vaan Nilaththera Val
  Aani Thulaiththitadh - Thaane Kotuththa Un			- Paadham

6. Paadham Ataindhavark - Kaadharavaaip Pira
  Saadham Arul Yesu - Naadhane, Endrum Un 			- Paadham
title: Paadham ondre venum

song:
Ennai Jeeva Paliyaai Oppuviththen
Etruk Kollum Yesuve.

Annai Thandhai Yundran Sannadhi Munnindru
Sonna Vaakkuththaththa Mallaadhu Ippodhu 		- Ennai

1. Andhakaaraththinindrum - Pavap Pey
  Atimaiththanath Thinindrum,
  Sondha Raththak Kirayaththaal Enaimeetta
  Endhaiye, Undranuk Kidho! Pataikkiren. 			- Ennai

2. Aaththuma Sareeramadhai, Umakku
  Aadheenamaakki Vaiththen;
  Paaththiramadhaayadhaip Paaviththukkolla
  Kaaththirukkiren; Karunai Sey En Thevaa.  		- Ennai

3. Needhiyin Aayudhamaai - Avayavam
  Nerndhu Vittenumakku;
  Jodhi Parisuththar Aalayamaakave
  Sondhamaaith Thandhen Endran Sareeraththai.		- Ennai
title: Ennai jeeva paliyaai

song:
Thevane, Naan Umadhantaiyil Innum - Nerungich
Chervadhe En Aaval Poomiyil.

 Maa Valiya Koramaaka Van Siluvai Meedhinil Naan
 Kove, Thonga Neritinum
 Aavalaai Umadhantai Serven. 				- Thevane

1. Yaakkopaip Pol, Pokum Paadhaiyil - Pozhudhu Pattu
  Iraavil Irul Vandhu Mootita,
  Thukkaththaal Naan Kallil Saaindhu Thoonginaalum En Kanaavil,
  Nokki Yummaik Kittich Cherven,
  Vaakkatangaa Nalla Naadhaa				- Thevane

2. Paraththuk Kerum Patikal Polave - En Paadhai Thondrap
  Pannum Aiyaa, Endran Thevane,
  Kirupaiyaaka Neer Enakkuth Tharuvadhellaam Umadhantai
  Arumaiyaai Ennai Yazhaikkum
  Anpin Thoodharaakach Cheyyum. 				- Thevane

3. Niththiraiyinindru Vizhiththu - Kaalai Ezhundhu
  Karththaave Naan Ummaip Potruven;
  Iththaraiyil Undran Veetaai Endran Kallai Naattuvene
  Endran Thunpaththin Vazhiyaai
  Innum Ummaik Kittich Cherven			 	- Thevane

4. Aanandhamaam Settai Viriththup - Paravasamaai
  Aakaayaththil Parandhu Poyinum
  Vaanamantalang Katandhu Parandhu Mele Sendritinum
  Makizhvurung Kaalaththilum Naan
  Maruvi Yummaik Kittich Cherven 				- Thevane
title: Thevane, naan umadhantaiyil

song:
Aiyaiyaa, Naan Vandhen - Theva
Aattuk Kutti, Vandhen.

1. Thuyyan Neer Sori Paavi Enakkaaich Chindhidh
  Thushtan Enai Azhaiththeer, - Thayai
  Seyvom Endre; Idhai Allaadhu
  Pokkillai, Thevaattuk Kutti, Vandhen. 			- Aiyaiyaa

2. Ullak Karaikalil Ondrenum Thaanaai
  Ozhindhaal Varuven, Endru - Nillen;
  Thel Um Udhiram Karai Yaavum Theerththitum;
  Thevaattukkutti, Vandhen. 					- Aiyaiyaa

3. Ennam, Veliye Poraattangal, Utpayam
  Eththanai Eththanaiyo! - Ivai
  Thinnam Akatri Elignanai Ratchiyum;
  Thevaattukkutti, Vandhen. 					- Aiyaiyaa

4. Etrukkontu Mannip Peendhu Suththikaridh
  Thennai Aravanaiyum; - Manam 
  Thetrik Konten Undran Vaakkuththaththangalaal
  Thevaattukkutti, Vandhen. 					- Aiyaiyaa

5. Mattatra Um Anpinaale Thatai Edhum
  Maari Akandradhuve; - Ini Thittame
  Undran Utamaiyaan Endrendrum;
  Thevaattukkutti, Vandhen. 					- Aiyaiyaa
title: Aiyaiyaa, naan vandhen

song:
1. Um Siththam Thevaa, Natappiyum
  Naan Or Manpaantam Um Karaththil
  Um Paadhaththantai Kaaththirukkum
  Ennai Um Siththappati Maatrum

2. Um Siththam Thevaa, Aakattume
  En Idhayaththai Aaraayume
  Um Samookaththil Thaazhndhirukkum
  Ennaik Kazhuvi Suththam Seyyum.

3. Um Siththam Thevaa, Aakattume
  Kaayappatta Ennai Nokkume
  Ellaam Valla En Aantavare
  Ennaith Thottuk Kunappatuththum.

4. Um Siththam Thevaa, Aakattume
  Mutrilum Ennai Aatkollume
  Kirisdhuvin Jeevan Velippata
  Ennai Um Aaviyaal Nirappum.
title: Um siththam thevaa

song:
1. Un Nenjile Untaana Visaaram Yaavum Nee
  Karththaavin Unmaiyaana Karaththuk Koppuvi;
  Vin Mannai Aantu Varum Makaa Thayaaparar,
  Un Kaariyangalukkum Vazhi Untaakkuvaar.

2. Jeyam Ataindhu Vaazhak Karththaavaip Pillaipol
  Nee Nampi Manadhaarap Panindhu Patrik Kol;
  Un Kavalaikalaalum En Payam Kolluvaai?
  Eththunpangal Vandhaalum, Mandraati Jepippaai.

3. Kaaththaave, Engalukku Ellaa Ikkattilum
  Ratchippalippadharkuch Chameepamaayirum;
  Narpaadhaiyil Nataththum, Uyir Naalanaiththum
  Um Raajyaththil Nataththum Appodhu Vaazhuvom.
title: Un nenjile untaana visaaram

song:
1. Avar Sollum Vazhi Selven!
  Avarai Nampak Katrullen!
  Enakkaaka Araiyuntaar,
  Eenak Kalvaari Kurusil.

  Raappakalaai Nataththuvaar,
  Vazhi Netuka Nataththuvaar
  Yesuve En Aapdha Nanpar,
  Kalvaariye En Gnaapakam.

2. Avar Karpanai En Aasai,
  Avar Karam Nataththattum!
  Theyva Siththam Enakkinpam,
  Thivya Kunam Kalvaariyaal.
  
3. Aiyam Achcham Illaamale,
  Aiyanai Nokki Mun Selven
  Vaanaththil Kaanpen Seekkiram,
  Kalvaari Nesar Yesuvai.
title: Avar sollum vazhi selven

song:
1. Kaattum Vazhi En Sandhosham
  Kaattum Oli Po Enkiraar;
  Naatorum Visuvaasippen;
  Meetparin Paadhai Pin Selven.

2. Aazhndha Neeril Nataththuvaar,
  Kaar Pallam Saaindha Kundrilum
  Korap Pusal Muzhanginum,
  Ner Karai Kontennaich Cherppaar.

3. Paadhai Kaatti Nidhya Jeevan
  Paar Unnutaiya Thenkiraar;
  Pareetchai Paataththaalunnai
  Paradheesukkum Aakkiraar.

4. Thunpam Avar Nataththudhal
  Inpa Keedham Paatach Cheyyum;
  En Paadhram Eevaal Nirappum,
  Nanku Siththam Seyya Evum.

5. Nataththum Paadhai Perinpam
  Neerotaiyin Pullen Meychchal
  Amar Neer Nataththa Inpam
  Adhe Vazhi Seeyon Thital.

6. Sondha Mandhai Nataththuvaar;
  Kanmalai Neeraik Kotuppaar;
  Kol Thatiyaal Aatral Seyvaar;
  Thevanitam Kontu Serppaar.
title: Kaattum vazhi en sandhosham

song:
1. Karththar Thaan Engal Thurkkamum Aran Palamumaame;
  Untaam Ikkattai Anaiththum Kazhippar Avar Thaame.
  Pollaanganin Sinam Ippodhu Maa Visham,
  Thushtarin Soodhaiyum Anindhu Urumum
  Nikar Puviyil Illai.

2. Edharku Naangal Vallavar? Inneesar Sakdhiyatror;
  Engalukkaai Veroruvar Por Seyvadhar Kerppattaar.
  Aar! Yesuk Kirisdhu Thaan Indha Maa Palavaan!
  Engatku Ratchakar Senaapadhi Avar
  Jeyippaar Avar Thaame.

3. Vizhungavarum Peykalaal Poomi Nirampinaalum
  Payappatom Karththaavinaal Edhirththu Nirkaththaalum;
  Irulin Pirapu Seerinaalum, Adhu
  Vellappatta Peyaam Thallunnath Theerndhadhe;
  Or Sollinaal Muriyum.

4. Pakaignar Theyva Vaarththaiyaip Pakaiththum Adhu Nirkum,
  Karththar Sakaayam, Avar Kai Varan Thandhaadharikkum
  Maatraarkal Yaavaiyum Ichcheevanaith Thaanum
  Vaanginaalum, Keto? Iraachchiyam Allo
  Engalukke Yirukkum.
title: Karththar thaan engal

song:
1. Ummantai Thevane! Naan Serattum;
  Siluvai Sumandhu Natappinum
  En Aaval Endrume
  Ummantai, Thevane! (2) Naan Servadhe.

2. Thaasan Yaakkopaip Pol Raak Kaalaththil,
  Thikkatruk Kallin Mel Naan Thoongaiyil,
  Endhan Kanaavile
  Ummantai, Thevane! (2) Iruppene.

3. Neer Ennai Nataththum Paadhai Ellaam
  Vin Ettum Eni Pol Vilangumaam
  Pirasannam Aakume
  Ummantai, Thevane; (2) Naan Serave.

4. Vizhiththu Ummaiye Naan Thudhippen;
  En Thuyar Kallai Um Veetaakkuven;
  En Thunpaththaalume
  Ummantai, Thevane; (2) Naan Servene.
title: Ummantai thevane!

song:
1. Yesuvutan Sukamaakave Selven,
  Engeyum Avar Ennai Nataththattum;
  Yesu Illaa Sdhalam Edhu Vaayinum,
  Echchandhoshamum Parandhe Poivitum.

  Engeyum, Engeyum, Payam Ariyen;
  Yesuvutan Sukamaakave Selven.

2. Yesuvutan Engeyum Thaniththalla,
  En Nanparkal Ennai Vittup Ponaalum
  Edhu Kaattil Ennaik Kontu Ponaalum,
  Yesuvutan Ellaa Sandhoshamunte.

3. Yesuvutan Evvitamum Thoongalaam,
  Saavin Nizhal Ennai Mootukaiyilum;
  Ekkam Neengi Ezhumpuven Nichchayam,
  Yesuvutan Inpa Veettil Vaazhuven.
title: Esuvutan sukamaakave selven

song:
1. Sedham Ara Yaavum Vara, Karththar Thaam Nataththuvaar;
  Kaatratiththum Kondhaliththum, Yesuvai Nee Patrap Paar.

2. Yesu Paaraar, Avar Kaavaar, Avar Kelaar Ennaadhe;
  Kalangaadhe Thavikkaadhe, Nampinonai Vitaare.

3. Kan Mootaadha, Urangaadha Un Karththaavaippatri Nee
  Avar Thaame Kaapporaame Endru Avaraip Pani.

4. Un Visaaram Maa Visdhaaram, Aakilum Karththaavukku
  Nee Keezhppattu Klesamatru Avarkkuk Kaaththiru.

5. Theva Kaikkum Vallamaikkum Sakalamum Kootaadho?
  Endhach Chikkum Endhap Pikkum Avaraal Arum Allo?
title: Sedham ara yaavum vara
Katal kondhaliththup ponga

song:
1. Thandhai Than Siru Maindhanai Kaiyendhith Thaanguvaan.
  Seeraattap Petra Paalakan Apaayam Ninaiyaan.

2. Avvaare Ennai, Pidhaave, Kaappaatrith Thaanguveer;
  En Pelaveenam Neengavum Kaiyendhi Varuveer.

3. Maadhaavin Nesa Matiyil Saaindhaatum Kuzhandhai,
  Thaayaarin Mukam Paarkkaiyil Marakkum Klesaththai.

4. Avvaare, Nesa Ratchakaa, Ummarul Mukaththai.
  Naan Paarkka, Sdhiramaakkuveer En Visuvaasaththai.

5. Thaai Thandhai Pakkam Paalarai Utkaara Vaikkungaal,
  Sandhoshith Thullang Kalippaar Petrorin Anpinaal.

6. Avvaare Thirup Paadhaththil Aanandham Ataindhen
  Menmelum, Arul Naadhare, Peranpai Rusippen.
title: Thandhai than siru maindhanai

song:
1. Anjaadhiru, En Nenjame, Un Karththar Thunpa Naalile
  Kan Paarppom Enkiraar. Ikkattil Thikaiyaadhiru,
  Thakundha Thunai Unakkuth Thappaamal Seykuvaar.

2. Thaaveedhum, Yopum, Yoseppum, Aneka Needhimaankalum
  Unnilum Vekuvaaik Kasdhi Ataindhum, Pakdhiyil
  Veroondri Etra Velaiyil Vaazhndhaarkal Poorththiyaai.

3. Karuththaaith Theva Thayavai Eppodhum Nampum Pillaiyaich
  Sakaayar Marakkaar, Meyp Pakdhi Unnil Ver Kontaal
  Irakkamaana Karaththaal Anaiththup Paalippaar.

4. En Nenjame, Makizhndhiru; Pey, Lokam, Thunpam Unakkup
  Pollaappuch Cheyyaadhe; Immaanuvel Un Kanmalai,
  Avar Mel Vaiththa Nampikkai Apaththam Aakaadhe.
title: Anjaadhiru, en nenjame

song:
1. Thollaik Kashtangal Soozhndhitum,
  Thunpam Thukkam Varum,
  Inpaththil Thunpam Neritum,
  Irulaai Thondrum Engum;
  Sodhanai Varum Velaiyil,
  Sol Ketkum Seviyile,
  Pattayaththaal Jeyam Varum
  Paran Unnaik Kaakka Vallor.

  Kaakkum Valla Meetpar Untenakku,
  Untenakku, Untenakku,
  Kaakkum Valla Meetpar Untenakku,
  Kaaththituvaar Endrume.

2. Aiya Mikundhadhor Kaalaththil
  Aavi Kuraivaaldhaan;
  Meetpar Udhira Palaththaal,
  Saththuruvai Vendren;
  En Payam Yaavum Neengitru
  Yesu Kai Thookkinaar;
  Mutraai Ennullam Maaritru
  Yesennaik Kaakka Vallor.

3. Enna Vandhaalum Nampuven
  En Nesa Meetparai;
  Yaar Kaivittaalum Pin Selven,
  Enadhu Yesuvai;
  Akalam, Aazham Uyaramaai,
  Evvalavanpu Koorndhaar;
  Enna Thunpangal Vandhaalum
  Ennaik Kaivita Maattaar.
title: Thollaik kashtangal soozhndhitum

song:
1. Kirisdhin Aattukkutti Naan, Idhu En Makizhchchi Thaan,
  En Nal Meypparaana Karththar Nandraaip Poshikkach Chamarththar;
  Ennai Avar Nesippaar, Per Arindhazhaikkiraar.

2. Avarai Naan Antinen Avar Kolaal Poorippen,
  Enakkavar Rusiyaana Meychchalum Kulirchchiyaana
  Thanneer Ootrum Kaattuvaar, Pasi Thaakam Theerkkiraar.

3. Avar Ennai Immaiyin Arul Naatkalukkup Pin
  Jeeva Meychchaluk Kazhaiththu Matiyile Serththanaiththup
  Penuvaar Makizheno? Naan Maa Paakkiyan Allo?
title: Kirisdhuvin aattukkutti naan

song:
1. Suka Kaalam Enkilum, Thukkamaana Podhilum,
  Neri Nindru Thavaren, Niththam, Niththam Nampuven.
 
  Vaazhvilum Maa Thaazhvilum, Kashta Nashtam Aakilum
  Yesuvaip Pin Patruven; Niththam Niththam Nampuven.
 
2. Endran Verum Nenjaththil Thooya Aavi Vilangin
  Avaraale Velluven; Niththam, Niththam Nampuven.

3. Inpam Aakil Paatavum; Thunpaththil Mandraatavum,
   Mosam Neril Anjiten; Niththam, Niththam Nampuven.

4. Jeeva Kaalam Muzhudhum, Saavu Pariyandhamum,
  Nidhya Jeevan Naatuven; Niththam, Niththam Nampuven.
title: Sukakaalam enkilum

song:
1. Meetkappatta Koottame, Ungal Meetpar Perile
  Paati, Vaazhththal Seyyungal; Meetpin Anpaich Chollungal.

2. Thevanaam Pidhaa Thayai Yesuvaal Untaanadhaip
  Paarththu Potrip Paatungal; Meetpaiye Untaakkinaar.

3. Neetu Kaalam Ungalaik Ketu Seydha Aasaiyaidh
  Thalludharku Maindhanaar; Meetpaiye Untaakkinaar.

4. Aadhalaal Makizhvote Potrip Paata, Maandhare
  Thoodharotum Kootungal; Meetpaiye Uyarththungal.
title: Meetkappatta koottame

song:
1. Nataththuvaar, Aa!  Inpennam, Maa Aarudhal Saarum Vannam
  Naan Evvitaththirukkinum Thevanin Kaiye Nataththum.

  Nataththuvaar, Nataththuvaar, Tham Kaiyaale Nataththuvaar;
  Avarai Neraaip Pin Selven, Tham Kaiyaale Nataththuvaar.

2. Orvelai Irul Paadhaiyil, Orvelai Edhen Poongaavil,
  Alai Katal Amaivilum Avar Nesak Kai Nataththum.

3. Karththaa Neer En Kai Pitippin; Thirupdhiyaal Kurai Pesen;
  Endha Nilaiyum Pooranam; Neere Enakkuth Thaarakam.
title: Nataththuvaar, aa, inpennam
Nenje visuvaasam kontu

song:
1. Nidhya Jeevan Enakkuntu, Niyaayaththeerppin Naalile,
  En Payam Ellaam Neengitru, Visvaasiththa Podhe.
  
  Thunpam Sakippom, 
  Innum Konjak Kaalandhaan, Kaalandhaan
  Thunpam Sakippom, Raajyam Servom Seekkiraththil.

2. Ulakam Ennaip Pakaiththaal, Payamindri Por Seyven;
  Sodhanai Yellaam Velluven, Yesuvin Vallamaiyaal.

3. Thunpam Thukkam Mikundhaalum Avarai Vittu Neengen;
  En Meetparai Naan Sandhikka Aayaththamaayiruppen.

4. Nee Un Paavaththai Unarndhu, Paranantai Oti Vaa;
  Avar Un Paavam Pokkuvaar, Parisuththamaakkuvaar.
title: Nidhya jeevan enakkuntu
Paraththai naatippoka nenje vizhiththiru
Neer jeeva appam panjaththil
En thevane, en aaththumaa
Thunpam unnai soozhndhalaik

song:
1. Aaraaindhu Paarum Ennai Neer Ennarumai Naadhaa,
  Um Kankalai Maraikka Yaar Thunivaar En Paraa.

2. Aaraaindhu Paarum Seykaikal; En Ninaivukalum
  Semmaiyallaadha Pongukal Enakkuk Kaanpiyum.

3. Andharangap Paavangalai Naane Kantunarndhu,
  Verukkum Manachchaatchiyaith Thaarum Ippozhudhu.

4. Um Vasanaththin Analaal Erindhu En Manam
  Aaviyin Nirappudhalaal Kaarum En Jeeviyam.
title: Aaraaindhup paarum ennai neer
Endhan aadhma nesare
Peraatruk koppaakap perinpamuntaam

song:
1. Kotum Paavangal Manniththavar,
  Kuraikal Neekka Vallavarallo?
  Maranaththi Nindretuththavar,
  Manach Chanjalam Neekkitaaro?

  Nampuven, Tharuvaar,
  Indrai Mattemmaik Kaaththaarallo?
  Nampuven, Tharuvaar,
  Raththaththaal Emai Meettaarallo?

2. Kumaaranaith Thandhennai Meettaar
  Kotuppen Kel En Naamaththaale
  Ventum Nanmai Yaavum Endranar;
  Thoontum Aaviyaal Seppinaare.

3. En Pidhaa Endran Thevai Yellaam
  Yesuvin Moolam Eendhituvaar;
  Thunpam Kashtam Kavalaiyellaam
  Anputan Avar Neekkituvaar;

4. Aaththumaa Thekam Aaviyotum
  Aalum Karththaraip Potruvome;
  Pidhaa Sudhan Aaviyaanorkkum
  Piriya Thoththiram Endrume.
title: Kotum paavangal manniththavar

song:
1. Yesu En Vazhi Nataththa Veru Edhum Ventumo?
  Sendra Naal Krupaiyaal Aanta Avaril Sandhekamo?
  Theva Samaadhaanam Aarudhal Ing Kavaril Thangave;
  Enna Nerittaalum Sdhoththiram Yesin Seyal Nanmaiye.

2. Yesu En Vazhi Nataththich Chuzhalilum Thetruraar;
  Sodhanaiyil Krupai Thandhu Jeevaappam Poshikkiraar.
  En Ati Thallaatinaalum, En Aadhmaa Thavikkinum,
  Pongudhe Sandhosha Ootru; Idho! Kanmalai Nindrum.

3. Yesu En Vazhi Nataththa Enna Poorna Peranpu!
  Vaakku Sampoorana Aarudhal En Pidhaa Veettil Untu.
  En Aaththumaa Saavaamai Porththu Ilangum Raajyam Sera
  Idho Endran Nidhya Keedham Vazhiyellaam Yesuve.
title: Esu en vazhi nataththa

song:
1. Raayare! Puyal Veesudhu Katal Alai Pongudhe
  Kaarirul Engum Mootudhe Pukal Kadhiyum Illai
  Maalkirome, Paareero Neer Thookkam Konteer Eno?
  Ovvor Velaiyum Katal Pongiye
  Vizhungap Paarkkudhaiyo?

  Kaatre Katale Nee Atanguvaai - Atanguvaai
  Kondhalikkum Katalaayinum Pisaasukal Manidharaanaalum
  Katal Poomi Vaanaraajan Thangum
  Patakai Vizhungaadhe, Thanneerum
  Samoolam En Siththam Atangum - Atangum - Atangum
  Samoolam En Siththam Atangum Amarndhirum.

2. Raayare! Sanjalaththaale Nokudhe En Manamum
  Kalangum En Idhayaththai Neer Unarththi Ratchiyume.
  Paava Sanjala Vellamum Aadhmaa Mel Paayudhe
  O! Saakirom, Saakirom Yesuve
  Neer, Amarththum Utane!

3. Raayare! Thikil Neengitre Koshtamum Amarndhadhu,
  Needhiyin Sooriyanum Thondri Idhayaththil Vandhadhe
  Nillum Arumai Meetpare Thaniyaai Vitaadheer
  Ummil Poorippaai Akkarai Serndhu
  Paakyanaai Vaazhven Ange
title: Raayare! Puyal veesudhu katal

song:
1. Kirisdhuvaip Patri Naam Paatuvom Ivvulakil
  Anpinaale Pulampum Ezhaikkum
  Azhundhum Rokikkum Kunamalikkindraar Krisdhu Yesu.

2. Iyesuvaip Patri Naam Paatuvom Ivvulakil
  Jepaththinaal Manakkilesaththinaal 
  Vazhith Thappiyorkal Meetpanai Nichchayam Petrituvaar.

3. Kirisdhuvaip Patri Naam Paatuvom Ivvulakil
  Kempeeramaai Marupirappinaik
  Kanta Aaththumaakkal Ataivaar Ursaakam Kirisdhuvinaal.
title: Kirisdhuvaip patri naam paatuvom

song:
1. Kirisdhu Raajaa Vaakkuththaththaththin Peril
  Thoniyin Saththam Thonikkum Endrume
  Raajanukkuk Kanam Pukazh Onguka
  Nilai Nirpen Vaakkuththaththaththil.

  Nirpen Nirpen
  Theva Vaakkuththaththangalai Nampiye Naan
  Nirpen Nirpen Naan 
  Nilai Nirpen Vaakkuththaththaththil.

2. Sandhekap Puyal Veesiya Podhilum
  Krisdhu Raajaa Vaakkuththaththaththin Peril
  Theva Jeeva Vaarththaikalinaal Vaazhven,
  Nilai Nirpen Vaakkuththaththaththil.

3. Avar Raththaththin Suththikarippinaal
  Paripoorna Vitudhalaiyaik Kanten.
  Naan Kaanum Annal Vaakkuththaththangalai
  Nampi Nilainirpen Endrume.
title: Krisdhu raajaa

song:
1. Pidhaave Kenjik Ketkiren Arulveer Endru Arindhu
  Indha Naalukku Ventiya Pelanaith Thandhu Nataththum.
  
  Sodhanaiyai Jeyiththita Valla Thevaa Pelan Thaarum
  Naalukku Naal Pelan Thaarum Idhuve Endran Praaththanai.

2. Mullillaadha Paadhaiyinai Orupodhum Ketkavillai
  Vaazhkkaiyin Sumai Thaangita Maadhram Neer Pelan Thandhitum.

3. Ivvelaiyin Thevaikkaana Arulappattulla Pelan
  Andraata Kashtam Thaangita Podhiya Aaseervaadhamaai.
title: Pidhaave kenjik ketkiren

song:
1. Kanmalaiye Pukalitam Puyarkaala Neraththile
  Nallavaiye Nee Naatitu Puyarkaala Pukalitam

  Ippaazh Nilaththil Maa Kanmalai
  Kaanal Manalil Thanin Nizhal
  Motcha Payaniyin Thunaivan
  Puyarkaalap Pukalitam

2. Pakalil Nizhal Iravil Aran Aran Puyal Odhukkitam
  Pakaivaraal Thikaikkaadha Puyarkaala Pukalitam.

3. Peruvellam Soozhum Podhu Puyarkaala Pukalitam
  Theva Ataikkalam Untu Puyarkaalap Pukalitam.

4. Kanmalai Narpukalitam Puyarkaala Neraththilum
  Neengaadha Thunaiyaayirum Puyarkaala Pukalitam.
title: Kanmalaiye pukalitam puyarkaala

song:
1. Yovaan Tharisanaththil Kantaar Vaana Senai
  Kreetamum Ven Vasdhiramum Kan Kollaak Kaatchiyaam.

2. Siluvai Veerarkalellaam Poraati Jeyiththu
  Vetriyin Sinnam Petranar Kaanpom Annakaril.
  
3. Poolokinil Pulampiye Kanneeraich Chindhinar 
  Kashtaththotu Poraatinar Paavaththai Vendranar.

4. Pedhle Kemin Natchadhraththin Prakaasam Kantanar
  Vazhi Kaattiya Kadhirai Pin Patrich Chendranar.

5. Sirai Araiyinullile Sakiththaar Kashtaththai
  Netu Naalaai Edhir Paarththa Nakaram Ivarkke.
title: Yovaan tharisanaththil kantaar

song:
1. Vedha Nool Odhitum Nalla Meyppaa,
  Paadhaiyum Sadhyamum Jeevan Neere.
  Pedhaiyaam Ezhaiyen Paadhai Sella
  Neer Allaal Yaarumillai.
 
  Iyesu Naadhaa! Ezhaikku Neer Allaal Yaarumillai;
  Iyesu Naadhaa! Neer Allaal Yaarum Yaarumillai.

2. Sadhya Visvaasaththaik Kaaththitave,
  Niththam Nin Keerththiyaip Paatitave;
  Saththuru Senaiyil Vetri Thara
  Neer Allaal Yaarumillai. 					- Iyesu

3. Ore Pidhaavai Arindhitave,
  Parisuththaaviyaip Petritave,
  Veredhu Pokkum Vazhiyumillai,
  Neer Allaal Yaarumillai. 					- Iyesu

4. Nanmai Edhum Seyya Arikilen,
  Thinmaiye Yaan Seyya Thiranulen
  Nar Seykai Yaavum Um Siththam Seyya
  Neer Allaal Yaarumillai. 					- Iyesu

5. Thevan Makadhvaththil Mel Varave,
  Jeeva Kireetaththaith Thaan Tharave,

 Munnum Pinnumaai Iyesu Ennai Nataththuvaar.

 Valla Kirisdhunakku Nalla Thaarakame.

Aadhaaram Nee Thaanaiyaa.

  Matrorkkup Patredhaiyaa? Eliyanukku		- Aadhaaram

  Naattaatril Vittaaraiyaa; Thaniyanukku 		- Aadhaaram

song:

  Keedham Paatiyum, Mun Selluvom.

  Yaarum Vaarum! Yuththam Pannuvom
  Sellum! Vellum! Aaravaaramaaka,
  Yesunaadhar Nampip Pokirom.

2. Koti Etruvom Kaalam Oodhuvom;
  Vaalum Veesuvom, Porkkolamaai,
  Karththar Thaanguvaar, Kootappokiraar,
  Vetri Sirappaar, Kempeeramaai.

  Thevareeraiye Kontaatuvom
  Ummaal Vallamai, Ummaal Makimai,
  Ummaal Vetriyaik Kantataivom.

song:
1. Yuththam Seyvom; Vaarum, Krisdhu Veerare!
  Yesu Senai Karththar Pinne Selvome!
  Vetri Vendharaaka Munne Pokiraar,
  Jeyak Koti Etrip Por Nataththuvaar.
 
  Yuththam Seyvom, Vaarum, Krisdhu Veerare!
  Yesu Senai Karththar Pinne Selvome!

2. Krisdhu Veerarkaal, Neer Vella Muyalum,
  Pinnitaamal Nindru Aaravaariyum!
  Saaththaan Koottam Andhath Thonikkadhirum
  Narakaasdhipaaram Anji Asaiyum!

3. Krisdhu Sapai Valla Senai Pondradhaam,
  Suththar Sendra Paadhai Selkindrome Naam;
  Krisdhu Thaasar Yaarum Or Sareerame;
  Visuvaasam, Anpu, Nampikkai Ondre.

  Krisdhu Sapai Thaane Endrum Nilaikkum;
  Narakaththin Vaasal Jeyam Kollaadhe
  Endra Thivya Vaakku Veenaaip Pokaadhe.

5. Pakdhare! Ondraakak Koottang Kootumen!
  Engalotu Serndhu Aarppariyumen!
  Vinnor Mannor Koottam Yesu Raayarkke
  Keerththi, Pukazh Menmai Endrum Paatume.

song:

  Poraatuvom Munai Mukamellaam,
  Senaadhipadhi Ennai Nokkuvaar;
  Aayadha Thaariyaiyum Nampuvaar.

  Sannaththanaakap Patai Mukaththil,
  Porkkalath Thaaravaarang Ketkave
  Payamumillaamal Yuththanj Cheyvene.
