  Kaanappattaalum, Vetrivendhanaai
  Niththiya Kaalam Mika Vaazhuven,

song:

  Narakaakkinaiyaich Cholvom Paava Matanga,
  Poorva Kaala Thevadhaasar Visdhariththaar Pol
  Motcha Lokam Poku Munne.

  Seyvom, Seyvom, Por Palaththutane
  Naanaa Jaadhi Paashaikkaarar Ratchippataiya
  Motcha Lokam Pokum Munne.

2. Senaiyaarin Yuththa Sapdham Poomiyengum Kel!
  Meetpataindha Pedhaikalin Saatchikalung Kel! 
  Muzhu Lokaththaiyum Vella Innum Konja Naal;
  Motcha Lokam Pokum Munne

3. Theedhaai Saththurukka Lenna Sonna Podhilum,
  Suththa Aaviyin Palaththaip Petru Yaavilum

  Nataththum Nidhyaraajaa, Por Isai Meettuvom.

  Thooyadhva Inpa Aamen Odhum Samaadhaanam

  Anpum Kirupaiyaale Thevaraajyam Varum.

  Um Inpa Mukam Engum Kaanpen Payamillai
  Siluvai Oli Nokkip Payanam Selluven 
  Nataththum Valla Thevaa, Kreetam Vendronukke.

 Vanjanaiyaakave Pey Edhirth Thundranai

  Palaveenan Ariveenan, Ivvulakam Kaatudhaan

  Theepa Meka Sdhampang Kaattum Vazhiyil Nataththume;
  Valla Meetpar, Ennaith Thaangum Yesuve.

Esu svaami arul naadhaa

song:

  Meyyaam Visuvaasam Anpotunmaiyum.

  Untaakkum; Meyppakdhi Vairaakkiyamum.

2. Menmelum Neer Thaarum Mey Gnaanaththaiyum
  Um Perile Saarum Sar Kunaththaiyum
  Men Melum Untaakkum Nar Sindhaiyaiyum
  Aararulai Naatum Peraasaiyaiyum.

3. Men Melum Neer Thaarum Suththaangaththaiyum,
  Maasatra Ullaana Nar Supaavaththaiyum,
  Theep Paavaththai Vellum Vallaaviyaiyum,

song:
1. Ulakin Vaanjaiyaana En Svaami Yesuve,
  Naan Ummai Etradhaana Vanakkaththutane
  Sandhikkach Cheyvadhenna? Naan Thevareerukku
  Seluththa Umakkenna Piriyamaanadhu?

2. Naan Yaadhoru Kadhiyum Illaadhavanumaai,
  Nirppandhamum Payamum Niraindhavanumaai
  Irundha Podhanpaaka Neer Ennai Nokkineer,
  Neere En Meetpukkaaka Ivvulakil Vandheer.

  Ikazhchchiyaich Chumandhen Neer Adhai Neekkineer;

  Sampoorana Muntaakki Ratchikka Vandheere.

4. Viyaakulam Ataindha Nararin Koottame,
  Ikkattinaal Niraindha Nirppandha Maandhare,
  Idho Sakaayar! Vandhaar; Karththar Kettorukku
  Iratchakaraith Thandhaar Adhaal Makizhndhirum.

song:

  En Ratchakaa; Kelum Vinnappam,
  Neekkum En Paadhakam, Aam Naan Innaal Mudhal, Um Atimai.

  Uyiratren; Enakkaai Mariththeer, Umakke Thevareer,

  Selvam Neenga Sangatamaanaayaa?

  Yesuve Aapdha Nanpar,
  Yesu Pondra Sakodhararillai,
  Yesuvitam Mattum Sol.

  Yesuvitam Mattum Sol.

song:

  Paava Thosham Yaavaiyum Neekkumpati Arulum.

  Paavam Neenga Maattaadhe; Neere Meetpar, Yesuve!
  Ummai Niththam Atiyen Thanjamendru Saaruven.

  Um Rantaam Varukaiyil Vaadhai Varum Velaiyil

song:

  Yesuve, Neer Paridhaapamanpumaai Irukkireer,
  Paarath Thukkang Konta Ullam Vandhu Thetral Seykuveer.

  Visuvaasaththaith Thuvakki Mutippavaraai Irum.

  Kuraivatra Anpaip Petru Oyaamale Thudhippom.

  Undran Saayal Petru Vaazhndhu; Theva Anpil Moozhkiye

  Naadhaa, Atiyaarai Niththam Maru Roopa Maakkitum.

song:
1. En Jepa Velai Vaanjippen!
  Appodhen Thukkam Marappen
  Pidhaavin Paadham Paniven
  En Aasai Yaavum Solluven;
  En Novu Velai Thetrinaar,
  En Aadhma Paaram Neekkinaar
  Oththaasai Petruth Therinen
  Pisaasai Vendru Jeyiththen.

2. En Jepa Velai Vaanjippen!
  Maa Thaazhmaiyotu Praarththippen!
  Mandraattaik Ketpor Varuvaar
  Per Aaseervaadham Tharuvaar;
  En Vaakkin Mel Visvaasamaai,
  En Paadham Thetu Ookkamaai,
  Endrorkken Novaich  Solluven;
  Ivvelaiyai Naan Vaanjippen.

  Aanandhak Kalip Pataiven.
  Piskaavin Mele Eruven,
  En Motcha Veettai Nokkuven;
  Iththekam Maari Ekuven,
  Vin Nidhya Vaazhvaip Peruven
  Perinpa Veettil Vasippen
  Vaataadha Kreetam Sootuven.

  Aantavaa! Piriyamaanadhai,

  Kalvaari Aaviyaal Ullaththai
  Poril Vella Arulume.

  Neer Natandha Paadhai Selven;

 Meentavaa, Paavik Kiranguvaaye.

song:
Aiyaa! Kolkadhaa Malai Naadhaa
 Enakkaar Thunai Sollum Anukoolaa

 Meyyaa! Idhu Tharunam Neraai
 Ichchiriyon Mukaththaip Paarkka Vaarum 		- Aiyaa

1. Paaraikkul Therai Polaanen - Naan
  Pala Thuyar Pattavanaanen
  Aalaikkul Karumpu Polaanen - Indha
  Akadhik Kun Mukam Kaatta Vaarum		- Aiyaa

2. Palarum Palavum Solli Eyththu - Enai
  Alaivaai Thurumpu Pol Aaiththu
  Tholaiyaadha Kavalaikkul Maaiththu - Thooradh
  Thuraththi Vitta Kadhiyaip Paarththu		- Aiyaa
title: Aiyaa! Kolkadhaa malai

song:
Aaviyal Jepam Seyyap Pelan Thaarum Suvaami!
Ataikkalaa Undran Thunai Venum Nemi!

1. Thevaavi Arulmaari Em Melanuppu,
  Thevaa Jepiththita, Pelan Ventum Svaami 			- Aavi

2. Muzhu Ullam Karaindhittaal Idhayaththilirundhu
  Suluvaaka Vasanangal Surandhitum Svaami		- Aavi

3. Vanjaka Udhatukal Varundhik Kettaalum
  Thanja Mendrummai Naan Anuka Viteere			- Aavi

4. Adhikaalai Jepaththaale Theti Vandhaalum,
  Aadhi Paran Aavi Illaal Viyarththam			- Aavi

5. Pelanatra Ezhaikkup Pelan Thaarum Svaami!
  Nalamaaka Naavai Neer Maatritum Nemi			- Aavi

6. Jepam Seyya Vaayai Neer Thottitum Svaami!
  Jeyam Pera Vakai Padham Karpiyum Nemi		- Aavi

7. Yesuvin Raththaththaal Idhayaththaik Kazhuvi
  Nesarin Aaviyaal Orumikkach Cheyyum			- Aavi
title: Aaviyal jepam seyyap pelan

song:
Aadhiyaam Makaa Raajane, - Endha Velaiyum
Atiyanotirum, Eesane.

Theedhillaa Saruvesaa, Thesurum Pirakaasaa,
Paadhakan Yaan Miku Palaveenan Aanadhaal 		- Aadhi

1. Paavi Pelanaal, Aiyane, - Nindraal Ennaip
  Pakaivar Jeyippaar, Meyyane 
  Thevaa, Thunai Neer Aiyane, - Siriyanitam 
  Serndhe Vasiyum, Thuyyane
  Mevum Thanjam Enakku Ventum, Kaavalan Neere; 
  Saavu Varaiyum Ennaith Thaangi Aravanaiyum		- Aadhi

2. Irakkam Pozhiya Vaarume, - Kirupaiyaaka,
  Iraivaa, Ennitam Serume; 
  Urukkam Niraindha Neerume - Anavaradham 
  Undran Arulaith Thaarume; 
  Serukkaai Enmee Thikalor Sedham Seyya Ninaikkum
  Thirukka Akatri Ennil Thinamum Arulpuriyum		- Aadhi

3. Endran Marana Mattume - Arukil Neere
  Irundhaal Makaa Ishtame. 
  Endha Akidhar Kettume - Imaip Pozhudhil
  Ekip Povaar Thittame; 
  Thandhai Sudhan Neerallaal Thanjam Veraarum Illai 
  Vindhai Mevum Kadhiyil Menmaiyutan Vaazhkave	- Aadhi
title: Aadhiyaam makaa raajane

song:
1. Theva Anpai Vedham Koorak Kantu Unarndhen.
  Raththam Sindhi Ennai Meetta Anpai Unarndhen.

  Endran Paavam Yaavum Theerkka Yesu Mariththaar.
  Anpu Pongi Velai Seyyap Palan Kotuppaar.

2. Theva Maindhan Raththam Otach Cheydha Kaaranam,
  Aani, Eetti Ivaiyalla; Endran Akramam;

3. Endran Jeevan Sukam Mutrum Thaththam Seykiren:
  Thiru Vaakkai Nampi Endrum Ummaip Pinselven.
title: Theva anpai vedham koora

song:
1. Karththarin Velaich Cheyyum Vitiyar Kaalaththil,
  Vaikarai Sukamaana Nalla Neraththil,
  Sooriyan Vaanil Eri, Kiranam Veesavum,
  Raaththiri Maa Sameepam Velai Oindhitum,

2. Karththarin Velaich Cheyyum Madhyaana Velaiyum,
  Veyilum Eriththaalum Ozhiyaadhirum.
  Oozhiyam Seydhu Vaarum Itaivitaamalum,
  Raaththiri Maa Sameepam Velai Oindhitum,

3. Karththarin Velaich Cheyyum Pozhudhu Pokume;
  Sivandha Vaanam Paarum Oli Neengume!
  Sandhiyaa Kaalamaaki Irul Untaakavum,
  Raaththiri Maa Sameepam Velai Oindhitum.
title: Karththarin velai seyyum
Kaalai, pakal, maalai endha neramenum

song:
1. Ketpor Yaarendraalum Sol, Sol Seydhi
  Thivya Suvisesham Yaarkkum Anuppu;
  Endhath Thesaththaarkkum Adhaip Parappu,
  Yaarendraalum Seralaam.
 
  Yaavan Endraalum, Yaavan Endraalum,
  Endrum Indhach Cheydhi Engum Kooralaam;
  Paavi Vaa, Pidhaa Anpaai Azhaikkavum,
  Yaarendraalum Seralaam.

2. Vaarum, Yaarendraalum Thaamadhippadhen?
  Vaa, Thirandhaar Vaasal! Utchellaadhadhen?
  Jeeva Paadhai Ondre, Yesudhaan Vaaven;
  Yaarendraalum Seralaam.

3. Vaakkai Yaarendraalum Petruk Kollalaam.
  Yaarendraalum, Ivvaakkendrum Nirkumaam;
  Yaarendraalum Nidhya Jeevan Kaanalaam,
  Yaarendraalum Seralaam.
title: Ketpor yaarendraalum
Kaaththaavin thaasare, ekkaalam

song:
1. Oozhiyam Seyvom Naam Theva Oozhiyare
  Selluvom Yesu Naadhar Narpaadhaiyile
  Mikka Gnaanaththinaal Vazhi Nataththuvaar
  Valla Aaviyin Arulaal Nataththuvaar.

  Uzhaiththe .... Uzhaiththe Vizhiththum .... Jepiththum
  Nampuvom .... - Uzhaippom Nam Yesu Varumalavum.

2. Uzhaippom Uzhaippom Suviseshakare
  Kaattuvom Thelivaai Jeeva Maarkkaththaiye
  Siluvai Sumandhor Makimai Ataivom
  Kooruvom Ratchippu Theva Eevu Endre			- Uzhai

3. Uzhaippom Uzhaippom Visuvaasikale
  Irulin Asdhipaarangal Norungave
  Yesuvin Naamam Ulakengum Ongave
  Kooruvom Ratchippu Theva Eevu Endre 			- Uzhai

4. Uzhaippom Uzhaippom Mutivu Varaikkum
  Aruvataiyiye Aanandham Ataivom
  Andha Raajjiyaththin Jodhi Thondrum Varai
  Kooruvom Ratchippu Theva Eevu Endre			- Uzhai
title: Oozhiyam seyvom naam

song:
1. Eththesaththileyum Pirasangiththe
  Thevavasana Arivaal Kontu
  Aruppu Oyum Mattum Uzhaiththu
  Narkadhiraich Cherppaarunto Indru?

  Koivaar Enge? Sakaayar Yaar?
  Avasaramaana Thindha Velai Paar
  Kraamandhorum Prasangiththe
  Narkadhiraich Cherppaarunto, Indre?

2. Purappattup Poi Vazhich Chandhiyil
  Aaththumaakkalaith Thetungal Endraar
  Manikal Ondrume Thavaraamal
  Kalanjiyaththil Serungal Endraar 			- Koi

3. Eththisaiyilum Vilaivaakudhe
  Ippo Tharuththaal Mikka Palane
  Aruppadhikam, Aatkalo Konjam
  Thaamadham Seydhaal Perum Nashtam Thaan	- Koi

4. Sakodharar Yaavarum Vaarungal
  Aaththumaakkalai Ondraaik Koottungal
  Aantavar Yesu Varum Pozhudhu
  Aruppin Aanandham Ataivome			- Koi
title: Eththesaththileyum prasangiththe

song:
1. Kettonai Ratchiyum; Saavonai Kaarum
  Paavamum Saapamum Neengach Cheyyum;
  Sorvonaith Thaangitum Veezhndhonaith Thookkum
  Supa Viseshaththai Ariviyum.

  Kettonai Ratchiyum; Saavonaik Kaarum
  Yesu Thayaaparar, Yesu Vallor.

2. Paava Santaalaraip Porumaiyotu
  Thiruththi Ratchikkap Paarkkiraare.
  Mey Manasdhaapamaai Nampikkaiyotu
  Vandhataindhaal Avar Mannippaare.

3. Theekkuna Nenjilum Mangip Ponaalum
  Paakyaththai Naatum Nallaasai Yuntaam.
  Aanpin Viseshaththaal, Saththiyaththaalum
  Kundriya Vaanjaiyum Melitumaam.

4. Kettonai Ratchiyum Aaththiraththotu!
  Aaviyin Vallamai Aruluvaar.
  Ratchippaik Kooravum Urukkaththotu
  Thevaaseervaadhamum Thandhituvaar.
title: Kettonai ratchiyum

song:
1. Niyaayath Theerppil, Umadhantai Nirkum Podhu Ratchakaa!
  Udhavaamal, Palanatru, Vetkappattu Poveno?

  Aadhmaa Ondrum Ratchikkaamal,
  Vetkaththote Aantavaa!
  Verungaiyanaaka Ummaik
  Kantu Kollal Aakumaa?

2. Aaththumaakkal Peril Vaanjai Vaiththiraamal Sompalaai,
  Kaalam Kazhiththor Annaalil Thukkippaar Nirppandharaai.

3. Thevareer Kaidhaanga, Satrum Saavuk Kanjik Kalangen;
  Aayinum, Naan Palan Kaana Uzhaikkaamal Poyinen!

4. Vaanaal Ellaam Veenaalaaka Sendru Poyitre! Aiyo!
  Mosam Ponen! Vitta Nanmai Azhudhaalum Varumo!

5. Pakdhare! Ursaakaththotu Ezhumpi Prakaasippeer!
  Aaththumaakkal Yesuvantai Vandhu Sera Uzhaippeer!
title: Niyaayaththeerppil, umadhantai

song:
1. Kotaana Kotik Kanakkaana Maandhar
  Gnaana Millaamal Maantu Povaare.
  Yaar Kooruvaar? Meynj Gnaanamutra Nenjar
  Yesuvinaaluntaana Meetpaiye.

  Raajaadhi Raajan Avare! (2)
  Suviseshang Koora Engum Viraindhotich
  Sandhoshamaaich Cholluvome.

2. Pooloka Vaasal Thiravunta Thengum,
  Thataikal Yaavum Neengalaayitre.
  Theevirippom Ore Theermaanaththotum,
  Paava Vinaasam Koorik Kaattave.

3. En Saakuveer? Endresu Ketkiraare;
  En Saakuveer? Endrisain Thuraippom.
  Mannuyirkkaaka Jeevan Thurandhaare,
  Supa Visesham Engum Kooruvom.

4. Thevaaviyaal Eththesa Jaadhiyaarum
  Yesuvin Paadham Panivaarkalaam.
  Karunaiyutra Koottaththaa Rellorum
  Oppatra Naamam Paatuvaarkalaam.
title: Kotaana kotikkanakkaana
Karththaave panivitai seyyach

song:
1. Imaalya Malaiyeri Thesaandham Nokkumen!
  Vangaalak Katal Thaanti Metrisai Vaarumen!
  Iththesaththaa Rellaarum Agngnaana Paasaththaal
  Kattuntu Ponaar, Paarum! Meyyari Vinmaiyaal.

2. Ichchelva Thesam Engum Maa Sezhippaayinum,
  Narkandham Veesukindra Ilangaith Theevilum
  Aiyo! Theeyorin Nenju Thurkandha Mulladhaal,
  Paadhaalath Theeyil Veezhndhu Maalvaare Paavaththaal.

3. Airoppaa Aasiyaavum, Aappirikkaa Kantamum,
  Eththisai Thesam Theevum, Poolokam Anaiththum,
  Immaanuvelaich Cherum; Sudhandhira Sondhamaai
  Meymaarkkam Valarn Thongum Makaa Pirapalyamaai.

4. Yesuvinaa Luntaana Nar Seydhi Kooruvom!
  Peranpin Makaththaana Meych Chutar Kaattuvom,
  Pooloka Mengumaaka Peroli Veesave,
  Nal Meetpar Raajaavaaka Vandharasaalvaare.
title: Imaalya malai eri thesaandham nokkumena

song:
1. Aa! Naayakaa, Naan Ummote
  Thaazh Paadhaiyil Sellattume;
  Um Velaiyil Eththeengaiyum
  Sakikkum Vakai Podhiyum.

2. En Anpin Sollaal Niththamum
  Mandhamullorai Evavum,
  Vizhuvorai Naan Thaangavum,
  Motcham Serkkavum Podhiyum.

3. Visvaasam Ongum Velaiyil,
  Jeyang Kollum Nampikkaiyil,
  Ummo Tennaalum Thangavum,
  Um Vazhikalaip Podhiyum.

4. Visaalamaai En Paadhaiyil,
  Velichcham Veesum Manadhil,
  Um Samaadhaanaththil Endrum
  Ummotu Naan Pizhaikkattum.
title: Aa! Naayakaa, naan ummote

song:
1. Ummotu Uzhaippen O! Kirisdhuve!
  Apaaththira Paavi Naam Endraalume
  Thandhom Emadhellaam; Uzhaippom Umakkaai;
  Jeyippom Ulakai Um Kirupaiyaal.

2. Ummotu Uzhaikka Ilaiththitom;
  Kashtam Sakikka Von Naadhaakinum,
  Um Krupai Podhumen Um Vaakke Aarudhal,
  Em Kashtam Neengudhe, Uzhaippome.

3. Viraindhu Oozhiyam Seydhituvom;
  Lokam Paavam Neengith Thappum Mattum.
  Eththesaththaarume Etruk Kontummaiye
  Sevikkum Mattume, Uzhaippome,
title: Ummotu uzhaippen o! Kirisdhuve

song:
1. Yesuvin Narseydhi Solveer
  Ezhai En Nenjaththile;
  Ullanpu Ponga Neer Solveer
  Sandhosha Seydhi Adhe!
  Paalanai Vaazhththa Vin Thoodhar
  Kootiye Aarppariththaar!
  Vinnil Pidhaavukke Menmai
  Poomiyil Sinekam Endraar.
 
  Yesuvin Narseydhi Solveer
  Ezhai En Nenjaththile;
  Ullanpu Ponga Neer Solveer
  Sandhosha Seydhi Adhe!

2. Naarpadhu Naal Theeya Kaattil
  Sodhanaiyaal Thaviththaar;
  Pataadha Paatukal Pattaar
  Saaththaanaiyo Jeyiththaar.
  Yaarukkum Nanmaikal Seydhu
  Sutriye Thirindhanar;
  Paavikalaal Thallappattu
  Kasdhikal Ataindhanar.

3. Meetpar Tham Siluvai Meedhil
  Thongiye Jeevan Vittaar;
  Uyirththezhundhu Motcha Veettil
  Endrum Veetraalukiraar;
  Aa! Indha Anpe Peranpu!
  Endranai Meettuk Kontaar!
  Raajaadhi Raajanaip Potrum!
  Anpin Soroopiyaanaar.
title: Esuvin narseydhi solveer

song:
1. Nal Meyppar Krisdhu Vaanavar Thappippona Aatukalai
  Azhaikkum Avar Sapdhaththai Vanaandhiraththil Ketkiren.

  Mandhaiyil Mandhaiyil Naam Kontu Serththu Vituvom,
  Thirindhalaivorai Yesuvantaiyil Serppom.

2. Udhavi Seyya Yaar Selvaar? Meypparukku Oththaasaiyaai
  Kulir Illaadha Mandhaikkul Kontu Serththita Yaar Selvaar?

3. Ejamaan Krisdhuvaanavar Malaik Kaattinil Kadharum
  Aatukalaip Poith Thetita Evum Saththaththaik Ketkiren.
title: Nal meyppar krisdhuvaanavar

song:
1. Kel Yesu Azhaikkum Saththam Yaar Poi En Velai Seyvaar?
  Mudhirndha Payir Aruththu Arikal Yaar Sumappaar?
  Koovi Azhaikkum Aantavar Unnadha Palam Eevaar.
  Idho Naan Thevaa Anuppum Padhil Yaar Solvaar Nandru.

2. Thoodhu Kelor Naatu Theti Katal Thaantaa Vittaalum
  Veettarukil Un Pakkaththil Thoodhu Solli Udhavu.
  Thoodhar, Pavul Pol Podhikka Aatral Illaavittaalum
  Yesu Maantaar Unakkendru Nesar Anpu Kooralaam.

3. Makkal Saakindraarkal Unnai Aantavar Azhaikkiraar.
  Ennaal Aakaadhondrum Seyya Makkal Ketkach Chollaadhe.
  Tharum Velai Sey Kalippaai Oozhiyame Un Vaazhvu.
  Azhaiththaal Padhil Sol Utan Thevaa Idho Anuppum.
title: Kel yesu azhaikkum
Oozhiyarkkor itamuntu

song:
Thaasare Iththaraniyai Anpaai
  Iyesuvukkuch Kontu Varuvom.

  Paasamaai Yesuvaik Kooruvom, Avaraik Kaanpippom
  Maa Irul Neekkuvom, Velichcham Visuvom. 			- Thaasare

1. Varuththappattu Paaranj Chumandhorai
  Varundhi Anpaai Azhaiththituvom
  Uriththaai Yesu Paavappaaraththai Namadhu Thukkaththai,
  Namadhu Thunpaththaich Chumandhu Theerththaare		- Thaasare

2. Pasiyutrorkku, Piniyaalikatkum
  Patchamaaka Udhavi Seyvom;
  Usidha Nanmaikal Niraindhu, Thamai Marandhu,
  Yesu Kanindhu Thirindhanare. 					- Thaasare

3. Nerukkappattu Otukkappattorai
  Neesarai Naam Uyarththituvom;
  Porukka Vonnaa Kashtaththukkul Nishtooraththukkul
  Patukuzhikkul Vizhundhanare. 					- Thaasare

4. Indhu Thesa Maadhu Siromanikalai
  Vindhai Olikkul Varavazhaippom;
  Sundharak Kunangalataindhu, Ariviluyarndhu,
  Nirppandhangal Theerndhu, Sirandhilangita.			- Thaasare
title: Thaasare iththaraniyai anpaai

song:
Jeeva Vasanam Kooruvom - Sakodharare
Serndhe Ekkaalam Oodhuvom.

Paavikal Melurukip Paatupattu Mariththa
Jeevaadhipadhi Yesu Sindhai Makizhndhitave 		- Jeeva

1. Paadhakap Peyin Valaiyil - Aiyo! Thiral Per
  Pattu Matiyum Velaiyil,
  Pedhaimaiyotu Pitivaadha Marul Mikundhu,
  Vedhanai Thaanataiyap Povor Kadhiperave 		- Jeeva

2. Naatu Thanile Alaindhom; - Kirisdhuvinaal
  Karththan Oozhiyaththil Amarndhom;
  Naatu, Nakar, Kiraaman Theti Naam Petrataindha
  Nalla Eevu Varangal Ellaarung Kantataiya 		- Jeeva

3. Poolokam Engum Nammaiye - Kirisdhu Naadhar
  Pokach Cholli Vidhiththaare; 
  Kaalaa Kaalangalilum Kootiyiruppom, Endra 
  Karththan Vaakkai Ninaindhu Eththesamun Thirindhu	- Jeeva

4. Vinnin Makimai Thurandhaar; - Kirisdhu Namai
  Meetkak Kurusil Irandhaar; 
  Mannin Pukazh, Perumai Ellaam Thoosi Kuppai En
  Rennich Chiluvaidhanai Etuththu Makizhchchiyotu 	- Jeeva
title: Jeeva vasanam kooruvom

song:
1. Meloka Varalaaru Solla Vaanjikkiren.
  Yesuvum Makimaiyum Krisdhuvum Ullanpum
  Meyyendru Ariven Naan. Solla Aasikkindren
  En Aaval Poorththiyaakum Nesar Maa Anpinaal

  Mannil En Vaanjai Yesu Varalaaru Solvadhe
  Vinnil Yesuvum Anpum Paatum Porul Endrum

2. Arpudha Varavaaru Solla Vaanjikkiren
  Kanavu Ninaivirkum Ettaa Adhisayam
  Naan Petra Nanmai Pala Solla Aasikkindren
  Toon Nanmaikatkaakave Idhondre Un Thevai 		- Mannil

3. Solla Solla Inpam Thevittaadha Vaanjai
  Sollum Podhellaam Inpa Adhisaya Anpu
  Aadhma Ratchippin Seydhi Palar Kettadhillai
  Vedha Thooya Saththiyam Solla Vaanjikkiren	 	- Mannil
title: Meloka varalaaru solla vaanjikkiren

song:
1. Theeyor Solvadhaik Kelaamal, Paavaththukku Vilaki,
  Parikaasaraich Cheraamal, Nallaarotu Pazhaki,
  Karththar Thandha Vedham Nampi, Vaanjai Vaiththu Adhaiththaan
  Raappakalum Odhum Gnaani Endrum Vaazhum Paakkiyavaan.

2. Nadhi Oraththil Vaataamal, Natappattu Valarndhu,
  Kani Thandhu Udhiraamal Ilai Endrum Pasandhu
  Asaivindrik Kaatraith Thaangum Maram Polave Nirpaan;
  Avan Seyvadhellaam Vaaikkum Aasirvaadham Peruvaan.

3. Theeyor Padhar Pol Nillaamal Theerppu Naalil Ozhivaar,
  Nallor Sapaiyil Seraamal, Vetki Naindhu Azhivaar.
  Inge Paavi Sezhiththaalum, Paavap Palan Naasandhaan
  Inge Nallon Thukkiththaalum, Karththar Veettil Makizhvaan.
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Theeyor solvadhaik kelaamal

song:
1. Um Vaasa Sdhalaththul, Ummai Vanangumpati, Thevane,
  Sandhoshamaaip Pravesippom; Um Paadhappati Panivom.

2. Karththaavin Naal Marakkavum, Adhai Asattai Pannavum,
  Poolokaththin Ullaasame Emmai Izhukka Maattaadhe.

3. Um Thooyadhaana Siththaththai Arindhu, Um Pramaanaththaik
  Kaik Kollumaaru, Thevareer, Sakaayanj Cheyyak Kataveer
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Um vaasasdhalaththul, ummai

song:
1. Velainaal Aarum Sendru Oivunaal
  Aarampamaayitre, En Nenjame
  Peraaseer Naalaam Idhil Oindhita
  Ezhundhitaayo? Aa! En Nenjame.

2. Aadhi Aaru Naal Akilaththaiyum
  Anta Saraasaram Anaiththaiyum
  Aantavan Aakki, Ezhaam Naalaiye
  Oindhaasariththaar Ninai Nenjame.

3. Seenaai Malaimel Karththar Karpiththaar
  Poodhalam Utra Podhum Oindhaar Kaan
  Theerkkar Pidhaakkal, Vedha Pakdharkal
  Oindhaar Innaale Aadhi Mudhalaai.

4. Theyvaaseervaadham Vaaindha Oivunaal,
  Pataippu Manam Kamazh Oivunaal,
  Immai Marumai Maaraa Oivu Naal,
  Mey Isravelar Sapai Kootum Naal.

5. Lowkeeka Velai Thozhil Akatri
  Theyva Mukam Thirumpu Nenjame,
  Maanati Veezhndhu Naamam Potriye
  Jepiththuth Thetu Avar Aasiyai.
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Velai naal aarum sendru oivunaal

song:
1. Karththar Aasariththa Oivu Maravaadhe,
  Vaara Naalil Sirandha Sopidha Thiname,
  Lowkeeka Joli Neekki Unnadhak Kalippu
  Vintala Jodhiyotu Innaal Udhiththadhu.
  
  Vaazhka Vaazhka! Endrum Vaazhka! Oivu Thiname!
  Vaazhka Vaazhka! Endrum Vaazhka! Oivu Thiname!

2. Oivai Yaasariththu Unnadhanaith Thozhu;
  Seetarkku Yesu Sonnaar Naane Jeevavazhi
  Ratchakaraip Pinsendru Thaazhmaiyaai Jeeviththaal
  Niththiyamaaip Paaindhotum Jeeva Thanneer Eevaar.

3. Parisuththa Inpam, Paalakar Yesuvaip
  Panivutan Kontaati, Vaazhththith Thozhuvadhe
  Alavilaath Thayave; Anpin Iratchakar
  Aruliya Nalvaakku Thetrudhe Manadhai.
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Karththar aasariththa oivu

song:
1. Oivu Keedham! Oivu Keedham! Inpa Thiru Keedhame!
  Matra Raakam Maasutradhe; Maname Nee Ventaadhe

  Oivu Keedham! Oivu Keedham!
  Un Raakam Ketkave Aaval
  Maasu Karai Unnil Illai
  Nesikkiren Naan Unnaiye.

2. Atiyaarkkuch Chamaadhaanam Anpirakkam Un Keedham;
  Ratchakarai Paavikatku Kaattuvadhe Un Joli.

3. En Aayulin Kaalamattum Nesippen Oivu Keedham;
  Meetkappatta Koottaththotu Paatuven Pin Motchaththil
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Oivu keedham! Oivu keedham!

song:
1. O! Oivu Supa Thinam, Mana Makizhchchi Naal,
  O! Aadhisaya Thailam Kaalai Maatrum Naal
  Unnil Pakdharkal Kooti, Karththaraith Thozhave
  Thooya! Thooya! Thooyena, Potrip Paatitave.

2. Nee Or Nar Thuraimukam, Ezhal Puyal Ara,
  Orazhakiya Thottam, Paradhees Ootrura;
  Varanta Jeeviyaththai, Kulirppikkindraaye!
  Pyoolaavaik Kaattukindra Piskaa Malai Neeye!

3. Inpaththor Thiyaana Thinam, Naan Aasikkindra Naal
  Manninindru Manadhai Vinnirkizhukkum Naal
  Endrum Pudhuk Kirupai, Indha Naal Eekudhe,
  Ponnakar Musippaaral, Thetitach Cheykudhe!
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: O! Oivu supadhinam

song:
1. Oivunaal Pallikootame! Maa Inpa Sdhalame!
  Maata Maalikaikalilum Neeye En Makizhchchi.

  Perinpa Sdhalame! Oivu Naal Veetadhe!
  En Aaththumaa Unnai Vaanjiththuk Kadharukiradhu.

2. Naan Kettalaindha Kaalaththil, Inpa Ratchakarai;
  Kantu Avar Sol Kettadhu Unnitaththil Thaane.

3. Jeeva Appam Jeeva Thanneer Unnitam Irukka;
  Endrum Unnai Marappeno? En Oivu Naal Veete!
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Oivunaal pallikootame!

song:
1. En Aapdha Nanpar Avar Mika Sirandhavar,
  Patchaththotu Ennil Avar Anpu Koorukiraar.
  Avarillaamal Vaazhndhiten Avaril En Anpu.
  Nilaiththu Nirkudhe, En Kaaththaave!

2. En Pelaveenaththaiyum Mutrilum Arivaar,
  Avaril Saayum Azhaippai Naan Naatukirene;
  Velichchaththin Nal Paadhaiyil Nataththuvaar Ennai.
  Ummotu Natakkiren En Karththaave!

3. En Thunpa Thukkangalai Avaritam Solven.
  Ena Mana Rammiyangalai Avaritam Solven.
  Avare En Vazhikalai Nanku Karpikkiraar.
  Ummotu Pesukiren, En Karththaave!
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: En aapdha nanpar avar mika

song:
1. Perinpa Nidhya Veetange
  Maarudhal Thunpame Illai
  Per Aaseer Inpam Mel Veettil
  Aanandham Ilaippaaruvom.

  Kaaththu ..... Manath Thaazhmaiyotiru
  Jepi ..... Porumaiyotu Nampi
  Kaaththu ..... Jepi.... Kaaththu Nampiyiru.

2. Siluvaip Paatukal Pata 
  Paaril, Thevan Siththam Kontaal
  Inpa Veetu Sera Naatu
  Manath Thaazhmaiyaaik Kaaththiru.

3. Pokum Paadhaiyil Mul Kantaal
  Thuyar Thukkam Nenjil Kontaal
  Thooyar Nenjin Thuyar Ninai
  Inpa Veetu Naatiththetu.

4. Velai Katinam Endraalum
  Jepi, Permoochchu Maravaar
  Ilaippaarum Naal Vitiyum
  Makizhndhang Kilaippaaruvom.
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Perinpa nidhya veetange

song:
1. Nampuvorkku Naan Unmaiyaayiruppen
  Kataatchip Porkku Suththavaanaaven
  Kashta Maayinum Unmaiyaayiruppen
  Endrum Thairiyasaaliyaai Iruppen (2)

2. Aapdha Nanpanaai Iruppen Ellorkkum
  Naan Thaanam Seyven Edhir Nokkaamal
  Pelaveenaththil Thaazhmaiyaayiruppen
  Nakaiththu Nesaththote Nokkuven (2)

3. Naalukku Naal Pidhaavin Vaarththaikalai
  Itaivitaamal Katruth Theruven
  Thaamadhamindri Avar Sapdham Ketpen
  Avar Sorpati Niraivetruven (2)
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Nampuvorkku naan unmaiyaayiruppen

song:
1. Yesuvin Paadhaththaruke Avar Arul Ketkiren
  Andraata Aanandhap Ponnaal Endrum Ennaich Chandhikka
  Yesuvin Paadhaththaruke Sendra Kaalam Kaankiren
  Avar Anpe Arulaaka Ennai Mutrum Vendradhe.

2. Maandhar Arul Perumitam Thevap Paadhath Tharuke
  Paava Thukkam Samarppiththe Ilaippaaral Peruven
  Yesuvin Paadhamamarndhe Azhudhu Jepikkiren
  Avaradhu Pooranaththin Thevai Yaavum Peruven.

3. Aaseervadhiyum Ratchakaa Paadham Kaaththirukkiren.
  Arut Kannaal Ennaik Kaanum; Arul Mukam Kaanpiyum
  Suththa Idhayam Aliththe Mutrum Pooranamaakkum
  Needhiyin Oli Yesuvin Prasannaththaip Peruven.
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Esuvin paadhaththaruke

song:
1. En Pidhaavin Lokam En Kaadhukal Ketka
  Immantalaththin Isaikal Thonikkudhe Thelivaai

  En Pidhaavin Lokam Malai Virutchangal
  Avar Sirushtiththaarena Naan Aarudhal Kolven
  
2. En Pidhaavin Lokil Kaalaip Pozhudhinil
  Paravaikalin Paadalkal Paraisaatru Kindradhe

3. En Pidhaavin Lokam Naan Endrum Maraven
  Mosam Neritta Podhilum Avare En Karththar.
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: En pidhaavin lokam en

song:
1. Pakalon Kadhir Polume Yesuvin Raajareekame
  Poolokaththil Viyaapikkum Neetoozhi Kaalam Varththikkum.

2. Parpala Jaadhi Thesaththaar Arpudha Anpaip Potruvaar;
  Paalarum Inpa Osaiyaai Aaraadhippaar Sandhoshamaai.

3. Nal Meetpar Iraajyam Engume Sireshta Paakyam Thangume;
  Thunputror Aarith Theruvaar, Thikkatror Vaazhndhu Poorippaar.

4. Pooloka Maandhar Yaavarum Vaanorin Senaiththiralum
  Saashtaangam Seydhu Potruvaar Neer Vaazhka, Raayare! Enpaar.
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Pakalon kadhir polume

song:
1. Karththarin Sannidhi Indru Naam Kootinom
  Avar Prasannaththil Thetinom
  Inge Naam Avarin Anpile Moozhkinom
  Avarai Antiye Selluvom.

  Karththardhaan En Oli Naan Indru Makizhven
  Avarkkendru Oli Veesuven Aa! Avvanpendrume
  Ennai Aatkollume Avaril Endrume Poorippen.

2. Aa! Indha Poovile Aantavark Kendrennai
  Atimaiyaakave Eevene 
  Avarin Kaanikkai En Jeevan En Aasdhi
  Ellaam Avarkkendru Eevene.

3. Inge Naam Kootinom Kempeeram Kolluvom
  Paraththil Nam Aasdhi Mikudhi.
  Aa! Andha Veettaiye Naatiye Selluven
  Adhuve Endrendrum En Kadhi.
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Karththarin sannidhi indru

song:
1. En Vaarththaikalil Edhuvum Vaazhkkaiyin Irul Neekka
  En Paadalkalil Edhuvum Idhaya Paaram Neekka
  
  Pesa Udhavum Thevane Udhavi Tharum Vaarththai
  Edhiroli Thonikkudhe Thaniththa Pallaththaakkil.

2. En Anpin Aravanaippaal Kashtaththai Inidhaakka
  En Samratchaniyinaale Thuridhavanaai Maara.

3. Uyarththudhalinaaleye Katinam Lakuvaakka
  Anpum Pelanum Nalkitum Avarukkaaka Vaazha.
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: En vaarththaikalil edhuvum

song:
1. Oivunaal Vinnil Kontaatukindror
  Perinpa Menmai Yaar Kooravallor?
  Veerarkkuk Kireetam Thoindhor Sukippaar;
  Thevandhaam Yaavilum Yaavum Aavaar.

2. Raaja Singaasana Maatchimaiyum,
  Angullor Vaazhvum Samaadhaanamum,
  Ivai Ellaang Kantarindhoril Yaar
  Avvannam Maandharkku Nankuraippaar?

3. Meychchamaadhaana Tharisanamaam
  Akkarai Erusalem Enpom Naam;
  Aasikkum Nanmai Kaikootum Ange,
  Ventudhal Orkaalum Veen Aakaadhe.

4. Seeyonin Keedhaththaip Paataadhangum
  Thatukka Elumo Eththollaiyum?
  Perarul Eendhitum, Thevane, Neer
  Pakdharin Sdhodhram Endrume Erpeer.

5. Angulla Oivunaal Niththiyamaam,
  Vitidhal, Mutidhal Illaadhadhaam;
  Thoodharum Pakdharum Oyaamale
  Or Jeya Keerththanam Paatuvaare.

6. Paapilon Pondra Ippaarin Sirai
  Meentu, Nam Thesam Poich Cherum Varai,
  Erusalemai Naam Ippozhudhum
  Vaanjiththu Engith Thaviththituvom.

7. Thandhaiyinaalum, Kumaaranilum,
  Aaviyin Moolamum Yaavum Aakum;
  Thiriyeka Thevanai Vin Mannullaar
  Saashtaangamaai Veezhndhu Vaazhththituvaar.
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Oivunaal vinnil kontaatukindror

song:
1. Oivunaal Idhuve Pelan Ataindhita
  En Kalaippulla Ullaththil Ootritum Aaviyai

2. Samaadhaanaththin Naal Kashttaththin Alaikalum
  Neengip Pokavum Nirappum Samaadhaanaththinaal

3. Jepaththin Naal Idhil Em Idhayangalai
  Uyarththi Naatita Emmaich Chandhikka Vaarume

4. Unnadha Naalinil Anuppum Aaviyai
  Ummaip Potri Nesiththita Idhayaththaiththaarum.
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Oivunaal idhuve pelan

song:
1. Vaazhka Kalippin Naal Sopidha Thiname
  Naan Endrum Vaazhththukiren Karththaa Aaseervadhiyum
  Maranath Thaazhvaaraththilirundhu
  Saavaamaiyin Aanandhaththai Ataindhita
  Naan Aasikkindren, Aasikkindren.

2. Raajaa Vandharulume, Krupaiyinaal Nirappum
  Pakdharkal Kaanumpodhu Kaattituveer Sengolai
  Paavikal Um Vaarththaikalai Unarndhu
  Karththarukkup Payappata Ariyattum
  Payappata Ariyattum, Ariyattum.

3. Aaviyaanavare Vaarum Vallamaiyotu
  Ratchakarin Anpai Velippatuththinaal
  En Aadhmaa Puththunarchchiyaip Petru
  Oivunaalai Veenaai Kazhiththitaadhe
  Veenaai Kazhiththitaadhe, Kazhiththitaadhe.
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Vaazhka kalippin naal

song:
1. Engum Niraiyum Iraiyavane
  Engatku Arut Seyyum Maraiyavane
  Ippadhin Moondraam Oivunaa Leendhitta
  Engalannal Yesaiyane -  Engu

2. Andraata Unavum Utaiyum Uraiyulum
  Anparaam Emak Keevaai Eendhanaiye
  Pirarkkeeyap Porulum Eendhemaik Kaaththa
  Annal Engal Yesaiyane

3. Kiriththuvam Enganum Eentu Muzhangita
  Kirupaiyaai Emakkarul Eendhavane
  Umdhiru Maraippati Endrum Ozhukita
  Indrum Emakkarul Eendhavane

4. Utramum Sutramum Eendhanaiye
  Ulavala Mura Aavi Vazhanginaiye
  Ulakame Uyya Undranai Eendhe
  Endhaayum Thandhaiyum Aanavane

  Jepadhudhiyum Thoththiramum Thoopangalaai
  Saatrudhu(Oo)M Umakke.
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Engum niraiyum iraiyavane

song:
Oivu Naal Pallikkootame!
 Theva Seyarkal Kooti
 Makizhndhaati Uvandhitum Nal.

1. Aaru Naal Sirushtikalai Nerutan Sirushtiththudh
  Theerththoindhirundha Karththar Naamaththaip Potri Nirkum 	- Oivu

2. Paarilulla Maandhar Yaavarum Aaru Naalin Velaikalaidh
  Theerththu Ilaippaara Vendrum Karththar Arulich Cheydha	- Oivu

3. Siruvar, Sirumiyarum, Vaaliparum, Mudhiyorum Theva
  Thiru Vaarththaikalaich Chindhiththunarach Cheyyum		- Oivu

4. Kettuppona Aaththumaakkal Kitti Vandhesuvaich Chera
  Thittamutan Velai Seyyap Petradhor Nallitame			- Oivu

5. Theva Raajyaththirkendru Aavalotu Edhirpaarththu,
  Thevanin Arulaip Petru Neetoozhi Vaazhach Cheyyum		- Oivu

6. Ezhaamnaal, Sapai Indrum Engum Perukivara,
  Mangaa Nalloli Veesa Neengaadha Meyyaana			- Oivu

7. Karththarin Kirupaikalai Nidhya Kaalame Sindhikka
  Saththiyaththinaale, Theva Siththam Ariyach Cheyyum		- Oivu

title: Oivu naal pallikkootame

song:
Oivu Naal Idhu, Maname Thevanin
Uraiyaith Thiyaananj Chey Kavaname.

Neya Thandhaiyar Seyark Kudhaviya
Neri Ich Chuvisesha Vasaname 			- Oivu

1. Jeeva Suka Puththira Selvam Thandhavar
  Sevati Unak Kapayame;
  Mevi Avar Kiru Paasanaththin Mun
  Ventikkol, Idhu Samayame				- Oivu

2. Aaru Naalunak Kaliththavar, Ilaip
  Paari Ezhinil Kaliththavar;
  Koorum Poorana Aaseervaadhaththaik
  Kuriththunai Idhar Kazhaikkiraar. 			- Oivu

3. Karththar Aasanam Kurakik Kel Indru
  Kaalai Nan Pakal Maalaiyum;
  Suththam Virumpuvor Maaththiram Vandhu
  Thudhikkath Thakum Ith Thevaalayam		- Oivu

4. Aadhma Thekam Nee Katavutkup Pataip
  Paatra Nar Supa Naalidhe;
  Araiyile Samusaara Jepam Seyvor
  Ataivar Palanidhil Adhaname. 			- Oivu

title: Oivu naal idhu maname

Oivu Naal Idhu Sapaiye - Thevan
Uvandhunak Karulinaare

Aadhalaal Avar Thiru Aalayam Ekuvom
Vaa Thiruch Chapaiyore

1. Puvi Vaan Uyir Pataiththu - Thevan
  Pukazhotu Thozhil Mutiththu
  Aaru Thinam Sendrezhinil Amarndhanar
  Aa! Thiruch Chapaiyore. 				- Oivu

2. Velai Jolikal Niruththi - Namadhu
  Thevanai Munniruththi,
  Kaalai Maalai Thavaraadhu Thevaalayam
  Varuveer Sapaiyore. 				- Oivu

3. Karththar Vasanam Kettu - Adhaip
  Paththiram Akam Vaiththu
  Karpanai Naankinil Karththaruraippati
  Kaa Thiruchchapaiyore. 				- Oivu

song:
Aa! Yemakkaai Nal Oivu Naalai
 Anpaai Amaiththaar En Paranaar

 Poomiyin Solaiyil Oivu Kolla
 Pooloka Meetparaip Potrik Kolla   		- Aa! Yema

1. Aarudhal Pakdhiyum Aavi Mazhai
  Anpai Yemmai Ninaiththitavum
  Therudhal Konte Oivunaalai
  Thiramaai Nalamaai Aasarippom 		- Aa! Yema

2. Aaviyin Perarul Ventituvom
  Aanandham! Peyinai Vendrituvom
  Saavai Vendru Ponavaraich
  Saatrip Potrip Paatituvom 			- Aa! Yema

3. Ennenna Sodhanai Vandhitinum
  Erpaai Oivu Kaaththitavum
  Mannanaam Thevanin Kattalaiyai
  Mannan Sorpati Kaik Kolvom 		- Aa! Yema

4. Suvaami Nin Thaasaraip Nokkip Paarum
  Pillaikalendre Ennik Kaarum
  Paraloka Oivil Kali Koora
  Parisuththa Sapaiyaaik Kaaththukkollum.  - Aa! Yema
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Aa! Emakkaai nal oivunaalai

song:
Aaseervaadham Parisuththam Aana Naal Innaal Thaane.

 Yesu Naadhar Niyamiththa Inpamaana Oivu Naal 			- Aaseer

1. Edhen Solai Thannile Erpatuththappatta Naal;
  Aadhaam Evaal Iruvarum Aasariththa Oivu Naal. 			- Aaseer

2. Aapel Mudhalaana Mey Aantavarin Pillaikal
  Paapel Maindhar Kaanave Pakdhiyotaasariththa Naal  		- Aaseer

3. Paarvon Munne Ekipdhil Pakdharkal Oindhirundha Naal;
  Saarvor Yaarkkum Parisuththam Naan Kotukkum Theyva Naal	- Aaseer

4. Mur Pidhaakkal Moovarum Mose Varai Yaavarum
  Karpanai Kotukkum Mun Kaaththu Vandha Oivu Naal.		- Aaseer

5. Seenaai Malaimel Nindru Theyvam Ariviththa Naal;
  Thaane Karpalakaiyil Than Viralaal Varaindha Naal.		- Aaseer

6. Yekovaa Isravelin Theyvamendru Kaanpikka
  Thamadhatai Yaalamaai Thandha Parisuththa Naal 		- Aaseer

7. Paapilon Siraikkuppin Pakdhan Nekemiyaavum
  Panpaai Seer Thiruththamum Seydha Thiru Naalidhe		- Aaseer

8. Oivu Naalin Aantavar Thondrinaar Ip Poovile;
  Unnadhanaar Neriyutan Ozhukinaar Tham Naalile		- Aaseer

9. Oivu Naalaa Sarippai Yoodhar Paaram Pariyaththaal
  Thirivupata Seydhadhaal Thiruththinaar Nar Seykaiyaal		- Aaseer

10.Aadhi Apposdhalarkal Aadhi Sapaiyaarutan
  Adhi Vinaya Pakdhiyaai Aasariththa Oivu Naal			- Aaseer

11.Indrum Pakdhar Kontaatum Yekovaavin Inpanaal
  Endrum Pudhiya Poomiyil Meetkappattor Thozhukai Naal	- Aaseer
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Aaseervaadham parisuththam

song:
Oivu Naaladhai Sdhaapith Tharuliya
 Unnadhaa Umakke Sdhoththiram.

 Maaivilaa Maraiyai Yaam Manadhil Utkontu
 Vaazhththi, Ummaip Pukazhndhu Potra Vaaivintu	 	- Oivu

1. Thekak Kavalai, Thozhil, Yaavaiyum Ozhikka
  Thivya Sindhaiyaal Engal Idhayame Sezhikka;
  Ekan Ninarul Petring Kikal Ara Azhikka,
  Evarum Oivu Naalaiyk Kontaatiye Kalikka			- Oivu

2. Vinnorutan Yaavarum Aaviyil Koota,
  Vedhaa Ummaip Pukazhndhu Mangalam Paata,
  Man Ulakil Poraatta Saalaiyil Ota,
  Varam Aliththita Ummaik Kenji Mandraata 		- Oivu

3. Muththi Vazhi Vilakkum Thurkkunam Maatri,
  Mun Nindremmai Nataththiye Karai Etri,
  Eththesaththaarum Ummai Ekamaaip Potri
  Irainja Arulum Umadhaaviyai Ootri			- Oivu
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Oivu naaladhai sdhaapith tharuliya

song:
Ezhaam Naal Oivu Naalena Iyampum Inpa Vedham;
 Idhanai Maruththu Meeral Adhikam Varukum Thunpam Sokam.

1. Ich Chuviseshaththinaal Endrume Silaakkiyam;
  Yesuvitam Servadharkuk Kittitum Narpaakkiyam  		- Ezhaam

2. Medhini Meedhilengum Mey Arivil Thera,
  Aaviyin Arul Niraindhu Paava Irulaip Pokka			- Ezhaam

3. Ippuviyor Evarum Sadhya Maraiyil Sera,
  Thappaana Madhangal Yaavum Thaaraniyil Maara		- Ezhaam

4. Vindhaiyutan Puviyor Yesuvantai Sera,
  Sondhamaaka Mey Maraiyaith Thandhadhume Paakyam	- Ezhaam

5. Thesamengum Paravi Seerkettoraimevi,
  Paasamutan Yesu Paadham Thaaviye Panivom			- Ezhaam
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Ezhaam naal oivu naalena

song:
Oivunaalin Aasarippai
Unmaiyaaik Kolvom; (2)
Kana Nanmaiyaip Peruvom.

1. Aadhiparan Sonnadhidhu Aneedham Naam Seyyalaamo?
  Paavikalum Seerataiyap Paadhaiyidhuve, 
  Paadhaiyidhuve, Paran Vedha Midhuve 			- Oivu

2. Aaru Naalum Velai Seydhu, Ezhaam Naalil Oindhiruppom;
  Oindhirukkum Naalaith Thevan Uraiththu Vaiththaare;
  Uraiththu Vaiththaare, Aseervadhiththu Vaiththaare	- Oivu

3. Vaakkiyaththil Sonnapati Vandhudhiththa Meendha Sapai,
  Saththiyaththai Uraikka Vandha Saatchi Idhuve;
  Saatchi Idhuve, Miku Maatchi Idhave			- Oivu

4. Thevan Sonna Oivunaalaith Thittamutan Makizhchchiyaaka
  Aasarippom Oindhu Naamum Aananng Kolvom; 
  Aanandhang  Kolvom, Paramaanandhang Kolvom	- Oivu
topic: Niyaayappiraamanamum Oivunaalum - The law and Sabbath
title: Oivu naalin aasarippai

song:
1. Ketkiren En Meetpar Saththam,
  Anpaana Kuralosaiyil;
  En Seviyil Thonikkudhu,
  En Pinne Vaa Thinam Pinne Vaa.
  
  Kurusetuththu Naan Pin Selven,
  En Nesa Meetpar Pin Selven;
  Avar Pokum Paadhaiyile,
  Avarutan Utan Pin Selven.

2. Paadhaiyo Kashtamaayinum,
  Kaal Thallaati Sorvaayinum;
  En Idhayam Poorikkudhe,
  Vazhiyellaam Um Pin Selluven

3. Yesuve, En Munne Sellum,
  Vaanoli Ennulle Veesum;
  Palam Thandhu Ennaith Thaangum,
  Vazhiyellaam Um Pin Selluven.

4. Pallaththaakkil Neer Nataththum,
  Mannaa Thandhu Poshippiyum;
  Yesuve Neer Endrum Ventum,
  Vazhiyellaam Um Pin Selluven.

5. Um Maarpil Aravanaiyum,
  Patchamaana Karangontu;
  Um Krupaiyaal Ennaith Thaangum,
  Vazhiyellaam Um Pin Selluven.
title: Ketkiren en meetpar

song:
1. Theva Aattuk Kuttiye, Lokaththaarin Meetpare,
  Ummaal Meetkappatta Naan Thevareerkkuch Chondhandhaan;
  Neer En Kottai Thanjamaam; Yaar En Vaazhvai Neekkalaam

2. Ummaip Patrum Nesaththai, Ummil Vaikkum Pakdhiyai,
  Peyum Ketta Lokamum Moorkkamaai Virodhikkum,
  Inpam, Thunpam Niththiyame Kanniyaaka Nirkume.

3. Karththare En Ullaththil Oli Veesi, Manadhil
  Andhakaaram Neekkitum; Anpin Juvaalai Etritum;
  Thooya Aavi Eevaiyum Poorththiyaaka Aliyum.

4. Endha Naazhikaiyile Neer Vandhaalum Yesuve,
  Ummai Naanum Sandhiththu, Kannaal Kantu Kaliththu,
  Vaazhvadharkuth Thinamum Saavadhaanam Eendhitum.
title: Theva aattuk kuttiye

song:
1. Poovin Narkandham Veesum Solaiyaayinum
  Nalla Thanneer Otum Pallaththaakkileyum,
  Yesunaadhar, Pin Sendreki Motcham Naatuven
  Vinnil Sootum Kreetam Nokki Otuven.
 
  Pin Sevvene! Meetpar Pin Selvene!
  Engeyum Eppodhum Pinne Selluven;
  Pin Sevvene! Meetpar Pin Selvene!
  Yesu Kaattum Paadhaiyellaam Selluven.

2. Kaar Mekam Mele Mootum Pallamenkilum
  Kaatrakoramaaka Modhum Sdhaanaththilum,
  Yesu Paadhai Kaattach Chatrum Anjave Maatten,
  Ratchakar Kai Thaangath Thairyam Kolluven.

  Neraai Amaiththa Theva Thevane!
  Thaaraai! Mandralaasiye!
  Vaaraai! Supam Serave!

  Neyane! Makaa Thooya Theva Thevane
  Seermevum Mey Manaasi Nee Thaa Vaa!
  Neyane! Makaa Thooya Theva Thevane!
  Seer Mevave Aasidhaa!

2. Naatorume Sel Paadhai Theepamaai
  Naatu Uyarndha Vedha Nool Adhaidh
  Theti Thunai Kontanpaai
  Neetiththivar Vaazhndhita!

3. Aandror Ennaalum Potrum Seyarum
  Vaandroi Sirandha Kalvi Selvamum
  Saandror Potrum Neyarum
  Thondrith Thikazh Seerarul!

4. Vaazhka Vaazhka!Endrum Immanar!
  Vaazhka! Ilangum Thandhai Thaayaarum
  Vaazhka! Sutraththaar Anpar
  Vaazhka! Supamandralum.
title: Seeraar vivaakam edhen kaavile

song:
Manavaazhvu Puvi Vaazhvinil Vaazhvu - Mangala Vaazhvu
 Maruviya Sopana Supa Vaazhvu.

1. Thunai Piriyaadhu Thokaiyimmaadhu
  Supa Mana Makalivar Idhupodhu,
  Manamuraiyodhu Vasanam Vitaadhu
  Vandhanar Umadharul Peravedhu? - Nalla 		- Mana

2. Jeeva Thayaaparaa, Sirushtiyadhikaaraa,
  Theyveeka Maa Mana Valangaraa,
  Thevakumaaraa, Thiruvellaiyooraa?
  Serndhavarkkarul Tharaadhiruppeeraa? - Nalla		- Mana

3. Kutiththana Veeram, Kunamulladhaaram
  Kotuththuk Kontaal Adhu Samusaaram
  Atakkam, Aasaaram, Anpu, Udhaaram
  Ampuvidhanil Manaikkalangaaram - Nalla		- Mana

4. Mandral Seydhevi, Manaalanukkaavi,
  Mandhiram, Avarkkurai Medhaavi,
  Andriyip Poovi Amirdha Sanjeevi;
  Avalaith Thallupavan Oru Paavi - Nalla			- Mana
title: Mana vaazhvu puvi vaazhvinil

song:
Kunam Ingidha Vativaai Uyar Kove Yesudheve!
Munam Ingidha Valamaai Ura Varuveer, Mesiyaave!

1. Mandral Seydhu Manaipukum Mana
 Vaalane Tanaivarum
 Than Thunaiyaana Mangaiyum Inge
 Thazhaikka Arul Thaarum 				 - Kunam

2. Aadhi Maanitark Kaana Or Thunai
 Andramaiththa Nar Podhane
 Theedhara Inaiyaam Ivarkkarul
 Seykuveer, Engal Naadhane. 			 - Kunam

3. Thondru Kaanaavil Mandral Ongitadh
 Thondriya Thayaaparane,
 Indru Mandral Sirandhita Arul
 Eendhitum, Krupaakarane				 - Kunam

4. Panpadhil Oru Maasum Kurai
 Paatillaath Theyveekane,
 Nanpadhil Iruperum Vaazhndhita
 Nannum Maa Kaarunyane 				 - Kunam

5. Utra Nal Uravorum Engal
 Urimai Aanavar Yaavarum
 Patradhaai Uru Pakdhiyotummaip
 Paata Nal Manam Thaarum. 			 - Kunam
title: Kunam ingidha vativaai

song:
Yesu Naayakaa, Vandhaalum Ennaalum Thivya
Yesu Naayakaa, Vandhaalum.

  Aaseervaadhamaaka Indha Nesa Maname Nandraaka 		- Yesu 

1. Sundharam Mikumpati Mun Andha Mana Veettil
  Undran Arul Thandha Thayaipole, Anpaale  			- Yesu

2. Uththama Sanmaarkka Neri, Pakdhi, Visuvaasam,
  Niththiya Samaadhaanam Utru Vaazha, Mika Vaazha,   		- Yesu

3. Thungam Miku Nan Kanam Vilangi Valamaaka
  Mangala Madhonga, Nalam Thaanga, Nalam Thaanga  		- Yesu

4. Niththiya Supa Sopanamo Teththisaiyinum Perukip,
  Puththira Sandhaaname Sezhikka, Thazhaikka 			- Yesu
title: Esu naayakaa, vandhaalum

song:
Indha Mangalam Sezhikkave Kirupai Seyyum.
Engal Yesu Kirisdhu Thevane.

Sundharak Kaanaavin Manap Pandhalil Sendram Panaththaik
Kandha Rasamaakach Cheydha Vindhaipol, Ingeyum Vandhu 		- Indha

1. Aadhi Thotuth Thanpai Etuththaai; Manutar Thamai
  Aanum Pennumaakap Pataiththaai;
  Needhi Varam Naalung Kotuththaai; Petrup Peruki
  Nirka Ulakaththil Vituththaai;
  Maadhavar Paniyum Vedha Podhane, Andhappati Un
  Aadharavaik Kontu Thivya Needhiyai Nampip Purindha	 		- Indha

2. Thakka Aapiraamum Vintanan; Adhanai Mana
  Thukkul Eliyesar Kontanan;
  Mukya Haaran Nilaththantinan; Ninaiththapati
  Paththiya Madhaakak Kantanan;
  Pakkuvam Uraiththitaa Repekkaalum Eesaakkuvukkudh
  Thakka Mana Vaaliyaakath Thandhu Thayai Seydhaar Pole	 	- Indha

3. Saththiya Ve Thaththin Vaasane, Arulum Pari
  Suththa Suviseta Nesane, 
  Pakdharkal Pala Vimosane, Pazhudhanuvum 
  Atra Kiris Thesu Raajane, 
  Vetriyaal Yaakkopuvukku Mutrilum Aliththa Peraai
  Puththira Sampath Thuntaakki Niththiya Supa Sopanamaai		- Indha
title: Indha mangalam sezhikkave

song:
Immanark Kunnarul Ee, Paravaasaa!
Yesuk Kirisdhaiyaa, O! Saruvesaa!

1. Semmaiyum Nanmaiyum Selvamum Thaarum;
  Thevareer Ivviruperaiyum Kaarum      		- Immanar

2. Aadhamo Tevaiyai Andramaiththeere,
  Avvidhamaaka Neer Indrum Seyveere      		- Immanar

3. Anpan Eesaakku Repekkaat Kirangi,
  Aapirakaamutan Saaraalaik Kaaththeer       	- Immanar

4. Un Thayai Petrivar Ongip Perukavum,
  Oruvarkkoruvar Nallanpil Nilaikkavum		- Immanar

5. Thaazhmai Porumaikal, Sarkuna Menmaikal
  Thandhuma Thaaviyaik Kontu Kaaththaalume  	- Immanar

6. Iyesu Kinisdhuvai Nesiththu Vaazhavum,
  Inpa Visuvaasa Veettaar Endraakavum      		- Immanar
title: Immanarkkunnarul ee, paravaasaa

song:
Mangalam Sezhikkak Kirupaiyarulum
 Mangala Naadhane.

1. Mangala Niththiya Mangala Nee
  Mangala Muththiyum Naadhanum Nee
  Engal Punga Nee Engal Thungava Nee
  Uththama Saththiya Niththiya Thaththuva Meththa Makaththuva
  Aththanukkaththanaam Aaprakaam Theva Nee 			- Mangalam

2. Manamakan .............. Avarkalukkum
  Manamakal .............. Ammaalukkum
  Maanuvelarkkum Makaanupavarkkum
  Pakdhiyutan Puththi Mukdhi Aliththitum Niththiyane Unnaidh
  Thuththiyam Seydhitum Saththiya Vedharkkum. 			- Mangalam
title: Mangalam sezhikka kirupaiyarulum

song:
1. Mana Vaazhvil Endrum Makizhndhirukkave
  Manamakkalai Naam Vaazhththip Potruvom.

  Mannan Kirisdhu Mana Makkalin Meedhu
  Ennillaadha Aasi Eendhu Kaappaare

2. Ellaiyillaa Vaazhvai Ivviruperkkum
  Valla Thevan Eendhu Vaazhvippaar Endrum 		- Mannan

3. Utror Petror Ullam Thanil Makizhchchi
  Kattukkatangaadhu Karththar Thandhaare		- Mannan

4. Paalar Pala Petru Pallaantu Vaazha
  Paatakar Yaam Paati Paaril Makizhndhom. 		- Mannan
title: Mana vaazhvil endrum

song:
1. Endhaiye! Kenjukindrom, Indhach Chiru Pillaikkaai;
  Unnadha Narulaal Idhai Endha Naalum Kaarume.

2. Indhap Pillai Endrume Undran Siththam Seydhume,
  Sandhadham Nar Seelame, Saalap Perach Cheyyume.

3. Naangalum, Em Naadhane! Paangaa Yumaip Pin Sella,
  Neengaa Them Motirundhu, Niththang Kaarum Thevane!
title: Endhaiye! Kenjukindrom

song:
Indhakkuzhandhaiyai Neer Etrukkollum, Karththaave!
  Undran Piradhishtaiyaal Umakkup Pillaiyaakkiya.	 - Indhak

1. Senai Veeranaai Vandhu Eena Saaththaanai Vendru,
  Gnaanap Pudhalvanaai En Naalum Ummaith Thudhikka 	- Indhak

2. Poi Vanjam Vanmai Pakai Pollaak Kunangal Neekki
  Mey Anpu Saththiyam Nesam Vilanga Endrum Seeraakki	- Indhak

3. Iratchippin Saththiyaththai Eththisaiyilum Koorum
  Suththa Nal Veeranaaka Iththaraiyil Vilanga 		- Indhak

4. Sanjalam Thuyar Thukkam Minjum Tharunaththilum,
  Nenjil Nin Panja Kaayam Thanjamendrunnaichchaara	- Indhak
title: Indhak kuzhandhaiyai neer etrukkollum

song:
Indhak Kuzhandhaiyai Neer Ippodhaaseervadhiyum

    Umakku Ukandha Pillaiyaaka Endrum Valara	   		- Indha

1. Pillaikal Enak Kadhikap Piriyam, Varalaam Endru
  Ulla Murukich Chonna Uththama Saththiyane 		  	- Indha

2. Paalaraik Kaiyil Endhip Panpaai Aaseervadhiththa
  Seelamaayindrum Vandhaaseer Vaadham Seyyum Aiyaa 	- Indha

3. Umak Koozhiyam Seyyavum Ummaich Chinekikkavum,
  Umadhu Aaviyaith Thandhu Umadhu Mandhaiyil Serththu	- Indha

4. Ulakamum Pey Pisaasum Ondrum Theedhu Seyyaamal,
  Nalamaai Idhaik Kaaththaalum, Nanmaip Paraaparane.	   	- Indha

5. Visuvaasaththotu Undran Meyppukku Ullatangi
  Pasiya Maram Pol Theyva Pakdhiyil Valara			  - Indha
title: Indhak kuzhandhaiyai neer

song:
Paalar Nesane - Mikap Parivu Koorndhindha
Paalarai Yendhi - Aaseervadhiyum Yesuve.

1. Paalar Vandhitadh - Thatai - Pannonaa Thendreer;
  Saala Vandharul Thandhu Thalaimer Kaivaippeer	- Paalar

2. Vaana Raajjiyam Ivar Vasaththa Thendreere;
  Piradhishtaiyaal Undran Naamanj Choottuveer    - Paalar

3. Kaanam Paatiye - Paalar Karththare Yumaidh
  Thaane, Osannaa! Enach Chaththamittaare         	- Paalar

4. Theva Paalane - Neerunj - Siriya Pillaiyaai
  Mevinee Radhaal Ummai Ventinomaiyaa  		 - Paalar

5. Aaviyaalivar Gnaana Apishekam Pera,
  Jeeva Nesare Arul Siruvark Keeveere 		- Paalar

6. Thaasar Naangal Sey Vaakkuth Thaththam Meeraamal,
  Nesa Yesuve, Yemai Nilai Niruththuveer     		- Paalar
title: Paalar nesane - mikapparivu koorndhindha

song:
Pataikkirom Ich Cheyai
Oppataikkirom Paalakanai

Karppaththin Kaniyidhu Karththarin Kirupai
Aadhiyin Vaarththai Anaivarin Paakkiyam   	- Pataikkirom

1. Utaiyunavum Uraiyoolum Petre
  Kundrin Vilakkaai Vilangattum Unakkaai
  Kaattup Pushpam Pondrum Katalaatum Machcham Pondrum
  Inidhu Vaazhndhita Iraiyarul Ventiye 		- Pataikkirom

2. Maanita Arivu Katukaana Arivu
  Mandhai Paavam Nindhaiyaip Pokkiye
  Kalvi Therchchiyum, Kalaiyutai Yunavilum
  Kannimai Pol Kaaththita Ventiye 			- Pataikkirom

3. Arivinil Therchchi Gnaanaththin Ezhuchchi
  Paarpukazh Gnaani Saalomon Polavum
  Narsukamum Neenta Naal Vaazhvaiyum
  Naatorum Petrita Nin Arul Ventiye			- Pataikkirom
title: Pataikkirom ich cheyai

song:
Piradhishtai Seyya Vaarum, Periyone Indha Veettai

 Nararaana Naangal Thinam Thudhipaati Jepiththita 	 - Piradhi

1. Naasa Ulakamadhil Vaasam Seykirapodhu 
  Nesaa! Neer Kirupaiyaa Yeendheere Ivvitaththai	 - Piradhi

2. Karththar Veetu Kattaaraakil Kattuvar Pirayaasam Veen;
  Meththavum Velaikal Seydhu Pojanam Pusippadhu Veen	 - Piradhi	

3. Indha Manaiyil Vaasam Seyyum Pillaikal Mele
  Sandhadhamum Kirupai Koorndhitum Anpinaale 		 - Piradhi

4. Akkini, Pusal, Kaatru, Aapaththuth Thunpam Thollai
  Pini, Maranam, Mosam Varaamal Kaarumaiyaa 		 - Piradhi

5. Thangi Jepikkum Janam Saththiya Aaviyinaal
  Pongip Pooriththu Pudhup Piraviyaai Maarach Cheyyum	 - Piradhi

6. Thevaa! Kaarum, Theva Thoodhar Thunaiyuminge
  Kaavalaai Nirka Venum, Kalakkamillaamal Kaarum	 - Piradhi

7. Niththiya Veetu Paralokaththil Emakkuntu;
  Pakdhiyullorkkaai Yesu Vaiththaaradhaiye Meentu	- Piradhi	

8. Pidhaach Chudhanaaviyarkkum Thoththiram, Thoththirame;
  Aadhi Mudhale Ellaak Kaalamu Muntaakave		- Piradhi
title: Piradhishtai seyya vaarum

song:
1. Atiyaar Vental Kelum Yesuve
  Um Paadham Serndhom Thaasar Innaale
  Nal Veettaik Katta Neere Varuveer
  Um Aasidheti Vandhom Naangale.

2. Engal Nalveettil Neere Thanguveer
  Pandhiyil Neerum Koota Thanguveer
  Engal Nal Pechchil Neerum Makizhveer
  Engal Thunpaththai Inpamaakkuveer.

3. Em Veettai Innaal Pirindhu Sendru
  Engengo Thangum Ellaap Peraiyum
  Anpaai Anaiththu Aadhariththitum
  Avaraik Kaaththu Allum Pakalum.

4. Aantaantaai Engal Veetuvaraiyum
  Aaviyil Anpil Endrum Peruka
  Engal Nal Naattil Inpa Illangal
  Yesuvin Veetaai Endrum Peruka.
title: Atiyaar vental kelum yesuve

song:
1. Parama Senaikkum 
  Poolokaththaarukkum Aantavare,
  Anpu Niraindhavar, Irakkamullavar,
  Kirupai Seypavar Thevareere.

2. Makimaikkendrudhaan
  Ivvaalayaththaiye Kaanikkaiyaai 
  Pataikkak Kootinom, Piradhishtai Seykirom.
  Kontaati Nirkirom, Aanandhamaai.

3. Uyarndha Vaanamum 
  Visaala Poomiyum Niraindha Neer 
  Thayavaik Kaanpikka, Sapaiyaich Chandhikka, 
  Inge Prakaasikka, Vandharulveer.

4. Oozhiyar, Janangal 
  Seluththum Jepangal Maa Thayavaai,
  Inge Kettarulum, Kirupai Kaanpiyum,
  Kettorai Ratchiyum Vallamaiyaai.

5. Ippodhu Ingeyum 
  Pin Motcha Veettilum, Umakkendre, 
  Kanamun Thudhiyum, Anputan Nandriyum, 
  Endrendrum Ezhuppum, Aantavare.
title: Parama senaikkum poolokaththaarukkum

song:
1. Thozhane! Un Jeevan Inge Endrendraikkum Nirkumaa?
  Thondrip Pokum Pukai Pola Adhu Neengum Allavaa?
  Aayul Naalai, Aayul Naalai Nee Aadhaayam Pannikkol.

2. Ivvulakil Ulla Porul Nilaiyaamal Neengume;
  Paraloka Pokkishangal Endrendraikkum Nirkume;
  Thitan Kontu, Thitan Kontu Adhaiye Nee Thetikkol.

3. Maandhar Menmai, Mettimaikal, Pullaip Pol Ularndhupom; 
  Lokak Kalvi Yosanaikal Seekkiram Ozhindhupom;
  Pelavaanum, Pelavaanum Pelanatravan Aavaan.

4. Theka Sosdhamullavarkal Ninaiyaadha Neraththil,
  Mannukkuth Thirumpuvaarkal; Idhai Enni, Thozhane!
  Ippozhudhe, Ippozhudhe Un Ratchippaith Thetikkol.

5. Saavin Mele Jeyangonta Yesu Naadhar Varuvaar,
  Thanakkul Saavai Ataindha Ellaarai Uyirppippaar.
  Nidhya Jeevan, Nidhya Jeevan Eevaai Thangdharuluvaar.
title: Thozhane! Un jeevan inge

song:
1. Karththaave Atiyaarukku Ataikkalam Neere;
  Sakaayam Seyyumpatikku Ezhundharulveere.

2. Umadhu Sannidhaanaththil Makizhchchi Ataivom,
  Umadhu Kaiyai Neettukil Anjaamal Natappom.

3. Malaikal Thondrum Munname Anaadhi Kaalamaai
  Suyampuvaai Irundheere, Iruppeer Nidhyamaai.

4. Aayiram Aantu Umakku Or Naalaip Polaame;
  Yukangal Thevareerukku Or Imaik Koppaame.

5. Saavukkullaana Maanitar Nilaikkave Maattaar,
  Ularndha Poovaippol Avar Udhirndhu Pokiraar.

6. Karththaave! Atiyaarukku Ataikkalam Neere;
  Sakaayam Seyyumpatikku Ezhundharulveere.
title: Karththaave! Atiyaarukku

song:
1. Thoongi Nanpane! Un Aardhalatai
  Paangaai Un Kaiyai Meetpar Maarpil Vai;
  Em Anpinum Meetpar Anpadhikam
  Thoongu! .... Thoongu! .... Thoongu!

2. Paalan Nidhrai Poluna Thamaidhal
  Kaalai Velai Seydhu Ini Azhaai;
  Aazhndha Thun Nidhrai Neenta Naalalla,
  Thoongu! .... Thoongu! .... Thoongu!

3. Uyirththezhum Maanpu Moolumattum,
  Meetparkkul Mariththor Ezhumattum,
  Natpin Thotramindri Varumattum,
  Thoongu! .... Thoongu! .... Thoongu!

4. Theyvanpin Sopidha Maakumattum,
  Theyva Saayal Ner Vimpikku Mattum,
  Thuyyanun Ponmuti Soottu Mattum,
  Thoongu! .... Thoongu! .... Thoongu!
title: Thoongi nanpane! Un

song:
1. Uyirth Thezhumpung Kaalai Thannil Aavi Thekang Kootavum,
  Thukkam Neengum, Olam Oyum; Novum Pom.

2. Eengavai Siridhu Neenga Narar Ilaippaaravum,
  Thooya Amaidhiyil Thangith Thoongitum.

3. Serndha Aavi Thekam Thammai Appaal Pirikkaa Thendrum,
  Kirisdhu Saayalai Anindhu Poorikkum.

4. Uyirththezhumpum Naalin Maatchi Yaaraal Solli Mutiyum?
  Niththiya Kaalam Maa Sandhosham Nilaikkum.

5. Andha Paakkiya Naalil Karththar Maantor Kuzhi Meeluvaar;
  Petror, Makkal Sutraththaarum Kootuvaar.

6. Niyaayath Theerppil, Um Siluvai Patrum Naangal Yesuve,
  Makizhum Akkoottanj Cherach Cheyyume.
title: Uyirththezhumpung kaalai thannil

song:
Mariththor Evarum Uyirththezhuvaar;
 Vaanath Thekkaalath Thoni Muzhanga

 Eripukai Meka Radha Meri
 Yesu Makaa Raajan Varungaal 			- Mariththor

1. Thoodhar Min Naatrisai Thulanga,
  Jodhi Vaan Parai Iti Muzhanga,
  Paadhakar Nenjam Natunatunga,
  Parisuththor Thiral Manadhilanga 			- Mariththor

2. Vaanam Puviyum Vaiyakamum
  Mata Mata Vendru Nilai Peyara,
  Aana Porulellaam Akandrota,
  Avaravar Tham Tham Varisaiyile 			- Mariththor

3. Azhivul Loraai Vidhaikkappattor
  Azhiyaa Meniyai Anindhituvaar;
  Eliya Roopamaai Vidhaikkappattor
  Endrum Vaazhum Jodhiyaai 			- Mariththor

4. Samuththiram Thannil Vizhundhorai,
  Tharai, Thee, Thaamum Thindroraich
  Samoolam Thandhu Kanappozhudhil
  Saruvesar Natuth Theervaikkendre 		- Mariththor
title: Mariththor evarum uyirththezhuvaar

song:
1. Nesa Thozhare! Vaarume! 
  Nidhya Vaazhvurap Paarume! 
  Madhuvilakkuch Changaththile
  Vaanjaiyaai Ippodhe Serume!
 
  Serumen! Serume! 
  Madhu Vilakku Sangaththile
  Serumen! Serume!
  Vaanjaiyaai Ippodhe Serume!

2. Veenil Alaindhu Povadhaa? 
  Viski, Piraandhiyinaal Saavadho? 
  Aanavam Enpaarkal Allavo!
  Aakaiyaal Ippodhe Serume!
 
3. Sukaveenamum, Thunpamum 
  Sodhanai, Poraattam Payamum 
  Illaamal, Vaazha Virumpinaal
  Ippodhe, Thappaadhe Serume!

4. Vaana Senaiyum Makizhum,
 Valla Pidhaavume Pukazhum, 
 Meetparum Aaviyum Vaazhththave 
 Ventumenraal Ippo Serume! 

5. Ikaththil Sukam Vaazhkkaiye, 
 Paraththil Keerththiyin Serkkaiye,
 Enrenrum Motcha Paakkiyame, 
 Ventumaanaal Indre Serume!
title: Nesa thozhare! Vaarume!

song:
Thozhare! Serndhu Vaarungal, 
 Saaraayam Thallum Koottaththil, 
 Senaiyaaik Kootik Kolluvom;
 Kootik Kolluvom; Kootikkolluvom;
 Theva Naamaththai Menmai Yaakkuvom.

1. Kaal Kaikal Thalarndhu Pom - Pela
  Saalikal Koonippom Thalai 
  Moolaikal Pedhamaam, Sevik
  Kelvikal Kundrippom, Kannin 
  Kaatchikal Maraindhupom, Aadhalaal 
  Thaadhaa Pondra Saaraayangalai 
  Thaamadhamindrith Thallippotungal		- Thozhare

2. Kutiyinaal Kettavar Palar, 
  Kutiyinaal Seththavar Palar, 
  Kutiyinaal Noiththavar Palar,
  Kutiyinaal Ilaiththavar Palar, 
  Kutiyinaal Kalaiththavar Palar, 
  Thaadhaa Pondra Madhupaanangalai
  Mana Verupputan Thallip Potungal			- Thozhare

3. Thevanin Anpu Kooravum,
  Jeevanil Pangu  Peravum.
  Suththaraai Valarndhu Pari 
  Suththaraith Tharisiththaalavum. 
  Sapaiyai Neer Alangarikkavum 
  Saaraayangalaith Thalli Jeeva 
  Jalaththaip Paanamaaik Kutiththu Vaarungal  	- Thozhare
title: Thozhare! Serndhu vaarungal

song:
Aiyaiyo! Madhi Thaano? Madhu
Paanam Arundhaleno?

1. Vaiyakamum Adhin Menmaikalum Ava
  Maa Mendrunarndhanaiye! - Pinnum
  Meyyazhivu Seyyum Peerum Piraandhiyum,
  Viskiyum Nerththanaiyo! Nesaa! 			- Aiyaiyo

2. Sarppaththaip Polave Theentiyun Meniyaidh
  Thaan Kollai Kollum Adhu; - Neeyo
  Thurp Puththiyaale Mayangi Maruntu Veen
  Thondharai Serppadhedhu? Nesaa! 		- Aiyaiyo

3. Maanamum Pokum, Makimaiyum Pokum
  Mariyaadhaiyum Pokum - Ava 
  Maanamum Maa Pelaveenamum, Oonamum   
  Vandhu Soozhalaakum - Nesaa! 			- Aiyaiyo

4. Kankal Sivandhu, Kai, Kaalkal Thalarndhiru 
  Kaadhukalum Ataikkum - Kaayap 
  Punkalum, Vaandhiyum, Ponnaana Meniyil
  Pooshanamaaip Patiyum - Nesaa! 			- Aiyaiyo

5.  Kutiththavan Pechchu Pazhippallavo Sevi 
  Koorththu Ketpaaro? - Mikap 
  Paththavanendraalum Mataththaname Yenpar 
  Paazhungutiyin Seero? - Nesaa!  S 			- Aiyaiyo 

6. Puththiyung Kettup Porumaiyung Kettup 
  Pukazhutampung Kettu Theva 
  Paththiyum Kettup Paran Kirupaiyung Kettup   
  Pazhippuk Kaalaakaadhe! Nesaa! 			- Aiyaiyo

7. Kutiyar, Veriyar, Madhuppaanap Piriyar    
 Kolaikaarar Aavar Nisam! - Ivar,   
 Mutivu Payangaram Motchamumillai 
 Mutiyaa Thivar Naasam Nesaa! 			- Aiyaiyo
title: Aiyaiyo! Madhidhaano?

song:
Thenilum Iniya Nesare - Satruch
 Sevikotuth Thenaik Kelum! Madhu
 Paanamaam Vishaththaip Paananj Cheyyaadheer,
 Paampaam Adhu Naalum.

1. Eththanai Perkal Kutiyinaal Matindhaar!
  Idhayam Natungitudhe! - Perum
  Piththaraip Polach Chaaraayam Arundha
  Pedhaikal Ekitudhe					- Thenilum

2. Penkalai Yizhandhu, Pillaikal Alaindhu,
  Pichchai Ketkavumaachche! - Iraththak
  Kankalum, Mukaththil Punkalum Vilangak
  Kaaranamadhu Vaachche! 				 - Thenilum

3.  Veettilum Por, Veliyilum Por Than  
 Meniyilum Murive! Sondha 
 Naattilum Por, Idhai Sakippa Thevvaaro!   
 Naatuveer Nal Arive! 				- Thenilum

4. Manadhilum Kalakkam, Madhiyilum Mayakkam 
 Valarum Sakdhiyum Thiyakkam; - Idhaik 
 Kanavilum Karudha Ventaam! Ventaam! 
 Kal Unnal Kolaip Pazhakkam  			- Thenilum
title: Thenilum iniya nesare satruch

song:
Maththiya Paanaththil Mika Niththiyam Karuththu Vaikkum
Maanitare, Keleer.

Puththi Umakkuntaanaal Thelindhu Kutiyum; Summaa. 	- Madh

1. Paampai Matiyil Vaippaaro? - Pazhakinaalum
  Payam Indri Adhai Moipparo 
  Vempu Kasappil, Enpaaro? - Madhukkutikka
  Virumpukindreer, Nalladho? 
  Naam Pisakom Endrum, Natandhu Thirivom, Endrum 
  Veempukal Solvadhen? Vizhuveer, Vizhuveer Kaanum 	- Madh

2. Kaipporul Izhandhitavum - Pudhalvarotu
  Kaadhali Azhundhitavum, 
  Meypporul Maraindhitavum Eri Narakil 
  Veezhndhadhil Uraindhitavum, 
  Tharparan Arul Ingu Thaan Izhakkavum Ventin 
  Eppatiyum Kutiyum Ilaiththuch Chunangik Kontu		- Madh

3. Satrum Viruppam Ventaam - Madhuvil, Adhu 
  Sadhiththuk Ketuththu Vitume; 
  Mutrum Iyesu Paran Mel - Urimaiyaaka 
  Muzhudhum Anpataindhavaraip 
  Patri Visuvaasiththu, Parakadhik Kaalaaka 
  Utramadhuk Kutiyai Utane Vitudhal Nandre  		- Madh
title: Maththiya paanaththil mika niththiyam

song:
1. Varushath Thuvakkaththil
  Vandhen Yesu Naamaththil
  
  Anjiten En Valla Meetpar,
  Thanjam Thandhu Ennaik Kaappaar
  Nenjaththil Visaaramen?
  Nesaraip Pin Patruven.

2. Varungaalam Ariyen;
  Aayinum Naan Kalangen

3. Saaththaan Vandhedhirththaalum,
  Sadhru Moorkkang Kontaalum

4. Kashtamo? Kalakkamo?
  Thushtarin Itukkamo?

5. Thikilo? Kaarirulo?
  Sedhamo? Maa Mosamo?

6. Sukamo? Viyaadhiyo?
  Thukkamo? Makizhchchiyo?

7. Menmaiyo? Maa Thaazhmaiyo?
  Meetpar Sendra Paadhaiyo?

8. Ennenna Maarudhalo?
  Ennenna Sampavamo?

9. Niththiya Yekovaa! Um
  Siththame En Paakkiyam.
title: Varushath thuvakkaththil

song:
1. Nava Varutam Nalkinaar Naadhar Yesu Namakku;
  Jeevan Sukam Arul Thandhaar Thudhi Sollip Panivom; 
  Potruvom Anudhinamum Poo Malar Sootiye.
  Potruvom! Potruvom! Potruvom!

  Makizh Kontaatik Kempeeri! Maname! Pooreeppaai;
  Vaana Thoodharutan Paati Vaazhththi Nee Kumpitu!

2. Pala Thunpam Naam Katandhom; Paran Paadhai Thotarndhom;
  Kali, Theemai Sadhi Vendrom; Karththar Meetpai Yaam Kantom;
  Aatrineer, Thayai Kaattineer; Thetrineer, Sendraantil,
  Aatrineer! Aatrineer! Aatrineer! 			- Makizh

3. Aaviyin Kani Peruka, Aantu Emai Nataththi,
  Aadhmaa Pudhu Pelanaaka, Anti Umaip Paniya,
  Aatkollum, Emai Anudhinam; Aantitum Ivvaantil
  Aatkollum! Aatkollum! Aatkollum! 			- Makizh

4. Pasi Panjam Anukaamal, Patai Santai Varaamal,
  Paadhukaaththup Paaraattitum; Paramane Krupaiyaal,
  Kaiyitum Velaiyai Ellaam Karththar! Neer Kanpaarum
  Kanpaarum! Kanpaarum! Kanpaarum! 		- Makizh
title: Nava varutam nalkinaar naadhar
Makizh kontaatik kempeeri

song:
1. Innor Aantu Mutrumaai Engalai Makaa Anpaai
  Kaaththu Vandheer. Iyesuve; Thudhi Etruk Kollume.

2. Engal Thunpan Thaazhvilum Neer Sakaayaraayirum;
  Paadhaiyillaak Kaattilum Uyyum Vazhiyaayirum.

3. Yaarenum Ivvaantinil Saavin Pallaththaakkinil
  Sendritin Um Kolaale Thetrum Nalla Meyppare.

4. Engalai Um Thaasaraai Thooimai Pakdhi Ulloraai    
  Nilai Kollach Cheydhu Neer Kireetanj Chootti Arulveer. 

5. Eka Karththaraam Neere Mannar Mannan Ennave 
  Endrum Ummaip Potruvom Undran Veettil Vaazhuvom.
title: Innor aantu mutrumaai

song:
Thoththiram, Thoththiram, Thoththirame!
Thudhi Miku Thevaa Thoththirame!

Neththiram Pol Katandhaantilellaa
Nimishamum Karunaiyaal Nidham Kaaththeer		- Thodh

1. Eththanai Aapaththu Sodhanaikal
  Emakku Neritta Palayitarkal
  Aththanaiyum Emai Anukaamal
  Aadhariththeer Pizhai Ninaiyaamal			 - Thodh

2. Aanandhaththutan Pudhu Varutam
  Aarampiththome Aavalutan;
  Naanilam Purakka Avadhariththa
  Naadhanaip Pukazhvom Nandriyutan 			- Thodh

3. Ippudhu Aantinil Atiyaarkku
  Ikapara Nanmaikal Anukkirakiput;
  Appane Kirupaiyin Settaiyinkeezh
  Arpudhamaayanaith Thaadharippaai 			- Thodh

4. Vetriyaai Yuththaththil Mun Sella,
  Vekuvaai Aadhma Jeyangal Kolla,
  Pakdhiyaai Natandhu Nin Paadhai Sella,
  Pakaruveer Unnadha Varangal Solla	       		- Thodh

5. Thesangal Vazhiye Theemaiyara,
  Thevanaith Thetiye Thoshamara,
  Osannaa Paatiye Aasaiyutan
  Uyyave Yarulvaai Thunpamara 		       		- Thodh
title: Thoththiram, thoththiram, thoththirame

song:
Pudhunava Aantadhaik Kantom - Engal
 Punniyar Yesuvin Kirupaiyinaale.

 Idhuvarai Engalai Irakkamaaik Kaaththa
 Immaanuvel Raajaa Endrendrum Vaazhka

1. Aaviyil Marupirappataiya - Engal
  Aaththumaa Muzhuvadhum Pudhup Pelanataiya
  Meviyun Irakkaththai Engal Mel Vaiththu
  Vedhaalaththai Vella Aayudhan Thaarum. 	  		- Pudhu Nava

2. Kaiyittuch Cheykira Velai - Ellaam
  Karththaa Neer Aaseervadhiththitavenum
  Poi Maarkkam Ozhindhita Meyyaana Vedham
  Pudhup Pelan Petrengum Valarndhongach Cheyyum	- Pudhu Nava

3. Varukira Aapaththu Vilaka - Naangal
  Makimaikku Naattin Virutchangalaaka
  Uruki Jepiththummai Oyaamal Potra
  Unnadha Aaviyin Arul Thandhukaarum   			- Pudhu Nava

4. Panjam Pasiyanukaamal - Innum 		  
  Yuththangal Thondri Thunpam Varaamal
  Thanjam Ataindhummai Saranamendretra
  Thayavu Seydharuluveer Arulmarai Vedhaa  		- Pudhu Nava
title: Pudhu nava aantadhaik kantom

song:
Immattum Jeevan Thandha Karththaavai Aththiyandha
 Ennamaai Sdhoththarip Pomaaka.

 Nammai Ratchikka Vandhu, Thammaip Paliyaaith Thandhu,
 Nar Sukam Mevavum Arpudhamaakavum

1. Kaalam Solpol Kazhiyum, Thanneeraip Pol Vatiyum,
  Kanaavaip Poleyum Ozhiyum;
  Vaalipamum Maraiyum, Seelam Ellaam Kuraiyum,
  Mannin Vaazh Vondrum Nirkamaattaadhu;
  Kolap Padhumaikkum, Neerk Kumizhikkum, Pukaikkume
  Konta Ulakaththil Anta Paran Emaik
  Kantu Karunaikal Vintu Thayavutan. 		- Immattum
  
2. Palavidha Ikkattaiyum Thikilkalaiyum Katandhom,
  Paramap Paadhaiyaith Thotarndhom;
  Valiya Theemaiyai Vendrom, Naliyum Aasaiyaik Kondrom,
  Vanjakar Pakaikkum Thappi Nindrom; 
  Kali Endra Thellaam Vintom, Karththaavin Meetpaik Kantom
  Kaaindha Manadhotu Paaindhu Vizhu Kanam
  Saaindhu Ketavum, Aaraaindhu Neriyutan	 - Immattum

3. Jana Sedham Varuvikkum Ketu Katkor Mutivu
  Thandhu, Norunginadhaik Katti,
  Kana Sapaiyai Aadhariththanpaai Aaseervadhiththu,
  Kan Nokki Ellaar Mel Andrandru
  Thinamum Arul Udhikkach Cheydhu, Thamadhu Theva
  Sindhai Yinotadhi Vindhaiyadhaai Uyar
  Maindhanaal Engalai Indha Vinodhamaai 	          - Immattum
title: Immattum jeevan thandha karththaavai
Sapaiyin asdhipaaram nal
Samasdha mantalaththaiyum

song:
1. Svaami, Vaan Irumpaiyum Poomi Venkalaththaiyum
  Pondradhaal Em Paavaththai Neekki, Kelum Jepaththai.

2. Eri, Kulam, Aarukal Engumulla Jeevankal
  Yaavum Maarikkaakave Vaanjaiyutru Engitre.

3. Maandhar Kotum Pasiyaal Vaatip Pelaveenaththaal
  Thoindhu Thoindhu Pokiraar, Niththam Niththam Saakiraar.

4. Ummaiyandrip Panjaththai Neekki Engal Pasiyaidh
  Theerkkum Jeeva Thaarakar Illai, Neere Ratchakar.

5. Thayai Yulla Thevane, Yesuvin Nimiththame
  Mekaththukkuk Karpiyum; Sonaamaari Pozhiyum.

6. Adhanaal Poomi Kulirum Nilam Palanaith Tharum,
  Thesam Engum Sezhikka Yaavum Ummaith Thudhikkum.
title: Svaami, vaan irumpaiyum

song:
1. Sorpak Kaalam Pirindhaalum, Paar! Pinpu Eka Sapaiyaaka
  Kootuvom Aanandhamaaka, Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar.
 
  Kootuvom .... Kootuvom .... Yesuvotu Vaazhuvom
  Kootuvom .... Kootuvom .... Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar.

2. Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar; Mikka Gnaanaththaal Nataththi,
  Mosa Mindriyum Kaappaatri Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar.

3. Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar; Sirakaale Mooti Vaiththu,
  Mannaa Thandhu Poshippiththu, Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar.

4. Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar; Naasa Mosam Nerittaalum,
  Kaiyil Endhi, Anpinaale Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar.

5. Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar; Jeyakkoti Parandhotum;
  Saavum Thotrup Payandhotum; Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar.
title: Sorpak kaalam pirindhaalum

song:
1. Krisdhava Nesaththil Naam Aikkiya Maanadhaal,
  Indha Mananga Lotrumai Seer Porun Thattume.

2. Nam Pidhaa Sannidhi Naam Jepam Seykirom;
  Payam, Aasai, Nokkam Ondraam Sukam Aluvalum.

3. Nam Thukkap Paarangal Anniyonniyamaaik
  Kanneerutan Vasikkirom Naam, Sakadhaapamaai.

4. Naam Piriyumpodhu, Namakkuth Thukkamaam;
  Aanaalum Mana Yosippaai Servadhai Nampuvom.
title: Krisdhava nesaththil

song:
1. Erusalem, Erusalem Uyarndha Nakare,
  Karththaavin Vaasa Sdhaaname Pooloka Motchame;
  Nee Paazhataindhapatiyaal Visaaramaakirom.
  Unnai Ninaikkum Podhellaam Kanneer Vitukirom.

2. Munnaal Un Makkal Karththaraich Cheeyonil Paatinaar;
  Ippo Payandhotukkamaaip Pulampi Nirkiraar
  Un Menmai Yaavum Poyitru, Un Thaazhvu Yaavaiyum
  Kaana, Ungal Kan Kalangip Poi Kanneeraich Choriyum.

3. Erusalem, Erusalem Manandhirumpaayo?
  Nee Kondra Aattukkuttiyai Angeekariyaayo?
  Nee Iyesuvai Un Mesiyaa Endrantumalavum,
  Ekkaalum Engal Manadhu Viyaakulappatum.
title: Erusalem, erusalem uyarndha

song:
Vaarum, Emadhu Varumai Neekka Vaarum, Thevane! 
 Mazhai Thaarum, Jeevane!

1. Paaril Mikukkum Varuththaththaale Paatu Neentadhe!
  Veku Ketum Neentadhe!

2. Natta Payirkal Mazhai Illaamal Pattup Pochchudhe!
  Mikak Kashtam Aachchudhe!

3. Pachchai Marangal Kanikal Indrip Paarip Pochchudhe!
  Annam Paaral Aachchudhe!

4. Tharani Yaavum Vemmaiyaale Thadhumpudhe! Aiyaa!
  Narar Thayangirom Meyyaai!

5. Karunaiyulla Naadhane! Iththarunam Vaarume!
  Engal Thayakkam Theerume!
title: Vaarum emadhu varumai neekka

song:
1. Karththaave! Indhak Kaalaiyil Naan Thudhi Seykiren.
  Panindhu Jepam Ummantai Irandhu Seykiren.

2. Ennai Needhiyin Paadhaiyil Um Aavi Nataththi,
  En Velaiyaich Charivara Seyyap Pelan Thaarum.

3. Ummai Nesiththu Anjuvar Vaazhvataikindranar.
  Valla Thevaa, Ennaich Choozhak Ketaka Maayirum.
title: Karththaave! Indhak kaalaiyil

song:
1. Yesu Endran Nesare, Kanten Vedha Noolile,
  Paalar Avar Sondham Thaan Thaanga Avar Vallor Thaan.

  Yesu En Nesar, Yesu En Nesar
  Yesu En Nesar, Mey Vedha Vaakkidhe.

2. Ennai Meetka Mariththaar, Motcha Vaasal Thirandhaar,
  Endran Paavam Neekkuvaar, Paalan Ennai Ratchippaar.

3. Pelaveenam Novilum, Endrum Ennai Nesikkum,
  Yesu Thaangith Thetruvaar, Paadhu Kaakka Varuvaar.

4. Endran Meetpar Yesuve, Thanguvaar Ennaruke;
  Nesanaai Naan Mariththaal, Motcham Serppaar Anpinaal.
title: Esu endhan nesare

song:
1. Mana Makizhchchi Naalil, Makizh Kontaatuvom;
  Mannan Yesu Svaamiyai Vaazhththith Thudhi Seyvom.

  Potru! Potru! Em Yesu Raajanai
  Potru! Potru! Makimai Raajanai

2. Paalanaakap Pirandhaar, Paalarai Nesiththaar;
  Paralokam Sendraare, Paalar Em Nesare.

3. Kalileyaavil Jeeviththaar Karththar Kadhai Ketpom
  Avaraith Thudhi Seyvom Avar Em Ratchakar.

4. O! Engal Ratchakare, Um Mun Panikirom.
  Umakkaaka Jeevikka Udhavi Puriyum.
title: Mana makizhchchi naalil

song:
1. Yesu Ummaip Pin Selven; Neer Ennaik Kooppitteere;
  Nampi Nesiththu Vaaren; Motchaththil Serththitum.

  Ummai Pin Selven; (2)
  Ummai Pin Selven; Neer Kaattum Paadhaiyil.

2. Siriya En Kan Kaalkal Thisaimaari Nataththum;
  Naan Kalaiththup Poyinum, Neer En Pelanallo?

3. Vazhiyil En Saththuru, Varumai, Thukkam, Paavam,
  Ummai Naan Pin Sendraalo Viten Thairiyaththai.
title: Esu ummaip pin selven

song:
1. Kelum Yesu Suvaami! Naan Vandhen, Thetritum.

2. Thiru Raththaththaale, En Paavam Neekkitum.

3. Um Than Saayalaaka Suththaangam Pannuveer

4. Jeevan Vittadhaale, En Meetpar Nampuven.

5. Saatchi Solven; Yesu En Paavam Manniththaar.

6. Pataippen En Jeevan, Neer Maanteer, Enakkaai

7. Umdhan Velai Seyven, Neer Meettu Ratchiththeer.

8. Atiyenaik Kaarum, Neere En Nampikkai.

9. Sdhodhram Yesu Naadhaa! Neer Ennai Nesiththeer.
title: Kelum yesusvaami
Esu engal meyppar
Karththar sinekam sudhanaidh

song:
1. Thukkamulla Lokil Engal Kalippukkuk Kaaranam,
  Yesuvin Nal Nesar Naangal Endra Inpa Nichchayam.

  Paalya Snekidhar, Siru Snekidhar,
  Naangal Yesu Naadhar Sondha Nalla Nesar.
  Paalya Snekidhar, Siru Snekidhar,
  Thinam Thinam Paatuvom.

2. Paalar Nesan Naan Endresu Thiru Vaakku Aliththaar;
  Paalar Thamaik Kaiyilendhi Anpaai Aaseervadhiththaar.

3. Nesa Meyppar Thozhuvaththil Vandhu Aarith Therinom!
  Engal Idhayaththil Avar Inpa Saththam Ketkirom.

4. Emmaip Pola Nesa Yesu Pillaiyaaka Irundhaar;
  Meetpaip Petra Paalar Endrum Thullith Thullip Paatuvom.
title: Thukkamulla lokil engal

song:
1. Mun Siru Saamuvel Karththaavin Saththaththai
  Kettavar Vaakkinmel Vaiththaan Per Vaanjaiyai;
  Meyth Thevanotu Pesinaan; Aanandhak Kalippataindhaan.

2. Yokovaa Nesaraai Ennotu Pesinaal,
  Naan Kettup Pakdhiyaai, Poorippen Adhinaal;
  Maa Suththar Endru Unarven; Eppaavath Theengum Veruppen.

3. Avvaare Pesaaro Aam! Sadhya Vedhaththil
  Azhaikkiraar! Idho! Tham Paadhaththantaiyil
  Mey Vedham Engum Thetippaar Vaa! Neesap Paavi! Enkiraar.

4. Appaalan Polave Maa Vaanjaiyaaich Cholven
  Karththaave! Pesume! Atiyen Ketkiren.
  Thevaalayaththil Thozhuven Nal Vaarththai Ketka Vaanjippen.
title: Mun siru saamuvel
Esuvantai seril poorippaakkuvaar

song:
1. Engal Azhakaana Sellap Paalare,
  Yesu Vaarththaik Kelum Indhak Kaalame,
  Paalare! Ennantai Vandhu Serume;
  Paalar Anaivorum Vandhu Serume.

  Vandhu Serume! Vandhu Serume!
  Paalar Anaivorum, Vandhu Serume!

2. Vinnin Raajanaana Yesuvantaikke
  Paalya Senaiyaaraich Cherppom Utane;
  Vaarum Yesuvantai Endru Azhaippom;
  Avar Thivya Anpai Engum Kooruvom.

3. Vandhaal Endran Maarpil Serththu Anaippen
  Siluvaiyil Thongi Jeevan Vituththen,
  Paava Mannippeeven, Sirai Neengitum,
  Uyirotezhundhen, En Antai Varattum.

4. Anpin Karaththantai Vandhom, Yesuve!
  Angu, Thanguvoraip Paavam Seraadhe.
  Avamaakum Saaththaan Thandhirangalum
  Servom Umadhantai Paalaraayinum.
title: Engal azhakaana sellap paalare
Esu karpiththaar oli veesuve
Or azhakaana natchaththiram

song:
1. Adho! Maattuth Thozhu Paar!
  Meyppar Potrum Paalan Yaar?

  Ivar Thaam Maa Valla Karththaa!
  Ivar Makimaiyin Raajaa!
  Thirup Paadham Panivom;
  Raaja Kreetam Soottuvom.

2. Kashtamaai Vanaththil Yaar
  Upavaasam Seykiraar?

3. Anpin Vaarththai Solvadhaar?
  Janam Thudhi Seyvor Yaar?

4. Thukkap Paaram Noi Ullor
  Kunamaakkukiraar?

5. Laasarin Kallarai Paar!
  Angu Kanneer Vittor Yaar?

6. Thiral Janak Koottaththaar
  Potri Vaazhththum Ivar Yaar?

7. Raththa Vervai Sindhi, Yaar
  Jepaththil Poraatinaar?

8. Siluvaiyil Kaatchi Paar!
  Arum Jeevan Vittadhaar?

9. Saavai Vendru Ezhundhaar,
  Adhaal Nammai Meettor Yaar?

10.Raaja Kolam Anindhaar,
  Lokam Yaavum Aalkiraar.
title: Adho maattuth thozhu paar
Paalare! Or nesar untu

song:
Poomi Adhirndhaalum Aazhi Ponginaalum
 Enna Nerittaalum Anjiten.

1. Yekovaa Thunai Nirkiraar, Anjiten.
  Ekkaalum Avar Kai Vitaar, Anjiten. 	   	- Poomi

2. Or Jeeva Nadhiyuntu Paar! Anjiten.
  Aththaal Sandhosham Seykiraar, Anjiten. - Poomi

3. Naan Undran Thevan Enkiraar, Anjiten.
  Maatraarai Otap Pannuvaar Anjiten. 	 - Poomi

4. En Yesu Naadhar Naamam Jeyam! Nampuven.
  En Yesu Naadhar Naamam Jeyam! Nampuven.
  Yesu Naamam Jeyam (3) Nampuven.
title: Poomi adhirndhaalum aazhi

song:
1. Yesuve! Kalvaariyil Ennai Vaiththuk Kollum;
  Paavam Pokkum Raththamaam Thivya Ootraik Kaattum.
  
  Meetpare! Meetpare! Endran Menmai Neere
  Vinnil Vaazhumalavum Nanmai Seykuveere

2. Paaviyen Kalvaariyil Ratchippaip Petrene!
  Gnaana Jodhi Thondravum Kantu Pooriththene!

3. Ratchakaa Kalvaariyin Kaatchi Kantonaaka,
  Pakdhiyotu Jeevikka Ennai Aalveeraaka.

4. Innamum Kalvaariyil Aavalaai Nirpene;
  Pinpu Motcha Lokaththil Endrum Vaazhuvene.
title: Esuve! Kalvaariyil ennai

song:
1. Veeraadhi Veerar Yesu Senai Naangal,
  Senai Naangal, Yesu Senai Naangal.

2. Thiruvasanaththai Engum Thirindhu Solvom;
  Thirindhu Solvo Madhai Arindhu Solvom,

3. Ariveena Mennum Naattai Adhamaakkuvom;
  Adhamaakkuvom; Gnaanamadhaal Thaakkuvom.

4. Iratchanya Seeraavutan Needhik Kavasam,
  Needhik Kavasam Kaiyaaluvom Vasam.

5. Visvaasak Ketakaththai Meluyarththuvom.
  Meluyarththuvom; Adhai Meluyarththuvom.

6. Paava Sodhanai Thataikal, Paasam Neekkuvom;
  Paasam Neekkuvom; Aasaapaasam Neekkuvom.
title: Veeraadhi veerar yesu senai

song:
1. Naan Motchap Payanam Pokindren;
  Ennutan Varuvaar Yesu;
  Ippaadhaiyin Menmai Kooruven,
  Ennutan Varuvaar Yesu.
  
  Yesu, Yesu Ennutan Varuvaar Yesu,

2. Naan Payamillaamar Pokalaam,
  Ennutan Varuvaar Yesu.
  En Nenjin Makizhchchi Niraivaam,
  Ennutan Varuvaar Yesu

3. Anekath Thataikal Sandhippen,
  Ennutan Varuvaar Yesu;
  Ellaavatraiyum Naan Merkolven
  Ennutan Varuvaar Yesu

4. Neeyum Ippaadhaiyil Seruvaai,
  Unnutan Varuvaar Yesu
  Endrendrum Motchaththil Vaazhuvaai
  Unnutan Varuvaar Yesu
title: Naan motchap payanam pokindren
En paavam, saapam, novum

song:
1. Velichchamaaki Iravu Pakalai
  Vekuvaai Mudhal Naalerpatuththi,
  Aakaaya Virivai Untaakki,
  Amaiththaar Irantaam Naaladhile.

2. Moondraam Naalil Jalam Piriya,
  Mulaiththu Tharaiyil Pulpoontu;
  Setikoti Virutchak Kanikalutan
  Sirappaaka Yirukkach Cheydhanare.

3. Naalaam Naalil Vaanamadhil
  Navamaai Udhikkum Sooriyanum,
  Sandhiran Koti Natchaththiram
  Sarva Vallavar Sollaalamaiththaar.

  Seekram Ikkashtam Parandhu Sellume

3. Angen Meetpar Pakkam Naan Jeevippen.
  Avaraith Thudhippen Endrendraikkum.
  Ange Naan Aavalaai Nesipporaik Kantu
  Makizhndhu Thudhippen Avvin Naattil.
title: Naan ingor anniyan

song:
1. Nadhi Pol Kalikoordhal Paayumpodhum
  Thunpa Alai Modhum Podhum
  Enakku Enna Nerittaalum, Neere
  En Thunai Endru Sol Aadhmaave.

2. Saaththaan Ennai Kasdhiyaal Sodhiththaalum
  Naan Avarai Antich Cherven
  Kirisdhu En Nirppandha Nilaimaiyai
  Arindhu Maantaare Enakkaai.

3. En Paavangal Yaavaiyum Siluvaiyil
  Enakkaai Avar Sumandhaar.
  Naan Avaril Vitudhalaiyaanene
  Potruven Avarin Anpaiye.

4. Thevane, Vaanam Surul Pol Vilaki
  Thoodharin Ekkaalach Chaththam
  Thoniththu Engal Raajaa Varum Naalai
  Kaanach Cheyyum Engal Pidhaave.
title: Nadhi pol kilikoordhal

song:
1. En Jeevanin Maa Raajane 
  Naan Umadhatimai
  Enakkaaka Neer Anindha 
  Mulmuti Maraven.
 
  Kedhsemaneyai Maraven,,
  Um  Thuyaraththai Maraven,
  Um Anpai Endrum Maraven
  Kalvaarikku Nataththum

2. Enakkaaka Neer Sumandha 
  Siluvai Maraven,
  Am Maraththil Neer Ataindha 
  Paatukal Maraven.

3. Neer Niththirai Seydhapodhu 
  Thoodhar Vandhu Kaaval
  Seydha Verum Kallaraiyai 
  Enakkuk Kaanpiyum.

4. Naaldhorum En Siluvaiyai 
  Umakkaaich Chumappen.
  Paadhai Thuyaramaakilum 
  Naan Selven Ummutan.
title: En jeevanin maa raajane

song:
Kaalam Idhu Kataikkaalam Idhu.
Karththarin Varukaikkuk Kaalam Idhu.
Indre Nee Iratchippu Ataindhita
Kirupaiyin Kaalamidhu

1. Kaalaththin Arumaiyai Unarndhu Neeyum
  Kirisdhuvin Paadhaththantai
  Vandhataiyaththakka Samayamidhu
  Veenaakak Kazhiththitaadhe			- Kaalam

2. Muththoodhin Suvisesham Ulakamengum
  Sendritak Kaalam Idhu
  Unnai Adharkaaka Arppanikka
  Satrum Thayangitaadhe.				- Kaalam

3. Aruvatai Seydhitum Kaalam Idhu.
  Adharkaaka Uzhaiththitum Kaalam Idhu.
  Jepiththuk Kotuththita Kaalam Idhu.
  Ellaavatrirkum Kaalam Idhu 			- Kaalam
title: Kaalam idhu kataikkaalam

song:
1. Kalangaadhe Thikaiyaadhe Nee,
  Karththar Unnaik Kaappaar.
  Avar Settaiyil Ataikkalam
  Thandhu Unnaik Kaappaar.

  Karththar Unnaik Kaappaar
  Ennaalilum Enneramum
  Avar Unnaik Kaappaar;
  Mutrumaai Avar Kaappaar.

2. Un Ninaivu Tholviyutraalum
  Manam Thalaraadhe.
  Aapaththai Nee Kittich Cherndhaalum
  Karththar Unnaik Kaappaar.

3. Un Thevaikal Yaavum Thandhunnai
  Avar Endrum Kaappaar.
  Un Nanmaikkaanavaikal Yaavum
  Avar Thandhu Kaappaar.

4. Enna Maa Sodhanaiyilume
  Avar Pelan Eevaar
  Avaritam Unnai Oppuvi;
  Avar Unnaik Kaappaar.
title: Kalangaadhe thikaiyaadhe nee

song:
1. Makimaiyin Raajaa Kolaththai Vittu
  Ivvulakam Vandheer Enakkaai.
  Aanaal Pedhlakemil Um Pirappirku
  Itamillaamar Poyitre!

  Vaarum En Ullaththil, Thevaa!
  Umakku Itamuntu Ennil.

2. Um Maa Adhisaya Pirappaik Koori
  Thoodharkal Paati Makizhndhaarkal.
  Aanaal Elimaiyaaka Ivvulakaththil
  Ummaith Thaazhththineer Enakkaai.

3. Narikalukkuk Kuzhiyum, Aakaaya
  Paravaikalukkuk Kootunte.
  Aanaal Kalileyaa Naattil Um Thalaiyai
  Saaikka Itamum Illaiye.

4. Thevane, Neer Jeeva Vaarththaiyaai Vandheer
  Um Makkalai Vituvikkave.
  Aanaal, Mulmati Sootti Nindhiththu Ummai
  Nataththinaarkal Kalvaari.

5. Neer Makimaiyaai Thoodha Senaiyutan
  Vaanil Raajanaai Varum Podhu
  Makane Ennitam Itamuntunakku
  Endra Um Vaarththai Ketkattum.
 
   En Idhayaththil Poorippen 
   Avvaarththaiyai Naan Ketkumpodhu
title: Makimaiyin raajaa kolaththai vittu

song:
1. En Yesu Mattum Siluvai Sumakka Ventumo?
  Ovvoruvarkkum Siluvai Untu; Enakkume

2. Ennai Vitudhalai Seyyum Mattum Naan Siluvai
  Sumandhu Maa Sandhoshamaai En Kreetam Peruven

3. Ap Palingulla Veedhiyil Meetparin Paadhaththil 
  En Kireetththaip Pataiththu Thudhippen Niththiyamaai.
title: En yesu mattum siluvai

song:
1. Mukamukamaakak Kaanpen
  Anparaam En Yesuvai
  Muzhu Makimaiyaai Kaanpen
  En Kankalaal Naan Kaanpen.

  Muka Mukamaakak Kaanpen
  Vaanangaluk Kappaale
  Muzhu Makimaiyil Kaanpen
  En Kankalaal Naan Kaanpen.

2. Ippo Nizhalaattamaaka
  Thirai Natuvaakaththaan;
  Andha Naal Varumpozhudho
  Muzhu Makimaiyile.

3. Kantaale Enna Aanandham!
  Thukkam Thunpam Neengume!
  Yaavum Nerppatuththappattu
  Irul Neengi Vitume.

4. Aanandhamaam Annimisham
  Kantavarai Ariya!
  Ratchaa Perumaan En Yesu
  Enakkaaka Maantavar.
title: Mukamukamaakak kaanpen

song:
1. En Meetpar Enakku Ventum
  Appo Enakken Payam?
  Avarin Karaththaal Ennai
  Anaiththuch Cherththituvaar.

  Aadhmaave, Anjaadhiru,
  Avar Nataththattume.
  Naan Selven; Avar Nataththum
  Paadhai Engum Selluven.

2. En Meetpar Enakku Ventum
  Nampikkai Kundrum Podhu
  Matravar Koorakkootaadha
  Thairiyam Kooruvaar Avar.

3. En Meetpar Enakku Ventum
  Ulaka Jeevayaththil
  Katal Kondhalikkum Podhum
  Por Ennaich Choozhum Podhum.

4. En Meetpar Enakku Ventum
  En Pelaveenaththile
  Ennai Avar Thaanguvaare
  Akkarai Serummattum.
title: En meetpar enakku ventum

song:
Thesam Yaavume Mosamaakudhe - Paava
Naasam Seyyave Yesu Varukiraar.

1. Soppanam Kantaar Nepukaadhnechchaar;
  Soppanaththaiyum Arththaththaiyume
  Solli Thandhita Aatkal Thetinaar;
  Solla Yaarume Kaldheyarillai. 		- Thesam

2. Thalaidhaan Thangame; Maarpu Velliye;
  Silaiyin Vayirume Venkalamaame;
  Irumpuk Kaalkale; Paadhangal Mattum
  Irumpum Kalimannum Kalandhu Aanadhe. 		- Thesam

3. Thangam Paapilon; Velli Persiyaa;
  Venkalath Thotai Kirekka Thesame;
  Irumpu Romare; Naam Vaazhum Kaalam
  Irumpum Kalimannum Kalandha Paadhame 		- Thesam

4. Kaliman Irumpume Kalavaadhadhu Pol
  Kaliman Manidhanil Otrumaiyillai
  Santai Engume Ai.Naa. Sangaththaal
  Santai Niruththave Iyalavillaiye. 		- Thesam

5. Silaiyin Paadhaththil Vizhundha Kal Ondru
  Silaiyaith Thakarththadhu; Nilaiyaai Nindradhu.
  Yesu Kirisdhuvaam Andhakkanmalai
  Yesu Varukiraar Aayaththam Aavom. 		- Thesam
title: Thesam yaavume mosamaakudhe

song:
Thevan Un Sumaidhaangi;
 Tholmel Sumai En Innum?
 Thevan Un Parikaari;
 Thozhaa En Azhukai Innum? 			  - Thevan

1. Karuppaanavan, Nee Kariyaanavan Endru
  Veruppaakap Pirar Koorinum
  Katindhituvaar Saaththaanaiye;
  Katandheerththu Utai Tharuvaar.	          - Thevan

2. Kaliyaana Saalaiyil Virundhaalikku Raajaa
  Polivaana Utaikotuththaar.
  Utuththaamela Oruvan Vandhaan.
  Ketuththaane Makizhchchidhanai	          - Thevan

3. Ilaippaarudhal Thaan Kotuththitave Yesu
  Kalaiththorai Azhaikkindraare!
  Varundhuvore, Vizhundhitaadheer;
  Virundhuntu Vandhituveer. 			  - Thevan

song:
1. Theva Aaseervaadham, Engalukkuth Thaarum
  Naangal Veetu Selkindrom, Engalotu Vaarum.

2. Parisuththa Aavi, Engalitam Thangi
  Nidhya Paadhai Nataththam, Naangal Vazhi Natappom.

3. Aamen (3) Iyesu Kirisdhu Naamaththil
  Pidhaa, Sudhan, Aavikkum Makimaiyuntaakattum.
